metas.name: Still Here, Still There
metas.description: A Chinese woman in her fifties moves alone to the U.S., chasing an American Dream postponed for three decades. As she struggles between freedom and obligation, her pursuit reveals the quiet contradictions of migration—where sacrifice and obsession blur, and one woman’s journey reshapes the filmmaker’s own.

metas.name: Rage Against the Archive
metas.description: This experimental browser-based film investigates the networked afterlives of ethnographic photographs from the 19th-century colonial publication 'The People of India' as they circulate through the New York Public Library’s digital archive. Through performative interventions and acts of Electronic Civil Disobedience that corrupt the archive’s HTML code, the artist transforms the website itself into a site of protest.

metas.name: I Wanna Be With You Everywhere
metas.description: Recognizing that, due to a lack of access, disability communities are often barred from cultural institutions and social resources, an artist collective produces uniquely accessible events for an ever-expanding vision of a cross-disability community. Capturing them at work and at play, this film embraces the collective’s commitment to an aesthetics that incorporates collectively made creative access while highlighting integrated audio description, open captioning, descriptive audio narration, and ASL interpretation integrated into the film itself.

metas.name: The Order
metas.description: A phantasmagorical audio-visual overload of vampiric Philaspychogeography and pure psychic energy made manifest via filmmaker Nathaniel C. Shannon (Saint Vitus Bar: The First Ten Years Book, Deadguy: Killing Music), with score and sound-design by Don Devore, founding member of legendary Philadelphia hardcore band Ink & Dagger.

metas.name: I'm Not You
metas.description: Eighteen-year-old Joe is caught in an emotional storm of identity, sexuality, and expectation. This crisis rips the heart out of a world that once seemed simply, now torn between the pressures imposed by a traditional working-class family and labels imposed by friendships groups and individuals. Joe embarks on a journey of discovery and introspection that threatens to destroy a family, a community, and ultimately a life.

metas.name: Power Trip
metas.description: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

metas.name: Tuna on Rye
metas.description: Amy and Arthur deal with the everyday complications of Arthur’s dementia.

metas.name: Camp Rock 3
metas.description: When Connect 3 loses their opening act for a major reunion tour, they return to their beloved Camp Rock to discover the next big thing. As campers vie for the chance to open for their favorite band, tensions rise and friendships are tested - leading to unexpected alliances, revelations, and romances.

metas.name: How the Sausage Was Made
metas.description: A making-of doc for “Fuck My Son.”

metas.name: Ballad of Eighteen
metas.description: A father's gift to his daughter on her 18th birthday - a diary. The diary remained untouched, until the daughter inscribed his eulogy on its first page. Through the mist of Chinese ritual, each image of memory lingers like the final note of a melancholy song.

metas.name: Independence
metas.description: As the UK overhauls its benefits system, three disabled people navigate a hostile bureaucracy that demands constant proof of disability in order to access support. Through re-edited interviews and speculative imagery, the film reveals how enforced visibility restricts care. As an alternative, the film imagines aesthetic interdependence as a radical form of resistance.

metas.name: DUST DREAM
metas.description: Four middle-aged women each confront their deepest fears in their dreams—things they never wish to happen, yet feel as if they have already lived through. In the end, dreams and reality blur into one indistinguishable chaos.

metas.name: documentary
metas.description: This short film uses a destructive, frame-by-frame editing pipeline to glitch and reshape a spoken testimony into a reflection of the filmmaker's own anxieties. Through generative fill, frame-interpolation, and manipulative editing, the narrative is humorously transformed into a disturbing commentary on the pastimes of the elite.

metas.name: as the fires rage on
metas.description: In a world of escalating wildfires and expanding prison systems, an incarcerated crew fights fires for 70¢ an hour. As the camera observes their daily routines, it examines not just their labor, but the systems of surveillance shaping both their lives and the film’s production.

metas.name: Bajo el Sol
metas.description: During a summer spent with his grandmother on the Oaxacan Coast, a filmmaker explores the layered relationship Puerto Escondido has with tourism through conversations around labor, water, contamination, and gentrification with tourists and locals alike.

metas.name: The Suburban Swindle
metas.description: Throughout the midwest one criminal syndicate is feared above all else, the Suburban Swindlers. Yet again they have gotten away… or so they think? Can they get away with their greatest deception yet as the law closes in, or will they end up caught in their web of lies.

metas.name: Bonne Omelette
metas.description: An aspiring home cook strives to craft the perfect omelette for his partner in this passionate food film.

metas.name: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS
metas.description: A captivating journey into KATSEYE's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, explore the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, see why this group's story is only just beginning.

metas.name: Fast
metas.description: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

metas.name: Every Now and Then, I Fall Apart
metas.description: Haunted by her best friend’s overdose, Eden numbs her grief through fleeting intimacy and quiet self-destruction. A sudden call from God pulls her back to the site of the death, where she’s offered a choice that forces her to confront what she’s been avoiding—and what she’s willing to destroy.

metas.name: Still Life
metas.description: After their son is stillborn at 24 weeks, Jess navigates an unexpected form of motherhood marked by silent milestones and uncomfortable social encounters, while Max struggles to hold their family together through grief.

metas.name: Hot Peasant Summer
metas.description: Nothing can stop the party for Brooke & Haley, not even getting flushed back to the 14th century.

metas.name: Shackled
metas.description: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

metas.name: Eye to Eye
metas.description: A young man helps his girlfriend to see without sight.

metas.name: Cheesecake
metas.description: A husband sets out to buy cheesecake for his pregnant wife, only to be swallowed by city chaos as she goes into labor alone.

metas.name: Peter
metas.description: Young Canadian Alden Brown traveled from Nova Scotia to Hollywood in the early 1980s and became one of the biggest porn stars ever.

metas.name: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
metas.description: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

metas.name: The Cuts
metas.description: Theatre faculty spar over outlandish financial schemes to keep their department afloat. The arts are worth saving - but can these bozos do it?

metas.name: Meet Cute In the CCU
metas.description: In the waiting room of a hospital's Cardiac Care Unit, two strangers, Sophia and Emilio, await word about their respective loved ones in surgery. Seeing Sophia is near panic, Emilio starts a conversation about topics innocuous (incompetent winking, the meaning of corniness) and profound (life's journey). In the process they make a connection that will forever alter the course of both of their lives.

metas.name: Under One Roof
metas.description: Dani, a product of divorce and a single mother, is working from home while caring for her peppery, sick mother when her bohemian father shows up on her doorstep, homeless. What follows is a cramped, chaotic reunion about family, friction, and being stuck together.

metas.name: Have A Heart
metas.description: Diana has a vendetta against dating. When led to a surprise blind date by her boy-mad best friend, Solana,  she gets blindsided by an accidental love arrow—courtesy of a burned-out Cupid and a date with an agenda.

metas.name: Toy Story Back-To-School Lunchbox Disaster!
metas.description: Oh no! It's Bonnie's first day of school...and Woody, Buzz, and Jessie just spilled her lunch!

metas.name: The Odyssey
metas.description: Telemachus is in search for his father, Odysseus, who disappeared 20 years ago.

metas.name: Down But Not Out
metas.description: Kid gets bullied and challenges bully to a boxing match

metas.name: Dementium
metas.description: Wyatt Bailey settles into a secluded and unknown to him cabin on a small Christmas tree farm with one driving goal; to solve his mother's murder. Unfortunately, the one person who might hold the answer is dead and wrapped in plastic in the back of his trunk... It's Wyatt's father. In a final and desperate attempt, Wyatt takes DMT, determined to ask his father the truth -- If he killed his own wife. What follows is both horror and hope in the cosmic arrival of Wyatt's charming ex-girlfriend, Cora, who continually begs him to revisit their first date together, as well as a haunting and terrifying witch hell-bent on Wyatt hurting himself. As Wyatt's drug-fueled nightmare unfolds, both entities will fight for Wyatt's soul as he works on coming to terms with his own complicated past.

metas.name: Lost Weekend Planetarium Experience
metas.description: Experience Lost Weekend in a breathtaking audiovisual journey that travels from the star-filled skies of Madagascar and the shimmering Northern Lights above Iceland's glaciers to the powerful storms across Texas. Filmed in nearly 20 countries, with no computer-generated imagery, this show brings audiences closer to the natural world through stunning nightscapes that blend music, science, art, and a sense of discovery.

metas.name: Rebel Flowers
metas.description: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

metas.name: Live Crickets
metas.description: Cass throws an impromptu funeral for her oldest friend, two weeks after her boyfriend dumped her and moved out. As Cass walks through the sea of people she thought might be her friends, we watch her realize just how alone she truly is.

metas.name: 5002 Space Aliens
metas.description: There are 5002 space aliens currently on our planet. This is the only known footage of all of them. Please put on your anti-alien glasses now and memorize all 5002 space aliens.

metas.name: Exposure
metas.description: After a photographer blackmails him, Alex becomes undone at the seams as his life falls apart.

metas.name: Inheritance
metas.description: After their father's cremation, three estranged siblings return home hoping to find closure, but buried tensions resurface when their mother reveals an unexpected decision about the family home forcing them to confront their fractured relationships and shared grief.

metas.name: All The Time
metas.description: Rose and Cole, two former lovers, reunite unexpectedly at a New Year’s house party and must confront their unresolved regrets as nostalgia resurfaces.

metas.name: Dance with Me
metas.description: As the boundaries between past and present blur, Anya  fights to hold onto Sasha, an elderly Holocaust survivor with dementia, as he struggles to distinguish memory from reality.

metas.name: My First Kiss
metas.description: Hally looks back on the night of her first kiss.

metas.name: Dance With Me
metas.description: As the boundaries between past and present blur, an elderly Holocaust survivor with dementia struggles to distinguish memory from reality while his devoted wife fights to hold onto the man she loves before he slips away forever.

metas.name: Mesmera
metas.description: When a series of gruesome suicides plagues a small Northern California town, Detective Hill investigates a mysterious lead, resulting in a deadly encounter with an occult mesmerist responsible for the deaths.

metas.name: Things Always Look Brighter in the Morning
metas.description: Two stranger meet and have a suspicion that they're similarities aren't coincidental...

metas.name: Dinner Tine
metas.description: An employee just wants all of her coworkers to be friends, but unfortunately they all hate each other. The only way for them to become friends is to... throw a dinner party.

metas.name: Miso Soup
metas.description: College student Reiko enrolls in a Japanese-language class to learn her heritage language. However, she begins to fall behind and feels like she is not Japanese enough. In turn, Reiko has to navigate her own feelings about having a dual identity.

metas.name: Three Housewives and a Body
metas.description: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

metas.name: Elise's Dream
metas.description: Elise has a dream about a Cove—and today that dream comes true...

metas.name: A Flash and How It Lasts
metas.description: Living in Los Angeles, a young Chinese gay man longs for the connection with his estranged father that seems out of reach. One day, his father visits him from China, and he discovers the tenderness and sorrow of his father that he had never seen before.

metas.name: Words From The Void
metas.description: A young man has to grapple with an intense moral dilemma.

metas.name: Call of My Life
metas.description: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

metas.name: My Type
metas.description: Inspired by a true story, two twenty-somethings whose shared experience with Type 1 Diabetes sparks an unexpected love connection.

metas.name: irregular
metas.description: a collection of vignettes illustrating a typical tuesday at a dive bar in New York City.

metas.name: Death Do Us Part
metas.description: In the middle ages Giulia, a young rebel, lives in a superstitious little town. She interacts with Death to fight and defeat the black plague.

metas.name: so where u wanna
metas.description: On a historic night, LLC venture to the ill fated second's. After talking to minors and drinking one too many caprisuns, Little Bus and Yung Tricky coerce an innocent Burger King fry cook into filming one of the music videos of all time.  For what seems like a chama time with nicky bair, turns into a power struggle against Elijah Kelly, and a fight to save the life of Burt LoMein. To learn the most valuable lesson of all, the power of love #hueylewis.

metas.name: Umbravius
metas.description: The unknown starts happening in a room full of disbelieve, a men trying to understand the disturbing acts around him when a much darker force is crawling around him for decades..

metas.name: BUS... STOP!
metas.description: A smuggler, an FBI Agent, a journalist, and a man with a talking sombrero happen to all meet at a bus stop.

metas.name: Catching Light
metas.description: Two women in a working relationship. One is more invested than the other, to the point that it breaks her.

metas.name: In the Moment
metas.description: A group of childhood friends reunites during their winter break from college.

metas.name: Degree of Certainty
metas.description: When a young risk analyst at a major US oil company in 1982 learns that the climate research department has just discovered a rapid rise in global temperatures, he has to decide on which side of history he wants to be.

metas.name: St. Jones Ditch
metas.description: A college professor, Tim Donnelly, is caught in an affair with his daughter's roommate. He loses his job, his wife kicks him out, and he hits the road in despair. He finds himself in St. Jones' Ditch, a ghost town in deep East Texas that hasn't quite died, though the folks who end up there have a habit of doing just that. This is a place where people go to quit living. Tim takes his place amongst the odd denizens of the bar and the equally quirky residents, and decides whether or not his life is worth living. This is a dramedy with some naughty laughs and an ultimately redemptive arc.

metas.name: Slogans (Part One)
metas.description: "The Interview"

metas.name: Her Trepidation
metas.description: Pahinag falls lucid in her dream re-living her traumatic past. She wants to change what was done on her but has to avoid the hazards that come along the way.

metas.name: The Spider and the Bee
metas.description: A potential one night stand takes a turn.

metas.name: She Stole My Son's Heart
metas.description: After her last heart transplant fails, Maria is in desperate need of a new heart. Fearing it could give out at any moment, she turns down her boyfriend’s proposal and heads out for a walk — only to mysteriously disappear. As the search intensifies, homicide and missing persons detective Vicky and her rookie partner are assigned to the case. With Maria's time running out, it becomes a race to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance before her failing heart gives out.

metas.name: Today, Tomorrow, Yesterday
metas.description: While caring for her terminally ill mother, a young artist battling depression believes acceptance into her dream school will finally give her life meaning, only to discover that the person she needed to believe in her was herself.

metas.name: Coming Down The Road: The Summer Blockbuster Tour
metas.description: A documentation of Cleveland artists Puma Thurman, DoHM, Meladite, and Irewyrm as they go on their first ever tour across the United States.

metas.name: Absolutely Devoted to You
metas.description: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

metas.name: Sawdust
metas.description: To afford an attorney for their immigrant father in detention, a former construction worker must perform as a femme fatale and seduce a wealthy client.

metas.name: The Assassin
metas.description: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

metas.name: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
metas.description: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

metas.name: Sour Minnows
metas.description: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty L.A. street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As reality grows porous and memory begins to slip, a delirious new logic takes hold.

metas.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
metas.description: A talented shrimp chef with an ego that outweighs his tiny body carries out his vendetta against a certain culinary inclined rat which puts The Shrimp’s human puppet at risk of deportation.

metas.name: Stonewalling
metas.description: After experiencing the classic meet-cute, Dean discovers an unexplainable force that keeps him from making contact with Anika. As each creative attempt to bypass the barrier takes a physically depleting toll on him, Dean must realize the unchangeable nature of their fate.

metas.name: PERFECTIONIST
metas.description: A creative artist falls into obsession and overwhelming determination for an art final as she simultaneously looks back on another artistic sibling of hers.

metas.name: Osees Live in Los Angeles
metas.description: We had agreed to do a 6 show residency at the Teragram in Los Angeles in 2025. Tried to mix it up for the kiddos so I brought on the big guns…BRIGID DAWSON. And boom goes the dynamite! The missing key component to all of this middle era Garage Punk junk. Culled from the last 3 shows here are the creme de la creme of the tunes. Some long bloated fliers and some short sweet friers.

metas.name: Bottled Up
metas.description: Simon decides to declare his love to his boss, Melanie, by hosting a romantic dinner at his mom's house. Over the course of the night, a number of unexpected guests show up leading to an onslaught of confusion.

metas.name: Peregrine Falcon
metas.description: Two young female serial killers take refuge in an abandoned warehouse to plot their next move. As one of the girls struggles with her role as the de facto leader, the other strives to prove her devotion as a follower.

metas.name: The Corner
metas.description: Follows youth boxing coach Daysi Garcia as she fights to give her kids a path to a better future.

metas.name: Baltimore Heirs: The Last Deed Undone
metas.description: This powerful documentary examines the hidden crisis of heirs' property and the lasting impact of systemic displacement on Black families in Baltimore. Through deeply personal stories and historical analysis, the film explores how tangled titles, predatory property systems, tax sales, and generations of inequitable housing policies have contributed to the loss of family homes, land, and wealth in historically Black communities.

metas.name: In the Kitchen
metas.description: In an Upper Manhattan townhouse, a Man and Woman work to get dinner on the table as a playdate downstairs threatens to go horribly wrong.

metas.name: Gambling Problem
metas.description: A man wagers more than he can handle.

metas.name: A Good Man 3
metas.description: Ethan uses a secret dating app for married people looking for affairs. A new romantic link makes him doubt his choices while the police close in on him.

metas.name: Monstrous Me
metas.description: When Ariel was a disabled and disfigured child of three years old, a bad babysitter brought over a bag of weed, her boyfriend, and a VHS of A Nightmare on Elm Street. From under the coffee table, through the railings, Ariel saw themselves in that Zenith television, in the face of Freddy Krueger, and decided there was agency in being a monster rather than a martyr.

metas.name: The Final Fork
metas.description: When her beloved fifth fork mysteriously disappears, an obsessive woman embarks on an increasingly absurd journey to find it, slowly rediscovering the world she’s been too distracted to notice.

metas.name: Awake
metas.description: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

metas.name: The Secret Lives of Suburban Housewives
metas.description: When one couple moves to suburbia, they realize their neighbors are hiding more than a few scandals. After a shocking death rattles the neighborhood, lies and revelations come to surface as a killer races against time to keep their secret buried for good.

metas.name: The Day You Begin
metas.description: On their first day of school, four imaginative kids feel like they don’t belong, until they learn that everyone has a unique story to share. The Day You Begin is a journey of self-acceptance, courage, and the magic that comes when we connect with others. Bursting with color, laughs, and compassion, this animated adaptation brings Jacqueline Woodson’s beloved book to life, reminding kids that every voice matters and every difference is a strength.

metas.name: You Want a Mint?
metas.description: In a city where the rich start to die with their mouths mysteriously filled with mints, Don- a celebrated detective- follows the mints to their source, unaware that his curiosity and class has already made him part of the killer’s target.

metas.name: Behind the Eight-Ball
metas.description: A high-functioning cocaine addict's life begins to crumble as his drug use intensifies, pushing him to face his inner battles and seek redemption before losing everything he values.

metas.name: Two Spirit Initiative
metas.description: A short documentary about the Gender and Sexuality Alliance Network's TSI Initiative.

metas.name: The Ideal
metas.description: With one last chance to speak to his dead younger sister, Felix struggles to find the “right way” to come out to her as a transgender man.

metas.name: Tú y Yo
metas.description: When Estella’s only daughter announces she’s moving away, this codependent mother is forced to confront a life of her own for the first time in decades. Stuck in the same routines and surrounded by nosy neighbors in her desert mobile home community, Estella takes an unexpected leap into the dating world—and into self-discovery.

metas.name: Fortune House
metas.description: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

metas.name: Alterity
metas.description: A group of paranormal researchers discover a dormant alien invasion force hidden in an abandoned shopping mall slated for demolition.

metas.name: Lajiao's Holes
metas.description: Lajiao wants to do things her own way, but a little girl will remind her of her mission as a member of the Zodiac.

metas.name: Glimmer
metas.description: After losing a career-defining fashion opportunity, aspiring queer Latinx designer Carlos begins questioning both his talent and his future. Encouraged by his outspoken best friend and inspired by unexpected moments of connection, he discovers the power of ‘glimmers’—small, magical moments of hope that illuminate life’s path. Set against the vibrant backdrop of queer nightlife, fashion, and chosen family, Glimmer is a heartfelt story about resilience, self-worth, and believing in yourself when everything feels uncertain.

metas.name: i wonder shall i fly
metas.description: Formerly enslaved people reflect Black history through 1940s interview audio and timeless home movies.

metas.name: Genevieve's Garden
metas.description: After being dumped and laid off in quick succession, Lily finds herself at a rising influencer’s new wellness retreat in the Hudson Valley. Looking for a distraction, she becomes obsessively infatuated with a fellow guest.

metas.name: Gun Pilots
metas.description: Gun Pilots takes a compelling insider’s view into the rigorous world of U.S. Army Apache flight training. It follows student aviators as they confront the formidable challenge of mastering the AH-64 Apache—the most lethal attack helicopter ever built!

metas.name: Otter
metas.description: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

metas.name: One Night Only
metas.description: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

metas.name: Wei Baba
metas.description: A woman introduces her Chinese dad to her American Jewish boyfriend and manipulates their language barrier to keep everyone happy.

metas.name: ForeFans
metas.description: A naive international student struggling to make ends meet decides to try webcam modeling to support herself financially. But within the lurid online world where every body is treated as a commodity, what will the ultimate price be?

metas.name: Tony
metas.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

metas.name: A Social Contract
metas.description: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

metas.name: Super Troopers 3
metas.description: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

metas.name: Vietslam: Squashing the Cultural Gap
metas.description: This documentary follows the birth of Vietnam's indie professional wrestling scene- from cramped gyms to a breakout showcase- capturing the hustle, humor, and heart it takes to win over skeptics and build a community one suplex at a time.

metas.name: The Idaho College Murders: Catching Kohberger
metas.description: A killer murders four University of Idaho students in their beds. New body cam footage and digital forensics reveal the disturbing profile of Bryan Kohberger, a calculated, isolated young man who hides a dark search history behind a calm exterior.

metas.name: The Encounter
metas.description: After a young man comes into contact with something otherworldly, two investigators are sent to uncover what happened.

metas.name: Support
metas.description: A mismatched group of strangers meet in a support group, but as their vices fade, their chaotic bond grows

metas.name: Robbie's Gonna Die
metas.description: When Robbie gets a mysterious message prophesying his soon-to-be demise, he and his friends try to get to the bottom of who's behind the ominous call, in all of the wrong ways.

metas.name: Changes: The Story Of Sugar
metas.description: The rise and fall and reunion of punk rock icon Bob Mould's 1990s post-Hüsker Dü band Sugar.

metas.name: Solace
metas.description: Framed by a speech given by the filmmaker’s brother at their uncle’s memorial service, this doc/fiction hybrid comedy blends archival family photos with surreal animated scripted scenes to explore outsized childhood fears, shifting family dynamics and intergenerational care.

metas.name: West Side Familia
metas.description: Through intimate portraits of this tight-knit community, West Side Familia follows the story of a Puerto Rican-led biker gang and community care group from the ‘70s grappling with the preservation of their public traditions and cultural identity in the hyper-gentrified neighborhood of Manhattan’s Upper West Side.

metas.name: The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines
metas.description: For decades, Philadelphia music educator Lovett Hines quietly shaped generations of artists from behind the scenes, nurturing creativity, discipline, individuality and community through music education. Now at 80 years old, his influence continues to ripple across stages, classrooms and cultures through the students and mentees whose lives he helped transform.  Blending intimate conversation, performance, archival elements and reflections from acclaimed artists including Christian McBride, Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, Bilal and Robert Glasper, The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines explores the enduring impact of a Black mentor whose classroom became a launching ground for artistic excellence, self-discovery and cultural legacy.  At its heart, the film is a meditation on mentorship, lineage and the often unseen architects behind transformative art.

metas.name: Our Bodies Ours
metas.description: Our Bodies Ours is a short poetic animated film that explores the nuance and beauty of trans becoming from a diasporic lens. Leaning on the music of lyric, it reframes gender-affirming care as an intricate, intimate and meandering act. What does it take to stitch our bodies into their true and ever-changing shapes, to migrate between who we are and who we may become?

metas.name: Old Man River
metas.description: Old Man River continues Iyabo Kwayana’s exploration of lineage, memory and inheritance through an intimate portrait of her father, a 100-year-old political activist and nation builder from Guyana who helped found the country’s first multiethnic political party. The film sits beside him as he reflects on a lifetime shaped by political struggle, idealism, sacrifice and the contradictions within revolutionary movements.

metas.name: The Seeds We Carry
metas.description: A short documentary weaving intimate portraits of community farm stewards in Southwest Philadelphia. Through the rhythms of planting, cooking and sharing food, the protagonists reveal how everyday acts of care and resistance nurture belonging, foster cross-cultural kinship and preserve a sense of home amid the pressures of gentrification and displacement.

metas.name: Finding Your Laughter
metas.description: In this deeply personal documentary, Arlieta has gone against all popular advice and quit her day job to care for her father, Milton. She has to learn how to laugh in the midst of a disease that is not very funny, using improv to affirm and validate his experiences. Inspired by her father’s own artistic career, Arlieta turns to comedy to process her emotions. It’s challenging for her and her “bonus mom” Charmaine to watch Milton decline, but they support each other and find healing through laughter.

metas.name: Angels Pull Your Hair
metas.description: Angels Pull Your Hair is a narrative short about Danielle, a young Black woman grappling with the lasting impact of being raised by a mother with untreated mental illness. As Danielle struggles to make sense of her past, she’s haunted by the fear that she’s inherited her mother’s condition — a fear that takes form in the figure of a faceless sleep paralysis demon

metas.name: Authors of the Estate
metas.description: In North West London, two estates take their story into their own hands, asking what if a council house can become a publishing house in this tale of ownership, creativity, and the power of community.

metas.name: Glass Bricks
metas.description: Finessa Jawn — a trained dancer and life-long performer — gives us a look behind the curtain into the world of drag, walking us through the process of building a persona and embracing who you are regardless of society's expectations.

metas.name: Fists of Mothers
metas.description: An action film about what happens when two mothers have an awkward conversation about a playdate that turns violent. A fun ride about Black maternal rage, a release for what we’re unable to do in real life — be angry, be messy in the face of both spectacular violence enacted on us and our families as well as the micro-aggressions that have a hidden violence that cuts deep.

metas.name: For Peace of Mind
metas.description: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

metas.name: Ish Meets a Mermaid
metas.description: An Ojibwe artist named Ish finds that his paintings aren’t selling anymore, he is in debt to his gallery rep, and a local goon is lurking around his studio. When he decides to take an artist’s getaway, he meets trouble with a mysterious woman, Ziibi, who claims to be part of an underwater society that tribal mythology refers to as the people of the water, or Nibiinaabe. Ziibi brings Ish on a wild ride that ultimately leads to him finding success in the last place he ever expected — death.

metas.name: To Run Is To Return
metas.description: A young Black British man drives his car through a London landscape with skill as his music blares. His old lanyard that exposes his profession as a pharmacist dangles on the rearview mirror, bouncing to the beat of his music. He is willing it to be a good day. But as he approaches his destination, the cracks begin to show.

metas.name: When They're Gone
metas.description: After an abrupt encounter at a graveyard, two elderly men form an unexpected bond over the grief and love of their late wives.

metas.name: Watch Out for the Ghosts
metas.description: A personal meditation on loss, family, home and reclamation through the artistic process of Adebunmi Gbadebo. Gbadebo creates works out of organic materials from the South Carolina plantation cemeteries where her formerly enslaved ancestors and their descendants are buried.

metas.name: Potato Salad
metas.description: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

metas.name: DCI 2026: Big, Loud and Live
metas.description: Experience the thunderous power and precision of the world’s finest marching music ensembles. “Big, Loud & Live” brings the 2026 Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims to the big screen, broadcast live from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Beyond your average halftime show, the talented ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League blend world-class musicianship with breathtaking choreography and spellbinding visual formations. You’ll have the best seat in the house to witness the top 15 drum corps go head-to-head competing for their shot at the 2026 DCI World Championship title. From the earth-shaking roar of the brass to the lightning-fast precision of the percussion and color guard, see and hear every detail in stunning high definition. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or looking for a one-of-a-kind, live musical event, this is the ultimate way to experience the pinnacle of the marching arts.

metas.name: Soccer Tips & Tricks Vol. 1 With Björn Florg
metas.description: Since the Cold War, American's have come to love the European game known as "Fütbol", or as we American's call it, Soccer. But no American's can touch the European flavor that comes from being Björn and raised in the region. That's why 3 time World Cup Nominee Björn Florg started this video series; to share the tips and tricks he's learned over his many years in the game for your to enjoy from the comfort of your living room! From scoring to ball-handling, Björn leaves no stone un-turned, and no ball un-handled! Follow  Björn as he takes you from the couch to the pitch in this first installement of a proposed 2 part video series.

metas.name: L.A. Bars & Cigarettes
metas.description: Drunk and in desperate need of a cigarette, a high-strung nicotine fiend strikes up a conversation with a fellow smoker— but his quest for a quick fix soon devolves into an existential nightmare.

metas.name: Talk To A Stranger
metas.description: Two people meet in an elevator.

metas.name: No Contact
metas.description: Nostalgia, Black Eyed Peas, and the unwritten rules of New York City dating. When two strangers meet on a bench, a 21-day "break" turns into a masterclass on romance, airport running tropes, West Side Highway running etiquette, and what it actually takes to win someone back.

metas.name: The Betrayal
metas.description: Anthony and Will explore a new food, only to be interrupted by the death of their close friend, Hanbon.

metas.name: Field Mouse
metas.description: There's a mouse trapped in Leonard's house. It's stuck in the walls of the basement.

metas.name: Forever, Obviously
metas.description: A late 90's based short film about friendship and growing up.

metas.name: AEW Grand Slam Mexico
metas.description: All Elite Wrestling is heading back to Mexico City this August with another special edition of AEW Grand Slam: Mexico. This highly anticipated event will emanate LIVE from Arena Mexico on Wednesday, August 5th :  -Kyle Fletcher (c) vs. Mike Bailey for the AEW International Championship  -Willow Nightingale & The Brawling Birds vs. Mercedes Moné & Divine Dominion  -The Demand (c) vs. Hangman Adam Page & Brodido for the AEW World Trios Championship  -Persephone vs. Kris Statlander  -Cage & Cope & The Young Bucks vs. Death Riders  -Mistico & Jericho & Darby Allin vs. Don Callis Family  -Tommaso Ciampa vs. Andrade El Idolo vs. Komander for the #1 spot in the casino gauntlet at All-In  -Mark Davis vs. Will Ospreay in a Mexico City Street Fight

metas.name: More Than A Saint
metas.description: More Than a Saint is an hour-long documentary about quarterback Drew Brees, highlighting his profound impact on the New Orleans community and his historic football career ahead of his Pro Football Hall of Fame induction.

metas.name: Baggage Claim
metas.description: Upon learning of their mother's untimely death, lone-stoner Abby and type-A brother Ben must embark on a body identification road trip home to claim her corpse - along with their own personal baggage.

metas.name: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
metas.description: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

metas.name: Gargantuan
metas.description: Five washed-up heroes reunite to pilot their giant robot and save the world.

metas.name: The Wrong Girls
metas.description: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

metas.name: ENOUGH
metas.description: In the aftermath of an ectopic pregnancy, a young woman must confront her toxic marriage.  Will she break the generational trauma or continue the cycle of abuse?

metas.name: The Doorman
metas.description: A freshman pledge guarding the biggest dorm party of the year faces a test of his commitment to the fraternity.

metas.name: Bullseye
metas.description: An argument between a couple escalates

metas.name: Something Good Going On
metas.description: A Chinese-Indonesian teen confronts a stolen restaurant paycheck, a strained father-son bond, and the cost of his Ivy League future.

metas.name: Trigger Happy
metas.description: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

metas.name: Before Never
metas.description: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

metas.name: Sky to Soil
metas.description: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

metas.name: Turtle Rock
metas.description: A teenage girl named Turtle must overcome her stage fright to fight against dangerous musical monsters with the power of rock ‘n’ roll.

metas.name: Ohio King: A Gooner Sigma Story
metas.description: After the death of his Master Sigma, a gooner named Gian seeks vengeance on the ancient villain, the Ohio King.  On his journey Gian will discover truth, friends, and where he lies in the mind of his fallen Master.

metas.name: Storm on Sesame Street
metas.description: In the Storm on Sesame Street special, Elmo and his friends work together to get ready for a big storm, learning how to be prepared, have courage, and calm their bodies and minds when things feel scary. After the storm passes, Sesame Street looks different, and everyone pitches in to help their neighbors rebuild their homes. With the help of the neighborhood, including celebrity guests Post Malone and Michelle Buteau, Elmo and Abby set out to make a difference, and discover that small acts of kindness, and support from friends, can make the biggest difference of all.

metas.name: Bad Ramen
metas.description: A ramen date goes south when the girl suddenly falls ill at dinner and begins exhibiting sinister behavior.

metas.name: Décima
metas.description: In 1980s Puerto Rico, a grieving man is torn between escaping with his pregnant wife or joining his radicalized younger brother in a dangerous fight for justice, as the death of their brother threatens to tear their family and community apart.

metas.name: Oceanic Feeling
metas.description: On a summer vacation, David must stomach his mother's continued disappointment as he asks for her help after being laid off.

metas.name: Kylie Vincent's Last Day on Earth
metas.description: Last year (2025), Kylie Vincent's Instagram was deleted by Meta, with no option to appeal. Meta is silencing SA survivors and is one of the biggest perpetrators of censorship in America.

metas.name: Ankaha
metas.description: When Priya chooses to hang out with a new intern instead of attending a wedding with her boyfriend Ishaan, he is forced to confront what he really wants out of his future.

metas.name: 24 Hour Sanctuary
metas.description: In the heart of Los Angeles, a century-old deli that was once the symbol of Jewish heritage has survived the changing landscapes of a postmodern society by becoming a 24-hour sanctuary of community resilience for all people.

metas.name: Blessings
metas.description: Ray and Tyler go on a fishing trip. Ray has a proposal; hilarity ensues.

metas.name: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday
metas.description: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

metas.name: Oscar's Date
metas.description: When their roommate starts dating someone from their past, three friends race to warn him before things spiral out of control.

metas.name: The Little Girl Who Didn't Exist
metas.description: When Mel tries to meet the parents of her daughter's new playmate Sara, she finds that everyone claims the child doesn't exist. But as evidence mounts that Sara is real, Mel becomes convinced that someone is hiding the girl to conceal a dark secret.

metas.name: The Lift
metas.description: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

metas.name: The Glitter Fades
metas.description: After an impulsive decision to steal a watch, Matthew, a young man stuck working at a dry cleaner, is pulled into a chain of encounters that force him to confront who he is and who he wants to become.

metas.name: East Did Meet West
metas.description: Inspired by the 1930s court case Roldan vs. Los Angeles County, Filipino Salvador  Roldan and English Marjorie Rogers must find a way to convince an attorney to fight  for their marriage despite the anti-miscegenation laws of the time.

metas.name: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday - Countdown
metas.description: Get the latest breaking news, rivalry analysis from a panel of experts, and much more before The Biggest Party of the Summer concludes on Sunday night!

metas.name: The Inbetween
metas.description: Eric Williams, a renowned food critic is invited to a fine establishment run by a strange, utopian cult.

metas.name: Establishing Shots (and how music affects them)
metas.description: Establishing Shots (and how music affects them), a short film.

metas.name: Hawkins Power & Light
metas.description: HAWKINS POWER and LIGHT is set in 1983 and tells the story of three high school graduates who happen upon X-03, an escaped experiment from Hawkins Lab. Before they know it, they're thrust into a dark government conspiracy.

metas.name: Cornerstone: The Lenny Wilkens Story
metas.description: Built around Lenny’s final interview and the voices of those who knew him best, this short documentary celebrates the life of one of Seattle’s most beloved figures and reflects on a lifetime of leadership, humility, and service.

metas.name: Always Been You
metas.description: Two friends grow apart as one friend's relationship gets in the way of the two.

metas.name: Tracers
metas.description: Tracers follows a group of young American soldiers from basic training through their combat experiences in Vietnam and, for those who survive, their difficult return to civilian life. The film explores the legacy of the original stage production, which was created by Vietnam veterans and became one of the most influential artistic works about the war. Perniciaro's film combines documentary storytelling with staged performance to tell both the story of the play and the experiences that inspired it.

metas.name: Teatro Dallas: 40 Years of Play
metas.description: A glimpse inside Teatro Dallas, a non-profit theater in Dallas Texas, whose unconventional works and workshops have been central to empowering and fostering community in the Dallas Arts scene for over 40 years.

metas.name: coool
metas.description: an elsie fisher joint

metas.name: REW 03
metas.description: A filmmaker rediscovers a family home video thought to have been lost for nearly thirty years.

metas.name: Luteal
metas.description: A comical modern tale of a girl asking herself why she’s irritated all the time, and trying everything in order to change.

metas.name: Instruments of Torture
metas.description: A frustrated musician quits his job to follow his dream, causing untold misery.

metas.name: Toasted Pecan Rolls
metas.description: After the death of his grandfather, a sidelined baseball player teams up with an impulsive waitress to decipher his grandfather's cryptic final belongings, leading them on a surreal quest to reconcile his past and redefine his future.

metas.name: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Saturday
metas.description: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

metas.name: Drywall
metas.description: A small-town sheriff investigates a violent incident on a rural road that leads him to a secluded property where nothing is what it seems.

metas.name: My Happy Place
metas.description: A burned-out office worker discovers a hidden passage to a vibrant bar where he’s effortlessly loved and admired. As this secret escape transforms his confidence and identity, he begins to change in his real life too, forcing him to confront a difficult choice between staying in the fantasy or fully embracing reality.

metas.name: River Runs
metas.description: After suffering a career-threatening injury, a track athlete must overcome his fear of failure and an embodiment of his growing addiction to painkillers.

metas.name: Twisted Scissors
metas.description: After surviving a livestream exploitation warehouse, Ashley is taken in by the Scissors, a covert brothel that tracks and punishes sexual predators. When she discovers Kiko is still being streamed online, Ashley returns to the warehouse with her Scissors to save her friend.

metas.name: Reflex
metas.description: A teenager finds himself in a bloody quest for vengeance after his dirtbike is stolen by a group of gangsters with a kidnapped child.

metas.name: Interiors/Exteriors
metas.description: A disillusioned writer discovers that her boyfriend is going to propose to her soon. She decides to recite a story to him about a young woman's emotional affair with a jazz musician. The boyfriend slowly realizes how the story may reflect cracks in their own relationship, which they must confront.

metas.name: Thresher Shark: Stun to Kill
metas.description: Dr. Craig O'Connell and Aliah Banchik deploy state-of-the-art tech as they try to capture the thresher's deadly tail whip on film in the Philippines.

metas.name: Great White Highway
metas.description: After Canada's first great white attack, sightings spike across the coast and experts race to get answers before another incident rocks the country.

metas.name: HeartStealer
metas.description: A woman seeks to alleviate the trouble she's caused for her boyfriend.

metas.name: Under the Western Skies
metas.description: When a tough female rancher faces losing her family's land, she reluctantly teams up with her new city-boy neighbor, discovering that innovation isn't a betrayal of her roots, and that romance might just come from this wannabe cowboy.

metas.name: The Lesbian Hand
metas.description: Until very recently, depictions of lesbians in the movies have ranged from apparitional to vampiric, salicious to sensationalistic, suggestive to exploitative, melodramatic to horrific. This video explores the portrayals of sapphic sexuality in the cinema from the 1930s to the present through the actions of the hand: touching, holding, feeling, grasping, shaking, exploring, penetrating, reaching out, pulling back, letting go.

metas.name: Oriental Hardon
metas.description: Explores the “no Asians” ban through "gaysian nude archives."

metas.name: Killer Clown
metas.description: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

metas.name: Toast to Italy
metas.description: Jenny travels to Italy for a special bottle of wine for her sister's wedding. She meets Arrigo, also looking for the famous "Love Wine" and together their search leads to a love of their own.

metas.name: Void
metas.description: A man falls into a void and must return to the light.

metas.name: Disciples of a Craftsman
metas.description: In this unpredictable dramedy, Maurice returns home where he must face his haunting past, the hole his father's death has left in the community, and regain his belief in his people. In the culture.

metas.name: Anchors Aweigh
metas.description: When a well-meaning loser gets rejected by his much younger and more successful blonde girlfriend, he rents a small sailboat by the airport and spirals into a state of deep personal reflection.

metas.name: Death, Taxes, And Fantasy Baseball
metas.description: After loosing their fantasy baseball league three people must attend a funeral for a person they don't know and act like they belong.

metas.name: Sincerely, Victor
metas.description: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

metas.name: Robotica
metas.description: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

metas.name: Orange Torches
metas.description: A twelve year old boy unexpectedly spends the week with his eccentric, underachieving father.

metas.name: Bound By Lies
metas.description: Mira and Daisy thought one last score would be their way out. But when things go sideways and someone from their past comes looking for payback, they're left running with a bag full of cash, a broken promise, and nowhere to turn but each other. With love hanging by a thread and danger closing in, they have to decide if what they have is strong enough to survive, or if the escape they dreamed of was never real.

metas.name: The Obelisk
metas.description: While fighting for survival in the wilds of the Northeast, a drifter unites with a mysterious veteran to expose the truth of America’s demise.

metas.name: Sculpting This Earth
metas.description: Follows internationally acclaimed artist Strijdom van der Merwe over four consecutive seasons as he travels to remote locations in the southern African interior to make beautiful land art works in a striking range of spectacular natural settings.

metas.name: Three's Company
metas.description: Three friends prepare to rob a convenience store.

metas.name: Clover
metas.description: A student news crew follows a week in the life of Frankie Bernard, the unluckiest teen in the world, after she finds a four-leafed clover that changes her luck as long as she holds onto it... or does it?

metas.name: Nato Green: The Darkest Hour
metas.description: Nato Green is the country's only semi-functional hybrid of standup comedian and union organizer, so it stands to reason that this hour is part comedy special - part study group on how to defeat fascism. With the help of a whiteboard, Nato breaks down the political spectrum as it exists today and examines his position within it.

metas.name: Friendship Bracelets
metas.description: A deeply depressed high schooler rediscovers the beauty of the world through a to-do list given to her by her best friend.

metas.name: The Guinea Pig
metas.description: A scientist does experiments on a homeschooled patient to see if the internet really rots your brain.

metas.name: Villain
metas.description: Home for winter break, Clyde asks his estranged brother, Sean, to reunite with the family for Christmas Eve dinner. The table is set, and still, no response.

metas.name: Suki Waterhouse: Lollapalooza Chicago
metas.description: Suki Waterhouse's set at Lollapalooza Chicago

metas.name: Cocoon
metas.description: A teenager with an obsession with bugs and physical appearance builds a cocoon in an attempt to make himself beautiful.

metas.name: Horned Toads & Haybales: Water in Churchill County
metas.description: A short film detailing the history of water in Churchill County, Nevada, the location of the first completed project created by the Newlands Reclamation Act of 1902.

metas.name: Private Eyes
metas.description: When 17-year old Jackson Mercer is hired to investigate the school's picture-perfect Student Council President, Emma, he must grapple with his greatest case yet- Teenaged Love.

metas.name: Private Eyes (Director's Cut)
metas.description: When 17-year old Jackson Mercer is hired to investigate the school's picture-perfect Student Council President, Emma, he must grapple with his greatest case yet- eenaged Love.

metas.name: The Real Baristas of Cook County
metas.description: A team of baristas fight for a promotion while a secret shopper sent by corporate reviews their store.

metas.name: By My Side
metas.description: Two friends argue over a seatbelt, leading to a gift which takes a turn for the worse.

metas.name: Strati
metas.description: Angelise fights for her soul against her greatest enemy, doubt.

metas.name: She's Not Wired Like You
metas.description: Liking a girl is exciting until you can't unravel if she's straight or not. Through delusional optimism and shaky uncertainty, Nicole uncovers how it feels discovering that your crush isn't wired like you.

metas.name: FEED
metas.description: While doomscrolling on social media, Dylan receives some strange, otherwordly messages.

metas.name: The Soap Star Murder Mystery
metas.description: A soap star moves to the suburbs after a terrifying stalking incident. A shocking murder pulls her into a web of intrigue where no one can be trusted.

metas.name: Backpack Thieves
metas.description: It's 4 PM at the Hollywood Reservoir... and there's a backpack thief on the loose. Tracking the thief through "Find My," two teenage boys chase him down to Compton, California.

metas.name: My Strange Shark Addiction
metas.description: Four shark fanatics reveal their obsessions, including an intimate relationship, a massive collection, and a body covered in sharks.

metas.name: Sharkzilla Takes New York
metas.description: A scientist hunts for a possible radioactive shark killer near an old nuclear dumping ground in New York that's ringed with makos and great whites.

metas.name: Secrets of the Great White Kill
metas.description: Dr Riley Elliott and Kori Burkhardt push every boundary to record never-before-seen predations by great white sharks.

metas.name: Northbound
metas.description: Heading toward separate futures after college graduation, Margot offers a ride to Dylan, a classmate she has only ever known in passing, when his flight home falls through. Navigating the backroads of the Pacific Northwest, Margot harbors the fresh grief of her father’s passing while Dylan carries the anxiety of entering a life he isn’t sure he wants. Over the course of five days, their fleeting connection reshapes the way both of them view the road ahead.

metas.name: The Twin Who Lived
metas.description: After discovering she once had a twin sister who died when she was a child, Claire begins receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What at first seems like a cruel prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of Claire's life.

metas.name: Summer '16
metas.description: Set during the summer of 2016, Jared's world shifts when his best friend, Bando, lands his first job—forcing Jared to confront the one thing he's been avoiding: growing up.

metas.name: Farm to Table
metas.description: A humble farmer receives an invite to an experimental food focus group.

metas.name: Being, Having, Appearing
metas.description: A short documentary taking one along the process and creation of the piece, ‘Being, Having, Appearing’, by Logan Bonner.

metas.name: Trust Nobody 4 “You Can’t Trust A Fool”
metas.description: Fool is back in Milwaukee with a new crew and a fresh new hustle, but their biggest score turns into their worst mistake.

metas.name: Sad Porn Circa 1994
metas.description: Links gay pornography with liberation politics and the curtailment of sexual possibility.

metas.name: Death, Drugs, and Diabetes
metas.description: After soft spoken Billy is pressured into carrying around a bag of drugs at a party, four friends work to generate enough bail money to let him go free.

metas.name: Atelo
metas.description: After a brutal race, Damian and Amelia attempt to escape with the blood money they stole.

metas.name: Wrong Answer
metas.description: A young man is tested when being asked an unknown question. What will happen if he answers wrong?

metas.name: Molder Man
metas.description: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

metas.name: One Guy, Too Many Dates
metas.description: After one too many disastrous dates, a talented software engineer creates a women-centered app where users can anonymously review their dating experiences. What begins as a simple idea quickly turns into a viral phenomenon, igniting chaos between men and women online, attracting media attention, and complicating Emily’s own love life. In a world where everyone has opinions about dating, Emily discovers that building an app about relationships might be easier than surviving one.

metas.name: Super Duper
metas.description: On the night of a highly anticipated Super Duper Moon, two people embark on an intimate nighttime journey together. As clouds obscure the sky and the night stretches on, anticipation gives way to waiting, uncertainty, and presence. With the spectacle they planned for absent, the meaning of the evening must be negotiated through behavior, silence, and choice—revealing whether love is sustained by symbols or by staying.

metas.name: Salieri and Mozart
metas.description: A young gifted actor rehearses on his own when interrupted by the theater director and bizarrely mistreated. What will he make of it?

metas.name: Dead & Breakfast
metas.description: The story follows Danielle Stanbreaker, a paranormal consultant investigating a strange supernatural occurrence at a local Bed and Breakfast that ultimately ends up being real.

metas.name: City of Angels
metas.description: Two best friends move to Los Angeles to chase their dreams, but when a fame-hungry ritual backfires, vengeful spirits seek them out and escaping may mean sacrificing everything they came for.

metas.name: HANDMEDOWN
metas.description: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

metas.name: A Way Out
metas.description: One call for help ignites a nationwide fight to end human trafficking.  A Way Out follows Safe House Project as they confront the reality of human trafficking in the United States and build a clear path to safety for survivors. The documentary centers on a simple turning point: a survivor makes a call for help. From there, the film tracks what happens behind the scenes as Safe House Project coordinates a rapid response, connects with survivor advocates, and works alongside law enforcement and trusted partners to move someone from immediate danger toward safety and justice. As the story unfolds, viewers see how a single call can set a nationwide network in motion, and how clarity, coordination, and courage can change the outcome for someone who feels trapped. The film balances the gravity of the issue with a strong sense of hope, showing ordinary people stepping into an extraordinary mission to make a way out.  —Clay Vaughan

metas.name: Wild Inside
metas.description: On February 2, 2023, Flaco — a male Eurasian eagle-owl, the largest species of owl in the world — was discovered missing from his cage at the Central Park Zoo in Manhattan. What follows when Flaco, who had lived his entire life in captivity, was released in New York City is a surprising story revealing the delight, concern, and fascination of millions in the city and beyond.

metas.name: Beneath Mud Lake
metas.description: Four guys go to an Airbnb at a lake, and try and capture a foretold beast in the surrounding woods on camera.

metas.name: TRICKSHOT
metas.description: A man struggles to make a backwards basketball trick shot.

metas.name: Love on the Edge
metas.description: When her abusive spouse is murdered, a fleeing news anchor and her mysterious coworker are trapped in a web of lies during a police interrogation

metas.name: Favorite Child
metas.description: A group of siblings must confront their tensions and secrets when a family dog accidentally ingests one brother's pills. As fear and guilt surface, the crisis forces the fractured family closer together.

metas.name: Thrifted
metas.description: A young queer couple is brought 70 years into the past with one question. The camera knows the truth, and the rest of us can only imagine. A second-hand find was sweet, but the love captured was even sweeter.

metas.name: While They Were Away
metas.description: A day home alone during the summer of my freshman year of college.

metas.name: PotatoHead
metas.description: Robert Relish, an aspiring Far Right social media influencer struggles to keep balance in his carefully crafted "life" he presents online as he dodges his blind girlfriend Olivia and slowly preys on someone online doing what he does but better.

metas.name: Waffles
metas.description: Amidst an ongoing war, an American officer finds a private whom he believes is a spy, and cordially invites him to a luncheon.

metas.name: windowfilm
metas.description: A journey between Astoria and Herald Square through the windows of the train.

metas.name: Sisters of the Shattered Moon
metas.description: When a teenage girl discovers the corruption of her futuristic suburban idyll in the clouds, she is expelled to a vast underworld of endless night.

metas.name: Ultimate Shark Dive
metas.description: In a world first, a cliff diver Molly Carlson attempts a 50-foot dive off a helicopter into a floating cage surrounded by a shark feeding frenzy.

metas.name: How to Train a Great White
metas.description: Experts attempt to train great white sharks using cues and challenges to test learning, memory, and decision-making in the wild.

metas.name: What Shark Attacked?
metas.description: Experts analyze shark encounters caught on camera, using forensics to review bite marks and behavior patterns as they wonder: What shark attacked?

metas.name: Carpe Noctem
metas.description: Thomas's life is changed after he watches Dead Poets Society for the first time. It makes him realize he must carpe diem, or seize the day, and make the most of Summer... but it's night, so he puts his own spin on the classic phrase. With the help of a newfound friend and a video camera, Thomas has the best Summer of his life.

metas.name: John Shearer: American Moments
metas.description: A documentary short on the life and work of the late artist John Shearer, one of the greatest American photographers of the 20th century.

metas.name: AMUCK
metas.description: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

metas.name: Mickey's Country Farm
metas.description: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

metas.name: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
metas.description: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

metas.name: Naked Pool Party
metas.description: A comedy that follows three gay friends as they step out of their comfort zones to attend their first naked pool party.

metas.name: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
metas.description: When the fairytale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

metas.name: Interstate
metas.description: Set in 2009, a group of lost high school graduates embark on a road trip to find themselves before they enter the next chapter of their lives. However, their plans take a twist when both old and new drama emerges, threatening to break their fragile group bond.

metas.name: A Comfortable Relationship
metas.description: A quiet portrait of love, comfort, and the subtle ways two people can lose themselves in one another.

metas.name: LAVOLA Live at The Shack North
metas.description: LAVOLA Live at The Shack North concert film includes performances from LAVOLA's album "Did You Have a Good Day."

metas.name: Lover of a Ghost
metas.description: A girl abandoned by her lover is ostracized by the people of a small town, refusing to believe he ran from a murder. In search of clues she returns to the scene of the crime, only to be met by the silent gaze of a ghost.

metas.name: Cool Drink
metas.description: Sixteen best friends from across the planet meet for the first time and experience loss, love, and grief through the power of live music. Can they find their way back home?

metas.name: Expedition X: Atomic Sharks
metas.description: The team investigates disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in the Marshall Islands, exploring whether the region's atomic past is to blame.

metas.name: Expedition Unknown: Shark Secrets
metas.description: Josh Gates explores Scotland's Stronsay Beast, the earliest known shark attack and how the USS Indianapolis led to history's deadliest attack.

metas.name: Alien Sharks: Untamed America
metas.description: Forrest Galante explores America's strangest alien sharks in celebration of the nation's 250th anniversary.

metas.name: God Hunter
metas.description: In a world where beings from myth and folklore have entered our realm, an undercover cop infiltrates a trafficking ring that smuggles and sells these beings to find his son.

metas.name: In Memory Of Tommy Tiger
metas.description: Washed-up cereal spokesman Tommy Tiger wastes his hours with a cocktail of whippets, whiskey, and cheap beer. A memory of his father hurdles him into a crushing downward spiral.

metas.name: Jess Elgene: Less of a Man
metas.description: Jess Elgene's debut special, LESS OF A MAN, was recorded live at Caveat in New York City on March 6, 2024 and features the original songs "Katarina," "Food Court," "Body // Feelings," "The Devil," "Small Talk," and "Undeniably." The special covers a range of topics including gender identity, body image, and acceptance. Elgene is "totally charismatic and engrossing," and LESS OF A MAN boasts "some of the very best of storytelling-comedy at the Fringe this year." -- Binge Fringe Magazine

metas.name: The Chorus of Tongues
metas.description: An ecologist, tasked with recording frogsong and surveying species presence, comes face to face with local extinction when the voices of the bog go quiet one by one.

metas.name: The Curse of the Rosetta Stone
metas.description: Three best friends go on a quest to find the Rosetta Stone!

metas.name: Chum Island: Catching a Killer
metas.description: In this Shark Week whodunnit, a rare surge of highly aggressive shark attacks hit a tight-knit community off Australia’s southern coast, prompting marine biologist Riley Elliott to find and tag the oceanic suspects. But when he discovers this could be a new, elusive population of sharks, he builds the world's first "chum island" to lure them in and uncover if they are the ones responsible for the attacks.

metas.name: Jaws vs. Orca
metas.description: This special investigates the chilling phenomenon of great white sharks washing ashore with their livers extracted with surgical precision. To decode the orca's "kill sequence," the team travels to the Strait of Gibraltar, where orcas have developed a highly organized tactic of ramming sailboats, crippling rudders, and even sinking vessels.

metas.name: Jurassic Sharks
metas.description: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

metas.name: Winky's Speakeasy
metas.description: Booze, banter and boings. Welcome to the saloon for washed-up cartoons.

metas.name: RESET
metas.description: In a world where citizens are reset to six at age 65, a young woman must care for her newly-reset mother and find her estranged father before the state intervenes— only to discover that healing her family means reparenting the child her mother never got to be.

metas.name: Longwood Dr.
metas.description: Introverted high schooler Devon begins to question her sanity when ominous messages start to appear around her as she tries to navigate her crumbling relationships.

metas.name: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
metas.description: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.

metas.name: Wham! 10 Days in China
metas.description: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

metas.name: The Gentleman Thief
metas.description: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

metas.name: The Country They Call Life
metas.description: A spirit must choose between life and death with only the help of a suicidal man.

metas.name: Gustloff: The Forgotten Tragedy
metas.description: A documentary-style recounting of the horrific fate of the MV Wilhelm Gustloff.

metas.name: The Last Fifteen Minutes
metas.description: While a giant monster attacks their city, the queer inhabitants of a small residential building (portrayed by hand-carved puppets) try to make their peace with imminent death — through music, sex, and lasagna.

metas.name: Pink Ounces
metas.description: A young black lesbian woman must battle the voices in her head and a charismatic artist to seal a kiss with the girl of her dreams.

metas.name: Tib Tub, We Need You!
metas.description: Three kids and their best friend Tib Tub, a 30-foot-tall robot boy, have one day left to complete the Perfect Summer Checklist. All they have left to do is go for a swim…without accidentally destroying the whole town!

metas.name: House of Sharks
metas.description: In New Zealand's waters, great white "houses" battle for dominance. Experts risk it all to reveal the bloodlines that determine their allegiances.

metas.name: Biggest Mako on Earth
metas.description: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow. A team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world.

metas.name: Bull Shark Dinner Bell
metas.description: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration.

metas.name: Call Grandma
metas.description: On a bitterly cold winter day, a young couple Lennie and Luke are on a drive to New York City to visit Lennie’s neurotic, seemingly aggressive but sweet-natured father. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: Old Fantasy
metas.description: A woman wants to be like her grandma. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: The Bowdoin Library Experiment 1972
metas.description: Recently unearthed footage from the controversial Bowdoin Library Experiment (1972) in which a simulation of a library goes awry. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: Power Lines
metas.description: A man tries to explain why he likes looking at power lines. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: Pro Se
