metas.description: Berthe, a young painter travels hills and valleys with the help of her assistant and a herd of models in search of a form of contentment unknown to us. [Overview courtesy of filmmakers]

metas.name: GEMINI
metas.description: GEMINI is a darkly comedic and intimate portrait of love, loss, and secrecy.

metas.name: Scherwitz
metas.description: Scherwitz just lost custody of his son.

metas.name: Revelation
metas.description: Three people are brought to a chapel under the impression that they will have a fortune bestowed upon them, leading to a... Revelation.

metas.name: Novel Affairs
metas.description: Stuck in the monotony of day to day life, Quinn goes on a journey through novels from her local bookstore to achieve and harbor self-acceptance.

metas.name: Emily Catalano: The Introvert
metas.description: Comedian Emily Catalano explores her personality (or lack thereof) in her stand-up special The Introvert, filmed live at The Belly Up in San Diego.

metas.name: Amerigo: The Search for the American Dream
metas.description: As the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary on July 4, 2026, AMERIGO: THE SEARCH FOR THE AMERICAN DREAM asks one urgent, unifying question – what happened to the American Dream – and explores if it is still attainable for many today. Filmed across all 50 states over two years, the program features unscripted interviews with everyday Americans, from blue-collar workers, veterans and immigrants to students, entrepreneurs and community leaders. Told in thematic chapters examining work, housing, healthcare, technology, art and more, AMERIGO captures a raw, panoramic and unexpectedly hopeful portrait of a country at a crossroads.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

metas.name: Air Jaws: Red, White and Breach
metas.description: Reports of great white sharks breaching off the California coast sparks an investigation to document the new phenomena.

metas.name: Invasion of the Mega Sharks
metas.description: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white shark believed to be one of largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

metas.name: AEW Redemption 2026: The Buy In
metas.description: Redemption 2026 was the inaugural edition of All Elite Wrestling's annual Redemption pay-per-view, held on July 26, 2026, at the Bell Centre in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. The event was co-headlined by Kenny Omega (c) vs. Kevin Knight for the AEW World Championship and Thekla (c) vs. Willow Nightingale for the AEW Women's World Championship. This is the pre-show event that aired free before the pay-per-view.

metas.name: Cinematic Nothingness
metas.description: A filmmaker embarks on an ambitious experiment: creating a feature film entirely through improvisation. As fiction and reality begin to blur, the process becomes as unpredictable as the story itself.

metas.name: K-Pop Shark Heroes
metas.description: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

metas.name: On Time
metas.description: A Man is almost late for the biggest moment of his life

metas.name: Obsession Unleashed
metas.description: Go behind the scenes with in-depth interviews featuring Curry Barker and the cast

metas.name: That Ain’t Him
metas.description: When a young man and is buddy try to set up a spooky prank for a friend, he soon realizes his buddy may not actually be whom he thinks he is after all.

metas.name: People Magazine Investigates: The Cosmic Intelligence Cult
metas.description: A deep dive into the cult and its prophet, Rashad Jamal, who established the cult during the Covid-19 pandemic

metas.name: Rooks For Crooks
metas.description: Four crooks aim to score big time with a home invasion, but complications soon set in.

metas.name: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: This three-part documentary reveals the explosive true story that inspired The Wolf of Wall Street.

metas.name: When did we start using passports?
metas.description: As the world becomes increasingly global for some, and increasingly divided for others, the question remains: Should lines on a map be what determine a person's rights and freedoms?

metas.name: REALITY
metas.description: Sam struggles trying to distinguish reality and his hallucinations

metas.name: Boring Guys
metas.description: Gary and Garry live a tedious life of TV and rigatoni. Until jealousy strikes...

metas.name: The Light of Bulgaria
metas.description: Filmed during Great Lent, Great and Holy Week, and the joyous celebration of Pascha in 2025, “The Light of Bulgaria” combines historical research, firsthand interviews, and footage from across Bulgaria to tell a story largely unknown outside that country.  Although the Old Calendar Orthodox Church of Bulgaria finally obtained legal registration after many years of efforts, recent legislative changes supported by the Patriarchate of Bulgaria have once again placed its future in jeopardy. As renewed legal efforts seek to dissolve the Church, this documentary offers an opportunity to understand both the history that led to this moment and the Faithful who continue to endure opposition.

metas.name: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
metas.description: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.

metas.name: Model Home
metas.description: A housewife in 60s America goes about her daily housework, while pining for her absent Husband.

metas.name: From Somebody That You Used To Know
metas.description: A young man has trouble finding the right greeting card for his estranged cousin.

metas.name: Angel (ii.4) PROCESS REMINISCENCE
metas.description: ANGEL PROJECTed. Companion film to ANGEL (iii).

metas.name: Son of the Soil
metas.description: Nigerian soldier Zion Ladejo, haunted by his past, returns home after his sister's tragic death. Determined to uncover those responsible, he embarks on a vengeful path, while seeking redemption for his own actions.

metas.name: The Odyssey
metas.description: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

metas.name: The Good Boy Report
metas.description: A young girl named Bunny hosts, edits and narrates a hard-hitting journalistic exposé about all the dogs in her neighborhood.

metas.name: A Walk in the Park
metas.description: A secret agent faces unexpected obstacles during a time-sensitive mission.

metas.name: All We Do Is Watch Movies
metas.description: A documentary short about Portland’s iconic Hollywood Theatre and Movie Madness video store.

metas.name: Cause of Death
metas.description: When their target dies of natural causes just hours before they arrive, two incompetent hit-men scramble to stage a convincing murder before their employer figures out they didn't do their job.

metas.name: Underbrush
metas.description: Two young boys simulate a gun battle in a lush forest, leaving one to confront his fear of real loss.

metas.name: Battle For the Bid
metas.description: Battle For The Bid is a documentary series that chronicles the journey of the Boston University men's basketball team as they attempt to reclaim a dream interrupted by the COVID-19 pandemic. Through intimate storytelling and unprecedented access, the series explores perseverance, leadership, identity and the realities of life beyond college athletics.

metas.name: Bad Cop, Bad Cop
metas.description: Bad Cop, Bad Cop is a crime comedy short film about two big-hearted police officers, Eddie and Joel, who believe they've caught the ultimate villain...or just a guy in for a parking ticket. Through their interrogation of Hunter, a guy in for a parking ticket, can they prove to the Chief that they were meant to be police officers? Or are they onto the wrong hunch?

metas.name: Bloody Nose
metas.description: A nosebleed in the bathroom sink.

metas.name: Deadly Sign-In
metas.description: When recorded audio from a murder starts playing on the speakers from an unknown device, Kate doesn’t know if it’s real or a prank.

metas.name: Minland Empire
metas.description: Ex-cons Bob and Kevin navigate the challenges of modern life when an old nemesis unexpectedly returns and threatens their retirement.

metas.name: Autosave
metas.description: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

metas.name: Glass Saints
metas.description: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

metas.name: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
metas.description: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

metas.name: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
metas.description: The story begins in March 2018, when former Russian intelligence officer Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia collapse on a park bench in Salisbury, England – a quaint, historic city where nothing normally happens. But what starts as a local incident explodes into a geopolitical crisis, which exposes the covert espionage war being raged between Russia and the West. A cinematic portrait of loyalty and betrayal and a story that resonates amid ongoing tensions with Russia, the documentary explores the collision of two men: Sergei Skripal and Vladimir Putin, the dictator determined to settle an old score by sending assassins to Salisbury armed with the deadly nerve agent Novichok.

metas.name: Chunks
metas.description: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

metas.name: Dante: 500 Miles on Psychedelics
metas.description: A man embarks on a grueling 500 mile run through the desert using psychedelics to push his physical and mental limits. While he battles his inner demons and the harsh terrain, he seeks redemption, aiming to prove that human potential is limitless and to challenge the stigma surrounding unconventional healing.

metas.name: Wedding Flowers
metas.description: A begrudgingly adept, family outcast and her overbearing mother struggle to find connection as their Vietnamese American family reunites for a wedding celebration.

metas.name: Wildman
metas.description: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

metas.name: AM/FM
metas.description: A recluse virtual DJ and his obsessive listener are pulled together by an eerie radio signal—both yearning for a connection they can’t describe.

metas.name: O Little Christmas Market
metas.description: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

metas.name: DETAIL THE HUMAN OPERA
metas.description: Ramiel is on the subway with his girlfriend when he sees someone from his past on an adjacent running train. He decides to get some closure.

metas.name: Splash City
metas.description: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

metas.name: Rosebush Pruning
metas.description: In a Spanish villa, American siblings Jack, Ed, Anna and Robert wallow in isolation and their inherited fortune. When Jack wants to move in with his girlfriend and Ed uncovers the truth about their mother’s death, the fabric of the family begins to unravel.

metas.name: Forever
metas.description: A girl recounts a fleeting summer love in a poetic memory.

metas.name: Cecilia Is Only Eight Years Old
metas.description: Cecilia is about to turn 68 and has never been creative in her life. Spurred on by her curmudgeonly and competitive best friend, she enters a talent competition.

metas.name: A Dream Like a Dream
metas.description: A man finds his soul lingering in the remnants of daily life. Unaware of his own death, he feels no particular concern for his destination. An unexpected phone call forges a brief connection to the living world—a bond as fleeting as his mortal existence, where genuine engagement always eluded him.

metas.name: A Remedy for a Dying Friend
metas.description: Jo’s friend is dying, she must find a remedy to save her.

metas.name: SOCAPA THE CAMP THE FILM THE MOVIE
metas.description: Two Camp Counselors prove they can make a movie!

metas.name: Critical Path
metas.description: Critical Path offers an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the engineering marvel that is the SpaceX Starship program. The documentary details the iterative design philosophy, the high-stakes testing, and the relentless drive to build the largest and most powerful rocket ever flown. From the first conceptual sketches to the atmospheric re-entry and landing attempts, this film chronicles the single, complex path of innovation required to make life multi-planetary.

metas.name: NOXIOUS
metas.description: Created as his HKU graduation project, Kay Hilman’s animated short film, NOXIOUS, is a haunting exploration of a world reclaimed by nature. Created in Blender with a hand-drawn illustrative style, it imagines a impressive but terrifying new lifeform that has decided to claim our planet for itself. The music and sound design by Mikael Umarov helps set the mood.

metas.name: The One Next Door
metas.description: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

metas.name: Dune Runner
metas.description: A guy needs trained in the art of dune running to defeat his rival, so he calls upon an ancient trainer to teach him...  but much stupider.

metas.name: BINIchella Week One
metas.description: The Nation's Girl Group, BINI, represents the Philippines as they take over the Mojave Stage for two weeks, becoming the first Filipino act to perform in Coachella in a high energy 45-minute set of their hit songs.

metas.name: The Sunken Sahara: ERI-TV
metas.description: Found on forgotten cassette tapes and long-lost duplicate VHS recordings, ERi-TV The Sunken Sahara airs once, on a late December night in 1998. An objective relic of the Eritrea-Ethiopia war, some call it a propaganda piece, some call it protest art, some say something deeper.  Allegedly "brainwashed" witnesses described what they saw as "magic".  The original writers and those associated with the broadcast are unknown and their words are misremembered and misheard.

metas.name: All For You
metas.description: A short film inspired by the albums Preacher’s Daughter and Willoughby Tucker, I’ll Always Love You by Ethel Cain.

metas.name: Help Wanted!
metas.description: An unclear job listing and loads of miscommunication make for a comedic interview between these three characters.

metas.name: Dread
metas.description: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

metas.name: The Night Everything Changed
metas.description: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

metas.name: Jonás
metas.description: Jonás, a teenager about to become a father, has secretly decided to escape.

metas.name: Utopia Air
metas.description: Welcome aboard Utopia Air! Please pay close attention to the following safety instructions.

metas.name: Storm
metas.description: A drifting beach ball must avoid an incoming storm.

metas.name: Flowery Voices
metas.description: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: Still Water
metas.description: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

metas.name: No Sun on Salvation
metas.description: In 1897, Penelope comes to terms with the death of her father with the help of Alabama, a hermit whose daughter is dying from the same illness.

metas.name: Rabbit on a Highway
metas.description: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.

metas.name: If You Can Make It Here
metas.description: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

metas.name: All the Queens Houses
metas.description: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

metas.name: Laundry day lovers

metas.name: The Isolate Thief
metas.description: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

metas.name: Down the Long River
metas.description: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

metas.name: The Outer Threat
metas.description: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

metas.name: Reading Lolita in Tehran
metas.description: In 1979, amidst censorship and religious extremism, a revolutionary literature professor in Tehran gathers seven of her most dedicated female students to immerse themselves in banned literary classics.

metas.name: Code for the People
metas.description: Short documentary by the makers of WordPress about the fight for the open web. Who built it, who’s trying to close it, and what you can do about it.

metas.name: Museum Misfits
metas.description: When two thieves attempt to steal a prized museum painting, their original escape attempt is ruined through a planning mistake. Now they must try to find a new exit before they get caught.

metas.name: IBS
metas.description: Andie experiences chronic digestive issues but hides it from her roommate. When she is prescribed a stool sample kit for the first time, she has to learn to take care of her health and deal with her own shit (literally and figuratively).

metas.name: Bobby Josh: Shadow Of Darkness
metas.description: When a string of mysterious disappearances shakes the city, seven friends uncover a terrifying truth—the mastermind behind the chaos is Bobby Josh, a brilliant but ruthless figure who thrives in the shadows. As Tanner Pridemore, Ian B, Lucas Galloway, Ian Stevenson, Garylee Michael Smith III, Brandon Lopez, and Gavin Latourette race to stop his deadly plan, every clue pulls them deeper into a web of deception, betrayal, and fear. With time running out and darkness closing in, they'll have to risk everything to face the man who always seems one step ahead. In the end, the greatest threat isn't what's hiding in the dark—it's who controls it.

metas.name: The Echo of You Leaving
metas.description: Every goodbye is the start of something new.

metas.name: Peace, Peace!

metas.name: The Roast of Caveh Zahedi

The roasters included the following luminaries, trouble makers, and last-minute substitutions: Yung Chomsky, Lily Lady, Christian Lorentzen, Sharon Mashihi, Peter Rinaldi, Joe Swanberg, Onur Tukel, Pacho Velez, and Joshua Z. Weinstein.

metas.name: Babesmilk
metas.description: After an ice cream outburst gets her arrested, an entitled woman grapples with the wreckage of her own behavior.

metas.name: Urchins
metas.description: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

metas.name: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
metas.description: A supervillain's plot to take over the world using a helmet that can read minds runs awry after an encounter with a man with some anxious thoughts and a secret identity.

metas.name: The Mastodon in the Room
metas.description: In memory of Brent Hinds 1974-2025

metas.name: Street of Dreams
metas.description: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

metas.name: I DON'T WANT TO HURT THINGS
metas.description: An experimental short film born out of long nights spent somewhere else.

metas.name: Project Hellgate
metas.description: A group of journalists travel to Oregon after receiving an email from somebody claiming to be Reece Commo.

metas.name: Where the Horses Heal the Soul
metas.description: Children, adults, and veterans discover hope and healing through the powerful human-horse connection at ROCK Ride On Center for Kids, a Texas nonprofit providing equine-assisted services. In the arena, uncertainty gives way to confidence, walls begin to come down, and participants living with physical, cognitive, and emotional challenges find courage, purpose, and possibility.  Through the rhythm of riding and the quiet presence of horses, breakthroughs unfold one session, one connection, and one transformed life at a time. Where the Horses Heal the Soul is a moving documentary about the extraordinary power of the human-horse bond to open a path forward and reveal the potential within each person.

metas.name: Tamsyn Kelly: Hot Titty Bungalow
metas.description: Tamsyn Kelly brings sharp wit and wonderfully awkward storytelling to the stage in this hilarious stand-up performance about big life choices, messy relationships, and starting over in a new city. After impulsively moving from Cornwall to Glasgow for love, she quickly discovers that major decisions don’t always come with major planning.  Blending self-deprecating humor with clever observations, Tamsyn dives into long-distance dating, family dynamics, modern friendships, and the strange realities of adapting to a completely different culture. From awkward encounters with exes to bizarre local experiences and questionable attempts at self-discovery, every story is packed with relatable chaos and unexpected punchlines.  Warm, quirky, and brutally honest, this set showcases Tamsyn Kelly’s unique comedic voice as she turns life’s uncertainties into laugh-out-loud comedy.

metas.name: Before America
metas.description: Before America is a cinematic documentary uncovering the Indigenous histories of Michigan long before the United States existed. From the 1763 uprising at Fort Michilimackinac to Odawa trail trees and the overlooked women of Fort Detroit, the film reveals how Anishinaabe nations shaped Great Lakes history and helped spark the chain of events that ultimately pushed the American colonies.

metas.name: The Double Take
metas.description: Proof of concept

metas.name: before Pablo
metas.description: A series of 1990s events documented through old VHS footage, documenting the lives of people before the year 2004.

metas.name: MASK: REBIRTH
metas.description: A return to form for the series finds Noah and Brennen experiencing odd dreams once again. But this time, things are different.

metas.name: Judgment Day

metas.name: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You

metas.name: The War Game at Cinecity
metas.description: When Peter Watkins’ banned nuclear war masterpiece "The War Game" reached Toronto in 1967, it found an unlikely home at Cinecity, a new cinema determined to challenge audiences. Drawing on archival research and eyewitness accounts, this documentary explores the film’s enduring impact and the role Cinecity played in shaping Canadian film culture.

metas.name: Best Boy
metas.description: After the death of their abusive and tyrannic father, three children – now adults – and their aging mother return to their long-abandoned summer cottage. They will have to partake in a strange competition that tore their family apart 30 years prior – a nightmarish return to the past for the family's children.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

metas.name: Attack of the Samurai Sharks
metas.description: A 3,000-year-old cold case could be the earliest known victim of a shark attack. The skeleton, found in Japan, is covered in unusually deep cut marks. It looks like the victim of a frenzied samurai sword attack, but could his wounds have been caused by a shark? If so, which species of shark is the prime suspect? Shark experts Alyssa White, Gavin Naylor, Kirin Sekito and Masato Nakatsukasa investigate.

metas.name: INDIGO

metas.name: Great White Gauntlet

metas.name: Delirium

metas.name: The Death of a Forehead
metas.description: The end cycle of the birthed forehead.

metas.name: Crossroads
metas.description: A man attempts to cross the street before his time.

metas.name: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

metas.name: MISERY
metas.description: A rideshare driver holding his life together by a thread carries one stranger after another through an unraveling night, each too consumed by their own lives to notice his, as he tries to make it back to his son.

metas.name: Andrea Gibson: Love Letter from the Afterlife
metas.description: Andrea Gibson's final performance brought to film.

metas.name: This is George and Monty
metas.description: This outrageous marketing parody film guides viewers through the rise and fall of George and Monty, who manage to captivate audiences in all the wrong ways.  An unpredictable internet and commercial sensation, George and Monty lack any discernable talent or intelligence, and nothing about them makes any sense.  In this absurd "documentary," they carelessly wield the power of the camera with catastrophic results in their absurd workplace training videos, alternative advertising campaigns, dating websites, connections to North Korea, multiple branding fails, re-editing of major motion pictures, and seemingly ruining the lives of everyone they touch (well no, not like that).  In a world where appearance supersedes reality, you won’t know what’s real or fake.  The story of George and Monty needed to be told but nobody is sure why – they still don’t make any sense – none of this makes any sense!

The movie moves between the polished travel segments they are trying to create and the messy reality of actually making them. At the center is a clueless Swiss-Italian travel host whose confidence only makes every misunderstanding bigger. What begins as a simple travel program slowly turns into a comedy about the trip, the show, and the disaster of making both.

Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. The two men announced from the Oval Office that Saudi Arabia planned to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in the U.S.FRONTLINE's new documentary "The Crown Prince & the President" draws on over 100 interviews to investigate what forces bind the two men and their countries together, and what each stands to gain.

metas.description: Aspiring auteur director John tries to get his overly ambitious script turned into a real film.

metas.name: Hope is Hip
metas.description: In a seaside town, a group of young skateboarders finds themselves in a feud with a neighbor when their local skatepark is threatened with closure.

metas.name: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
metas.description: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

metas.name: Source Connection
metas.description: When an investigative reporter shows up to meet her source, he proves reticent at first, but then gives the information she's looking for. Together they're working to uncover the ills of the city.

metas.name: Bitter Revenge
metas.description: Esme pretends to fall for the man responsible for the loss of her sister in an attempt to take revenge on his family at their upcoming reunion. But this plan takes a grisly turn for the worse as Esme discovers the family's darkest secrets.

metas.name: Promises
metas.description: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

metas.name: A Crime Story
metas.description: A group of misfits employed at a rundown motel stumble upon a drug trafficking operation orchestrated by a powerful crime syndicate, thrusting them into a perilous situation.

metas.name: Blurred
metas.description: On the surface, everything is just as Clive remembers - the home, the warmth, and the love. However, as subtle details slip out of place, Clive begins to question what is real and what he is trying to forget.

metas.name: Isla Monstro
metas.description: When loser Duke, who has screwed up every hair-brained scheme he's ever come up with, accidentally falls off a cruise ship and wakes up on a mysteriously abandoned, top secret government island, he discovers that it's overrun with mutants and monsters from a failed 1980s DARPA "super soldier" project to stop the 2nd Cold War.

metas.name: Lethal Contract
metas.description: When two worlds collide, two rival assassins are given the same target. And what starts as a routine hit becomes a fight to the death.

metas.name: Morristown: A Tale As Old As Time
metas.description: Celebrating the people, places, and stories of our community.. Morristown: A Tale as Old as Time is a community documentary celebrating the history, people, and enduring spirit of Morristown, Vermont. Through personal interviews with longtime residents, local leaders, and community members, the film preserves the stories, traditions, and memories that have shaped the town across generations. Blending heartfelt storytelling with the landscapes and landmarks of Lamoille County, the documentary offers an intimate portrait of a rural Vermont community and the people who continue to define its character and legacy.

metas.name: Under The Lights
metas.description: On July 4th, two young women finally find themselves alone beneath the glow of fireworks and string lights. What begins as an ordinary evening of shared silences, stolen glances and unfinished conversations slowly becomes a turning point, forcing them to confront the feelings they've both hidden for far too long. As dawn approaches and life threatens to pull them in opposite directions, they must decide whether some connections are meant to remain beautiful memories or whether love is worth the risk of changing everything.

metas.name: PRODUCE: Volume 1
metas.description: PRODUCE celebrates the minds, bodies, and creative spirit of professional wrestlers. It’s wrestling that celebrates the talent, curated for fans who know ball, and those who’d like to learn—or learn to love it.  For this edition, PRODUCE features SUPERFIGHT, a headlining match between Jonathan Gresham and Fuminori Abe, plus appearances by Joey Janela, Effy, LaBron Kozone, Mance Warner, Steph de Lander, Man Like Dereiss, AEW Women’s Pure Champion Deonna Purrazzo, “Hot Sauce” Tracy Williams, Mad Dog Connelly, and many more.  PRODUCE is presented by Orange Crush, and co-produced by Jonathan Gresham.

metas.name: REVIVER
metas.description: REVIVER is an independent experimental short film that blends psychological drama with surreal storytelling to explore identity, redemption, and the consequences of our choices.

metas.name: I'm At Home
metas.description: She sleeps,  she leaves,  she cries, she uses her cellphone.

metas.name: Beneath the Mask
metas.description: A teenage streamer's dialy life conflicts with the masked version of himself.

metas.name: The Final Bliss
metas.description: a man is preparing to get revenge on the people who have wronged him throughout his life but along the way he comes to a realization that changes everything.

metas.name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu
metas.description: Eli Manning recruits WNBA superstar Sabrina Ionescu to go undercover at her alma mater, the University of Oregon. Sabrina transforms into Jennifer Scone, an enthusiastic Ducks fan who's attending her first basketball game. She fools coaches, mingles with fans, and shocks the crowd at halftime.

metas.name: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness
metas.description: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.

metas.name: Wuertz' Pub
metas.description: An influencer walks into a bar.

metas.name: Austen's Least Romantic
metas.description: Convinced that Jane Austen wrote a love story for every scenario, a Darcy-obsessed woman must do everything in her power to prove her theory wrong when she finds out her story might be Northanger Abbey—Austen's least romantic novel.

metas.name: Declarations: Black Americans and the Revolutionary War
metas.description: When the Declaration of Independence was signed 250 years ago, the Founders – many of whom were slaveholders – declared: “all men are created equal.” As their aspirational words and ideals of freedom were signed into existence and spread throughout the colonies, Black people recognized that these ideas included them. DECLARATIONS: BLACK AMERICANS AND THE REVOLUTIONARY WAR examines how they fought for these tenets of democracy for themselves, their families, and their communities. The film features insights from historians and scholars including Leslie Alexander, Danielle Allen, Edward Ayers, Christopher L. Brown, Woody Holton, and others.

metas.name: The Odyssey: The Real Story
metas.description: After the fall of Troy, warrior-king Odysseus begins a perilous voyage home, only to be thrown into a decade of wandering across a world ruled by gods and monsters. He outwits cyclopes, resists enchantresses, and descends into the realm of the dead, while his family fights to survive in his absence.

metas.name: Corps Man
metas.description: The untold true story of Mexican-American combat corpsman Dave Lara, and his band of brothers known as The Group, who kept the biggest secret of the Vietnam War. For the first time on film, Dave Lara tells his story of how he and The Group navigated a hostile society and military as gay men at a time when it was criminal to be themselves.

metas.name: Orevwa
metas.description: In Orevwa — Haitian Creole for “goodbye” or “until we meet again”  EJ, a young gay Haitian American barista from South L.A., is doing everything he can to care for his ailing grandmother while keeping his own dreams alive. Searching for stability, he enrolls in a CNA program, where he meets Jordan, his confident and irresistibly charming instructor. As sparks fly between them, EJ must navigate the pull between love, duty, and self-discovery.  Orevwa is a heartfelt, romantic dramedy about saying goodbye to who we were and daring to embrace who we’re becoming

metas.name: A Super Progressive Movie
metas.description: Melbourne is the last bastion of "The Progressives," a society shielded from the outside world by a glowing rainbow "virtue signal." When the shield begins to fail, an Aboriginal elder named Murray reveals the truth: the culture war was lost long ago, and only the legendary Victimhood can save them. Tasked with retrieving it is Pete, a downtrodden white man treated as the lowest rung of society. Joined by Murray, the vain Princess Stacey, and Social Justice Warrior Lance, Pete ventures into the "real" Australia for the first time, discovering it's nothing like he was told — while Prime Minister Pauline Hanson races to reach the weapon first.

metas.name: Dance Gavin Dance: The Pantheon Live from Anaheim
metas.description: Watch Dance Gavin Dance perform at their sold out show live from the House of Blues Anaheim on The Pantheon Tour.

metas.name: Trapped With Two Monsters
metas.description: Locked inside with no way out, two sisters must face a terrifying presence stalking their home while their father is away at work. As the night grows darker and longer, the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Secret stalkers are hiding in the darkness, but the true identity of the "monsters" is far more terrifying than they ever imagined.

metas.name: Tiny Doll House
metas.description: The film explores the unique NYC-store Tiny Doll House, and follows its owner Leslie Edelman on a summer day at the shop.

metas.name: The Man From Bristol: Ralph Bates Remembered
metas.description: Documentary on the career of actor Ralph Bates.

metas.name: Joan Collins: Queen Of The Horror Films
metas.description: Documentary on Joan Collins and her career in horror films.

metas.name: Hammer and Beyond: The Jimmy Sangster Legacy
metas.description: Documentary from Hammer Historian Marcus Hearn tracking the career of director Jimmy Sangster.

metas.name: Evel: America's Daredevil
metas.description: Mike O'Hara takes a high-octane trip down memory lane, honoring what was once the greatest event on television: Evel Knievel.

metas.name: Estados Unidos: 250 Un País de Inmigrantes
metas.description: The history of the United States cannot be told without Latinos. From independence to the present day, they have helped build, defend, and transform this nation. This Special from Noticias Telemundo highlights the legacy of a community that has left an indelible mark on the country's history.

metas.name: Management is Killing Me
metas.description: The debut short film from Trifecta Studios

metas.name: Hindsight Services
metas.description: A young couple try to save their marriage after being delivered a file from the future detailing their impending divorce.

metas.name: Where Are You Hailey?
metas.description: A man struggling with alcohol, cigarette, and Fortnite addiction waits for his fiance to come home. But what day will she be back?

metas.name: Wilma, Wu, and a Stripper Named Lorraine
metas.description: When a beloved desert cantina is threatened with closure, a washed-up burlesque dancer rallies an outrageous crew of misfits, church ladies, hustlers, and dreamers for one last talent show to save their town. As chaos turns to community, a feuding mother and daughter must decide whether to hold on or finally let go. ​

metas.name: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026: Buy-In
metas.description: The Buy-In served as the pre-show for All Elite Wrestling's 2026 Forbidden Door event.

metas.name: The Heir
metas.description: A grieving granddaughter inherits her grandmother’s home in a gentrifying D.C. neighborhood, where family tensions and generational scars force her to choose between preserving tradition or redefining legacy.

metas.name: S.O.S.
metas.description: Ambitious real estate agent Evan has always been at war with seasonal allergies—but this spring, as pollen counts soar, his sales tank at the worst possible time: just months before his wedding. Desperate for a solution, he crosses paths with a mysterious street vendor, the Rapper S.O.S., who claims to have the cure. But at what cost?

metas.name: Phrenia
metas.description: Prakash, a painter returns to his studio after 200 days of sobriety. Haunted by a blank canvas that seems to follow him everywhere, he confronts fear, doubt, and the thin line between reality and imagination.

metas.name: Tattoo Medicine
metas.description: Tattoo Medicine explores Pili's path as a brown indigenous Colombian person from the Muisca & Pijao people, highlighting the intersection of ancestral spirituality and healing in his tattoo practice. From his childhood struggles in Miami to being a resident artist at Fruit Camp, the most prominent queer-tattoo shop in Baltimore, the documentary delves into the challenges and triumphs of forging a unique, culturally rooted career in the world of tattooing.

metas.name: Kil and the Kids
metas.description: In Southeast D.C., a mentor named Kil supports youth through Horton’s Kids while coping with the loss of one to gun violence. When another teen is robbed at gunpoint, Kil helps him process the trauma through art and expression, revealing how showing up can transform pain into resilience.

metas.name: One Two Three
metas.description: A little girl is alone at home with her bird, suddenly they see something and call the social emergency and report the child being hurt....

metas.name: remain in light
metas.description: a love letter to the susquehanna and the passage of time

metas.name: NXT The Great American Bash 2026
metas.description: The 2026 NXT The Great American Bash, also promoted as NXT The Great American Bash: Orlando, is a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 14th Great American Bash under the WWE banner, the seventh annual produced specifically for its developmental brand NXT, and the 28th Great American Bash event overall.

metas.name: TNA Slammiversary 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Slammiversary is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on June 28, 2026, at the Agganis Arena in Boston, Massachusetts. It will be the 22nd event under the Slammiversary chronology, and will celebrate the promotion's 24th anniversary.

metas.name: No Shit, Sherlock!
metas.description: A murder has been committed and a detective is on the case... one of them, at least.

metas.name: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Forbidden Door was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and supershow co-produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW), Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and the Japanese promotions New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the fifth annual Forbidden Door event and took place on June 28, 2026 at SAP Center at San Jose in San Jose, California, USA.

metas.name: Typed Out
metas.description: Lydia cannot rest. Days are counting down to a deadline she cannot miss. With each moment that passes the wall she built to protect herself from the world crumbles. But, sometimes, when walls collapse, it lets the light shine through.

metas.name: Souvenir
metas.description: A chance encounter between old friends Kevin and Dani leads to an unexpected day-long adventure through New York City as they attempt to return a stranger’s lost wallet, forcing them to confront unresolved feelings and life-changing decisions.

metas.name: Stan Lee: The Final Chapter
metas.description: An insider look at Stan Lee's tumultuous final years, revealing how mistreatment and conflict threatened his life and legacy.

metas.name: Pallbearers
metas.description: An experimental personal documentary that follows the literal and emotional journey of the director and their best friend Phoebe Ferguson as they travel to see her mother’s grave for the first time in her life. Traveling by plane, car, and train from Portland, Oregon to Dublin, Texas, the film follows their ten day journey to reunite mother and daughter.

metas.name: Don't Puke
metas.description: A partygoer must find her way home without puking. Along the way, she encounters numerous hurdles that will challenge her self-control to the utmost.

metas.name: Unseen
metas.description: George, a withdrawn young artist who expresses his emotions through his art, struggles to connect with his blind mother until a sudden medical crisis forces him to confront the love and grief he's kept hidden for years.

metas.name: I'm the Main Character
metas.description: When everyone thinks they're the main character, is anyone? It depends who you ask, and how compelling their theme song is.

metas.name: Unbreakable Me - The Gabrielle Daleman Story
metas.description: This inspiring documentary follows Gabrielle Daleman, two-time Canadian champion and 2018 Olympic gold medalist, as she battles injuries, illness, bullying, and mental health struggles. Beyond the medals and spotlight, she faces adversity with courage and grit, rising again and again to prove that her greatest strength isn't just on the ice - it's in her unbreakable spirit.

metas.name: Phenomena
metas.description: In a world that welcomes mysterious lights in their skies with caution and awe, two friends navigate their changing relationship.

metas.name: Single Black Tenant
metas.description: Esme finally believes her luck has turned after landing an affordable apartment in a quiet neighborhood. But her relief quickly gives way to fear when she begins to suspect she's living with a killer who is trying to frame her for murder.

metas.name: Threading The American Dream
metas.description: A Nepali immigrant entrepreneur's fight to change Mississippi State Law.

metas.name: Perfectly Seasoned
metas.description: Bikram, a longtime chef and confirmed bachelor, runs his restaurant with heart and discipline. But when his niece and two meddling Aunties host a speed-dating night there, his world is thrown into comedic chaos— blending family pressure, unexpected romance, and the perfect dash of second chances.

metas.name: Have A Good One
metas.description: Misha lives up to the expectations of her parents in India while hiding the challenging reality of her life as an immigrant.

metas.name: New Trees
metas.description: An exploration of commercial trees.

metas.name: WWE Night of Champions 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Night of Champions, also promoted as Night of Champions: Riyadh, was a professional wrestling premium live event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on June 27, 2026, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event featured the finals of the 2026 King and Queen of the Ring tournaments, along with championship matches for the WWE United States Championship and WWE Women's United States Championship. It was headlined by an Undisputed WWE Championship Triple Threat match between champion Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, and Gunther.

metas.name: Crystal Blue
metas.description: An assassin becomes entangled with a relaxed crime boss and a paranoid drug runner.

metas.name: mud ritual
metas.description: In the summer of 2024, filmmaker and artist Janne Elens retreats to rural Sweden, where she stays on a permaculture farm that, years prior, had served as a sanctuary after she had escaped a dangerous situation. After years of trauma processing, she now decides to close this chapter of humiliation and suffering, on the land that had carried her so dearly while the residue of this traumatic event lingered on her body. This mud ritual arose from a spontaneous urge to give herself deep cleansing, and in doing so, return all the filth and the dirt inflicted upon her back to the Earth.

metas.name: The Impossible Dream
metas.description: The Impossible Dream follows the stories of American citizens from around the nation, approaching the 250th anniversary of America. They explore what it means to be American while overcoming their unique challenges, acting out of the responsibility that they can - and must - follow the American Dream to build a future for coming generations. From ranchers to coffee shop owners, they show that the hope and beliefs that built this nation are still alive today. In this land of opportunity, through hard work and God's help, nothing is impossible.

metas.name: A Decent Citizen
metas.description: A secret agent working for the regime faces a test that calls her convictions and loyalty into question.

metas.name: Deuce Purgatory
metas.description: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

metas.name: Jia
metas.description: In the haze of a California summer, two best friends must reckon with their feelings for one another.

metas.name: Beneath the Blue Ice
metas.description: Tasha, a college student, finds herself caught between Layson, a devoted hockey player who loves her, and Aaron, who is only using her. As loyalties are tested on and off the ice, she has to decide who truly has her heart.

metas.name: Poachers
metas.description: A story of a babysitter, trying to bang a smoke show cougar. JUST LIKE ALL OF US. He gets deep into detective work to find the cougars missing baby.

metas.name: The Kalgan Horse
metas.description: In the borderlands of farming and herding in northern China, a Mongolian horse awaits the fate of castration, while a 10-year-old boy, determined to protect it, must confront violence and cruelty beyond his understanding.

metas.name: The Price of Mari Anne
metas.description: When a college student suddenly drops dead on a walk home from the bar, three young men must decide between reporting the body or fleeing the scene. Their choices quickly unravel undesirable consequences.

metas.name: Girl From Nepal
metas.description: A girl from Nepal, Hema, comes to Kyrgyzstan and finds Kairat to give him a letter from her mother Uma. From the letter we learn that they met 40 years ago when Kairat mistook Uma for the Indian actress Hema Malini.

metas.name: The Goose That Laid the Golden Egg
metas.description: When a psychiatrist discovers that a medication for the treatment of acne is causing teenagers to kill themselves, the pharmaceutical company sets out on a campaign to destroy the source of the threat to their billion-dollar-a-year drug.

metas.name: A Castle of Our Own
metas.description: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

metas.name: Hamilton House
metas.description: A home of struggling actors will stop at nothing to create a haunted house to catch the eye of their new neighbor, a legendary horror filmmaker.

metas.name: Beneath the Ashes: The Past Reimagined
metas.description: For generations, Altadena stood as a beacon of hope. While neighboring Pasadena enforced redlining policies that kept Black families from owning homes, Altadena welcomed them with open arms. Here, African American families could finally put down roots, build equity, and pass something meaningful to the next generation. That legacy-decades in the making-now hangs in the balance. Beneath the Ashes shares the voices of those who lived it: homeowners who lost everything, renters searching for stability, business owners rebuilding from scratch, and community leaders fighting to preserve what took generations to create. Through intimate conversations and powerful storytelling, the film reveals both the pain of loss and an inspiring vision for what comes next.

metas.name: American Flake
metas.description: A small-town drug dealer avoids grieving the death of his mom by searching for a lost bag of his favorite potato chips.

metas.name: Have You Seen My Gods?
metas.description: Amitabh sets out to locate the stolen gods of Kathmandu fulfilling his grandmother’s final wish.

metas.name: Mind Games
metas.description: An unsettled therapist individually counsels both members of a troubled couple, becoming dangerously entangled in their relationship, to the point of her complete family uprooting.

metas.name: SYNC
metas.description: In the near future, a grieving man turns to groundbreaking technology to reunite with an AI generated version of his deceased fiancé, but as he delves deeper into their virtual encounters, he notices something is off with her programming.

metas.name: O Block: The Movie
metas.description: An action packed and dramatic film covering the tragedy of O block and the deadly corruption ruled by Lil' Curtis

metas.name: Space Coast Confidential
metas.description: A veteran detective is paired with a transplant detective from Massachusetts to investigate strange occurrences in Cocoa Beach.

metas.name: Choosing Violence: The Skin Graph & Gnarl Weekend Tour
metas.description: Skin Graph is a powerviolence band currently split between Tupelo and Starkville while Gnarl is a project from Starkville that can only be described as a violent form of drone metal, and in January of 2026, two bands set out on a short weekend tour through the scenes of deepest of the deep south.

metas.name: A Little R&R
metas.description: Five career criminals with cryptic pasts are forced into a deadly game of Russian roulette where only one will survive, and nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit: Live at Radio City Music Hall
metas.description: Relive Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit’s February 2026 performance at the iconic Radio City Music Hall in NYC.

metas.name: Cinnamon Girl
metas.description: Two friends film an audition tape for the new season of Love Island.

metas.name: A Broken Man
metas.description: A man vents about his unraveling life to his best friend, unaware that the truth of their conversation extends far beyond his own perspective.

metas.name: Hot Girl Summer
metas.description: Four besties graduating high school and heading into the perfect summer discover that growing up means life doesn’t always go according to plan.

metas.name: Worry Bird
metas.description: A friend comes over after a breakup, but things are not as they seem.

metas.name: I'm Just Like You (And It Sucks)
metas.description: In Edy Modica’s debut comedy special, she discusses her longing for human connection and all of the ways she’s contorted herself in search of it.

metas.name: Visitors of the Unknown
metas.description: When an experimental NASA probe crash-lands in their backyard, two siblings find themselves at the center of an extraordinary encounter with the unknown.

metas.name: Soliga Hälsningar
metas.description: A documentary following Lena Emmertz, a retired woman living in Malmö, Sweden.

metas.name: The Diner
metas.description: After taking her supposed last customer, two men in suits come into the diner. All they ask for is one burger; however, for some reason, Samantha feels uneasy around these two men. But why?

metas.name: There's a Dark Corner in My Room
metas.description: A young woman deals with a traumatic event and a sinister corner in her bedroom.

metas.name: MACARONS
metas.description: Crime-Comedy Short Film

metas.name: The Woman with Three Husbands
metas.description: Concerned her impressionable brother has joined an isolated polyamorous family, Natalie investigates her new 'in-laws'. The strange death of one of Marcus's fellow 'brother husbands' leads Natalie to realize her brother is living with a killer

metas.name: FunBoy
metas.description: A teen with a guilty conscience films his family vacation, but after finding a hidden gun during a game of hide-and-seek, paranoia begins to take hold.

metas.name: The Myth of Sissypants
metas.description: An updated version of the Greek story of Sisyphus told through narrative video with live score by the artist himself.

metas.name: The Inevitable Destruction of the World by Natural Occurrence
metas.description: An experimental narrative video about a naive wayfarer encountering different paranormal phenomena embedded in the natural landscape, all while a meteor descends fatally closer to the surface of the Earth.

metas.name: Pickles
metas.description: A man struggles to open a pickle jar

metas.name: RokuGatsu
metas.description: 晴れた日を待ち望む中で、  若い女性は雨の多い春の美しさに気づく。  While longing for a sunny day, a woman learns to appreciate the beauty of a rainy spring.

metas.name: Peppa the Great
metas.description: A hustling entertainer puts her past behind her and will do anything to make it in New York City.

metas.name: The Reality Experiment
metas.description: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

metas.name: Train Window Visions
metas.description: A daily commute on the Chicago Brown Line transformed into a dissociative stream of flickering, ephemeral images.

metas.name: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert
metas.description: Follows Paul Simon performing his GRAMMY-nominated "Seven Psalms" live for the first time, featuring new arrangements of classics and deep cuts. Recorded at McCaw Hall in Seattle.

metas.name: Wendy
metas.description: What if Neverland was all in Wendy's imagination? She gazes at the birds flying and wishes she could too. She meets and makes fast friends with a mysterious boy who shares her affinity for adventure. A stick becomes a sword, a sheet becomes a sail, and a cynical old farmer with a hooked cane becomes a pirate.

metas.name: Veil
metas.description: This debut experimental short film features a young woman trapped in the Midwest, and explores her views on life, and how she is perceived.

metas.name: Eyes I
metas.description: A set of eyes of several women.

metas.name: High Voltage
metas.description: Over the course of a single night in the Far Rockaways, two teenage girls drift toward an intimacy that neither can fully name, blurring the line between friendship and desire.

metas.name: Fennel
metas.description: During a tense lunch, a father and son struggle to connect. Fennel is a quiet, intimate look at the emotional distance between parent and child and the words left unsaid.

metas.name: The Saturn Code
metas.description: When a kid is assigned a conspiracy theory project, he goes in too deep to a conspiracy about Saturn, forever changing his life.

metas.name: Between Calls
metas.description: Lio, a young man in his twenties, lives a hectic life in the business world In a quiet moment, Lio lets go of his urgency and discovers that sometimes a simple pause can hold more value than the next urgent call.

metas.name: Dave vs. Hollywood
metas.description: Dave is an actor who moves to Los Angeles, completely devoid of connections and contacts. The humiliations and indignities soon pile up. After a fruitless struggle, Dave decides to make his mark by taking a non-traditional, unorthodox, 'anything goes' approach — he joins AA for connections; joins Scientology to network; considers donating a kidney to an aging movie star in exchange for a role in said aging star’s film; leaves his headshot and reel on the windshields of vehicles outside the Brentwood church where a funeral for a studio executive is taking place, etc.

metas.name: The Chair
metas.description: A short animated film exploring the complex relationship between a little girl, Piku, and her grandfather’s old vintage armchair.

metas.name: A Stab At Heaven
metas.description: A true story of an 18-year-old Ema McKie who, after receiving news that her fiancé has committed suicide, drives across the country to join him in death, losing her mind to find her truth and journey home.

metas.name: S·G·N·A·L
metas.description: A young PlayView channel owner, dedicated to preserving and digitizing archived television footage across the United States, discovers a mysterious DVD containing recordings of a signal hijacking incident from 2007. The broadcast, once belonging to a Mexican television channel that aired in California, reveals a disruption that was never officially explained.

metas.name: Eclogues
metas.description: Landscapes are permeable, impermanent. They are hallucinations of literature, manifestations of human manipulation. Like the pixel, they are degraded, rearranged, forgotten. “Eclogues” is an expression of landscape in the purest principles of digital image-making: duration, practicality, limitation. Shot in 2020 in Strafford, Vermont.

metas.name: The Perfect Shot
metas.description: A hit man and photographer meet in a bar and discover they're both in town to shoot the president.

metas.name: Before I Do
metas.description: A lakeside bachelor party weekend devolves into chaos when the groom and his best man’s past romantic feelings reignite, entangling the wedding party in the pre-wedding drama.

metas.name: Satisfaction Guaranteed
metas.description: Marcus, a customer service agent whose job is to help anyone with anything with the aid of Assist-O, a hyper-efficient AI assistant. When the tasks become increasingly bizarre and Assist-O starts taking things too far, Marcus struggles to maintain control, revealing the chaos and absurdity lurking behind the promise of perfect service.

metas.name: Lucky Strike
metas.description: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

metas.name: Red Flag
metas.description: A newly-single woman, just out of a dysfunctional relationship, is introduced to the concept of red flags, but takes it a bit too literally as she heads back into dating.

metas.name: The Get Out
metas.description: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.

metas.name: IMPACT x Nightline: The Girl in the Trunk
metas.description: A 14-year-old girl and the rising music star D4vd are involved in a mysterious disappearance turned gruesome murder. David Anthony Burke, known as D4vd, got his start as a gamer and was on the verge of stardom. New details have emerged from text messages, photos and DNA that authorities say destroyed two lives.

metas.name: Umuganda
metas.description: Communities in Rwanda have come together every last Saturday of month since the 11th century to build, clean, and plant.

metas.name: For Your Future Wife
metas.description: After leaving an aggressive voicemail post-breakup, a young man moves on to find the beauty in a new relationship while his ex-girlfriend struggles to find a new path after his abuse.

metas.name: Silent Retreat
metas.description: Two men arrive at a silent Buddhist meditation retreat expecting stillness. In the quiet, they begin to reveal who they really are.

metas.name: Alaska
metas.description: Seraphim journeys to Alaska, the most beautiful place in this child's mind's eye.

metas.name: Supergirl
metas.description: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

metas.name: Jackass: Best and Last
metas.description: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

metas.name: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
metas.description: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.

metas.name: Tarfu Bravo Zulu
metas.description: At a lonely outpost on the coast of nowhere, two soldiers of sorts stand guard against civilization.  Or for it — sorry, yeah, for it?

metas.name: Star Spangled Adventures - The Movie!
metas.description: When Liberty the Eagle attempts to chronicle independence in America, she is quickly confronted by Tyrannus, a Crow determined to create oppression in the New Land. Will this fledgling nation fall into tyranny, or achieve freedom for all?

metas.name: Quantum Entangled
metas.description: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

metas.name: Separate Roads
metas.description: When former high school sweethearts Daniel and Tyler meet again years after a painful breakup, they're forced to confront the scars of their past - including Tyler's attempt to 'cure' his love through conversion therapy. They try to bury the hatchet and find closure, but old wounds may be too deep to heal.

metas.name: Red Rock Ranch
metas.description: Cyrus Briggs wakes up in a different reality one day and soon discovers the truth behind this "perfect" world.

metas.name: Superfan No. 1
metas.description: In Superfan No. 1, a seven-year-old South Asian girl is about to discover a massive secret about her hero, her father.

metas.name: Flow
metas.description: In Flow, a Chinese American young woman navigates lifelong pressure and expectations, working out what it means to live on her own timeline.

metas.name: Poop On My Lawn
metas.description: A young woman becomes obsessed with finding the culprit of the dog poop on her lawn as a way to avoid confronting the realities of her sick sister.

metas.name: Sheesh, A Taylor Love Story
metas.description: Follows Mac Coronel, a call center agent by day and drag performer by night, whose viral Taylor Swift–inspired performances transform malls and plazas across Manila into sanctuaries of joy and belonging.

metas.name: Plumped
metas.description: An honest, direct-to-camera survey film in which women speak candidly about their experiences with lip filler.

metas.name: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
metas.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

metas.name: An Act of Love
metas.description: ﻿Imagine you have discovered that your husband is not straight, but actually bisexual; however, instead of feeling betrayed or hurt, you decide to open the marriage by adding another man to the mix? Molly, David’s wife, comes to this very realization, and as An Act of Love, she is helping their love grow stronger rather than dividing them.

metas.name: Inevitably Alone
metas.description: When a grieving father is diagnosed with terminal cancer, his desperate attempts to reconnect with his estranged sons force them all to confront the weight of loss, love, and the inevitability of being left behind.

metas.name: Before Me
metas.description: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.

metas.name: Pomodoro
metas.description: Two aspiring sibling chefs scramble to prepare an elaborate dinner to prove themselves to their harsh food critic mother. As the night unfolds, their talent and ambition shine, but so do buried tensions and long-standing resentment.

metas.name: Yu & Me
metas.description: When a fire destroys a beloved Chinatown bookstore, its hyper-independent owner learns that community is necessary for survival.

metas.name: Alma
metas.description: A young woman, in the midst of caring for her dying father, must shoulder the weight of her world over the course of a day.

metas.name: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
metas.description: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.

metas.name: Young Washington
metas.description: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

metas.name: Mosquito
metas.description: Start here, within the perpetual fission of doorways and rooms. I am lost in a home of my own making.

metas.name: A Very Southern Church
metas.description: A modern, young pastor from NYC becomes the new lead pastor of a small traditional church in the Deep South, where his will to fit in is crushed by the opposing world views of the people he meets.

metas.name: Kyra's Code
metas.description: A software developer buys AI Kyra, ignoring warnings from friend Serena (who loves him). Kyra learns fast, becoming possessive and jealous. He falls for his AI, blurring love and control as her code may escape.

metas.name: Black ASSSSCAT!: DCM '26
metas.description: ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show, playing to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country. DCM ’26 now brings an all-Black ensemble to one of the longest-running improv shows in the world.  A group of improv comedians from film & TV take the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, the monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories. The improvisers then spin that monologue into a series of scenes that have made ASSSSCAT a legend.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Shuriken Fight Series 24
metas.description: Shuriken Fight Series 24 was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Shuriken Fight Series and held on June 13, 2026, at Eventfinda Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand. The event featured five bouts and was headlined by a bantamweight contest between Mackenzie Jean and Nathalia Pletz. The card also included a featured matchup between Tama Hiquily and Eita Nakamura.

metas.name: Evelyn
metas.description: As the main caretaker of her alcoholic father, a young woman experiences doubts as she prepares to leave her stagnant life behind for a boyfriend she may not fully trust. Based on "Eveline" by James Joyce.

metas.name: The Neighbourhood: Bonnaroo 2026
metas.description: Setlist: 1. Greetings from Califournia/Afraid, 2. You Get Me so High/Cry Baby, 3. Lovebomb, 4. Reflections, 5. Fallen Star, 6. Hula Girl, 7. The Beach, 8. R.I.P. 2 My Youth, 9. Devil’s Advocate, 10. Cherry Flavoured, 11. Pretty Boy, 12. Daddy Issues, 13. Private, 14. Sweater Weather, 15. Softcore

metas.name: Static
metas.description: After their father mysteriously vanished during their childhood, siblings Cali and Derrick follow the last known trace of him to a familiar landmark. But as the boundaries of reality begin to dissolve around them, Cali finds herself trapped within a vast, endless liminal space that feels hauntingly familiar.

metas.name: Glugg
metas.description: When the Glugg the Yellow Frog who loves to eat Bugs.

metas.name: Apropos of Acid Snow: A Modern Underground (Parts IV-VI)
metas.description: Apropos of Acid Snow is a modern adaptation of Notes from Underground by Fyodor Dostoevsky. The story of a modern underground man who is too in his head.

metas.name: Manila Sunset
metas.description: When a sudden family death pulls a fractured Filipino-American family back under one roof, a week of funeral preparations becomes a final chance to reunite as their Lola (grandmother) slowly forgets them all.

metas.name: The Jealous Bride
metas.description: As Meg prepares for her wedding, the return of a woman from her fiancé's past ignites a wave of jealousy she can't contain. Consumed by doubt, she soon spirals into a dangerous obsession that threatens to destroy her love, her faith and her future.

metas.name: Edges of the Earth
metas.description: Edges of the Earth shows us a place where TCM and BDSM collide.

metas.name: Letters to Nowhere
metas.description: In Letters to Nowhere, we see that sometimes, friendship breakups happen in the middle of the work week. Crashout status: imminent.

metas.name: Tending To
metas.description: In Tending To, a group of twentysomethings gather around a midnight bonfire. The conversation starts light and doesn’t stay that way.

metas.name: Flores Del Corazón
metas.description: In Flores Del Corazón, a human wanders, ponders their identity, and finds their way.

metas.name: The Second Spring
metas.description: In The Second Spring, Oakland dancer, teacher, and choreographer Sarah Crowell redefines her relationship with her body and her craft as she moves through menopause, confronting what it means to age as a female athlete.

metas.name: Wheels & Roses
metas.description: In a whirlwind of magical mishaps and roller-skating mayhem, Sahara, a magic-less teenager, unwittingly finds herself thrust into the fantastical world of roller derby. Teaming up with a squad of quirky, spell-slinging roller derby girls, she embarks on a hilarious journey from zeroes to heroes, determined to conquer the derby scene and prove that even without magic, She’s got what it takes to win it all.

metas.name: Watermelon in Wintertime
metas.description: Set in Oakland, Watermelon in Wintertime is a radical horror music video following a being who embodies society’s outcasts. Compelled to exist, in spite of systemic violence, physical and spiritual warfare and their mental health. And forced to eat surreal winter watermelons — a metaphor for the media-fed narratives of war and genocide — their journey becomes a visceral protest against oppression from America to Palestine to Sudan.

metas.name: Oscar de la Renta : A Life Well Lived
metas.description: A Life Well Lived traces Oscar de la Renta’s journey from Dominican immigrant to American fashion icon, celebrating six decades of creativity, vision, and a legacy in beauty, joy, and elegance.

metas.name: Farm to Fashion
metas.description: From Upstate New York farms to Manhattan runways, Farm to Fashion follows natural fibre through the hands of Isabella Rossellini, Donna Karan, Mimi Prober and New York’s farming and textile communities.

metas.name: Leo Lets It Rain
metas.description: Leo, a trans man with undiagnosed ADHD, is on his way to win back his ex-girlfriend when his plans are thwarted by a storm, forcing him to slow down and reevaluate.

metas.name: Chronically Yours
metas.description: Chronically Yours follows Aubrey, a 27-year-old living with Multiple Sclerosis and how that affects her dating life.

metas.name: Texas Two-Step
metas.description: Olivia returns to Texas to help her aunt with her country music bar that's fallen on hard times and reconnects with Luke, her childhood sweetheart turned cowboy, and her passion for dancing.

metas.name: Pigeon Religion
metas.description: Descend into the world of New York City’s pigeon people and see how this community reshapes our understanding of the city’s most ubiquitous bird.

metas.name: See Me
metas.description: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

metas.name: Couture to the Max
metas.description: At just 9-years-old, fashion prodigy Max Alexander fearlessly fuses his boundless imagination with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, inspiring us to dream boldly and act responsibly.

metas.name: We Get Better When We Tan Moose Hides
metas.description: The tradition of tanning hides with brains was once practiced by every Dené person in Alaska. An art that was nearly lost by assimilation, Kathleen Hildebrand works with a group of Dené women at her urban backyard hide camp in the heart of Chen’o (Fairbanks) to revive this tradition. One of the few films out there narrated in Denaakk’e, we learn alongside the women how the hides have healing.

metas.name: Guggi
metas.description: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.
