metas.name: Alicia Keys: Girl From Hell’s Kitchen
metas.description: Alicia Keys reflects on her childhood growing up in Manhattan's Hell's Kitchen and the journey that led her from the gritty streets of 90s New York to the Broadway stage in Tribeca.

metas.name: I Wanna Hold Your Hand
metas.description: In a dark movie theater, a young boy’s anxiety swells as he debates making the first move—until a small act of courage speaks louder than words.

metas.name: Black Tea
metas.description: An artist and a collector argue over an antique teacup. They make their cases over a cup of tea and a crush develops.

metas.name: My Dear Watson
metas.description: When he receives a mysterious love note, a teenage Sherlock Holmes must step outside of his comfort zone in order to uncover the identity of his secret admirer.

metas.name: Greenhorn
metas.description: A young masculine-presenting woman must return home to help her estranged father, an ex-rancher, recover from a car accident — only to discover that reconciliation isn’t so easy when identity is at stake.

metas.name: Bad Filmmaker
metas.description: "Bad Filmmaker" follows the complex working relationship between famous actor Lyle Lincoln and famous filmmaker Joe Saushez and its struggles.

metas.name: Ruleta
metas.description: As Christmas time approaches, an old man is forced into a game of roulette to answer for his sins.

metas.name: [redacted]
metas.description: Part of installation of Klein's exhibit Rack It!

metas.name: So Much Fun
metas.description: So Much Fun is a sprawling, deeply personal film that chronicles the bittersweet transition between youth and adulthood. What begins as a globe-trotting escape through the towering skylines of Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong slowly transforms into a raw examination of isolation, nostalgia, and growing up. The film wrestles with shifting relationships, changing identities, and the feeling of constantly evolving. It serves as both a cinematic travelogue and a rhythmic, music-driven diary. Fueled by a heavy, genre-blending soundtrack, So Much Fun is a beautiful, melancholic farewell to the past and an embrace of whatever comes next.

metas.name: improv4humans with Matt Besser: DCM '26
metas.description: improv4humans is a comedy platform from one of the founders of modern improv, Matt Besser. Together with longtime producer and engineer Brett Morris, i4h is dedicated to presenting the very best in improvised comedy, supporting performers, and teaching the craft to the next generation.  Besser is a founding member of the groundbreaking sketch group and Comedy Central series The Upright Citizens Brigade, and co-founder of the world-renowned UCB Theatre and training center — which has launched the careers of countless household names in comedy. He also co-authored The Upright Citizens Brigade Comedy Improv Manual, the definitive book on long-form improv.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Baby Wants Candy: DCM '26
metas.description: World renowned musical improv ensemble Baby Wants Candy (“Truly Amazing! Critics Pick!” New York Times) makes up a musical based on your title. Some recent titles we’ve liked: “Project Hail Mary Poppins”, “Sweeney Toddler” and the seminal “Hotuncles.com…the Musical”.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Big Grande: DCM '26
metas.description: Big Grande has been bringing their brand of rapid, honest, and wild live shows to sold-out crowds around the country — hell, the continent — for over a decade. Now they’re hopping onto the UCB stage for a DCM26 show that’ll leave you laughing (hopefully) and them sweating (definitely).  Their podcast, The Teachers Lounge, gained a fervent following on The Earwolf Network before they began selling it directly to fans. Find it — along with their four-episode live improvised comedy special, sketches, animated content, merch, and more — at biggrandewebsite.com.  Individually, you’ve seen them on The Other Two, Brooklyn 99, Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin, Superstore, Comedy Bang Bang, Son of Zorn, Bless the Harts, Playing House, and Last Call with Carson Daly — as well as behind the camera on Lights Out with David Spade and Netflix: After Party.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Bubbe & Tal
metas.description: A stoner buddy-dramedy between a Jewish grandmother and her trans grandchild on a day trip to Cape Cod during the off-season.

metas.name: The Offspring: SMASH 30th Anniversary Concert
metas.description: Watch The Offspring celebrate the 30th anniversary of SMASH with a full live performance from Honda Center in Anaheim, California on June 1, 2024, featuring the landmark album played in full plus fan favorites from across their catalog. Originally released on April 8, 1994, SMASH became one of punk rock’s defining albums, peaking at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and earning 6x Platinum certification from the RIAA.

metas.name: The Dastardly Desecration of Dame
metas.description: Returning to the pod - a new skit! The Western Wonder recently had a "rap battle" between his Discord buddy Damon, and the results were... well... you be the judge.

metas.name: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
metas.description: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

metas.name: Tour De Mesa '26
metas.description: Tour De Mesa '26 follows a group of friends as they taste the foods that fed them all year long throughout their senior year of high school.

metas.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream - An Excerpt
metas.description: Taking scene 1 of Act 3 and transforming it into a new interpretation.

metas.name: Sunday Nights
metas.description: An adaptation of Paul Thomas Anderson's 1997 film Boogie Nights. Sports mastermind and high school student Lance gets involved in a gambling scheme which leads to a change in personality and a new found obsession of money told in a documentary style.

metas.name: DISTANCE
metas.description: A chronically online, awkward young man has an unhealthy addiction of watching a small content creator every single day, disregarding vital tasks and isolating himself, but when his favorite icon misses a video upload one day, he finds himself in a sequence of psychologically conflicting events.

metas.name: Keira the Forest Guardian
metas.description: Keira, a young orphan girl, must go on a dangerous quest to save the land from a terrible darkness.

metas.name: Missing Pieces
metas.description: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

metas.name: Something, Something, Seventh Street
metas.description: Brooke picks up a table on Facebook Marketplace and brings it home.

metas.name: The Orange Umbrella
metas.description: Stuck in a monotonous, black-and-white existence, a lonely romantic becomes captivated by a mysterious woman whose orange umbrella brings color to his world—and uncertainty to his reality.

metas.name: Delay 1/2-4
metas.description: A story about a man and a camera.

metas.name: Telharmonium
metas.description: A generative film exploring the automation of culture through one of the earliest electronic instruments: the Telharmonium. As in much of Menick’s work, the film links the history of technology with contemporary anxieties about artificial intelligence and the mechanization of creative labor.

metas.name: Scuffle in the Lou
metas.description: A lunch, a bathroom, a brawl, and a wallet.

metas.name: Chi Mangia Solo
metas.description: On the night before selling their childhood home, an estranged brother and sister reconnect while cooking their late mother’s favorite recipe. They find their grief simmering just beneath the surface.

metas.name: Deadly Destination Wedding
metas.description: After flying to a secluded island resort ahead of a friend's destination wedding, a recently single lawyer begins a passionate fling with a charming stranger. When her passport disappears, she realizes the man she trusted may have trapped her in paradise.

metas.name: Frank Takes a Break!
metas.description: After being released from prison, a young man is sent to track down his old friend while drifting through an existential journey that forces him to choose between his past and a chance to change.

metas.name: Clay
metas.description: Emerging from a plaster egg in Central Park, a baby embarks on a lyrical voyage through the city’s pulse, uncovering her true form.

metas.name: Territory
metas.description: Girl is kidnapped by her own body. In the labyrinth of her inner self, the girl must face the obsessions and desires of a person who is doomed to food—ever-present and painfully tempting. The film explores a toxic relationship with one's body. It shows the illness from an internal perspective, emphasizing confusion, loneliness, and of loss of control—emotions that are often invisible but deeply embedded in the everyday lives of people struggling with eating disorders.

metas.name: Mnema
metas.description: In a world of obstacles and labyrinths, Mnema tries to find her way into each level of what resembles a video game. Between reality and fantasy, Mnema hears the voices of women who once were in her place.

metas.name: This Land Carries Us
metas.description: This Land Carries Us is a short experimental doc that centers Tewa presence, voice, and memory across ancestral homelands in northern New Mexico. Guided by the voice of the filmmaker’s grandmother, who recites a story written by the filmmaker’s late younger brother in the Tewa language, the film unfolds as a sensory meditation on land, family, and intergenerational connection.

metas.name: The Last Bateau
metas.description: In the quiet woods of East Texas, producer Brittani Mathis uncovers a wooden bateau built by her great-grandfather, Wyatt Moore, and a box of cassette tapes where his voice still lingers. Nearly fifty years after he recorded them, she returns to Caddo Lake to restore the last bateau he built. In doing so, she reconnects with the craft, memory, and lineage that shaped then both. Anchored around archival audio and quiet observation, this lyrical documentary moves like memory.

metas.name: Buffalo Spirit
metas.description: Fleeing from a troubled home life, a young Blackfeet woman finds refuge on the buffalo ranch of her Auntie and, in learning to care for the buffalo, begins to heal from the wounds that led her there.

metas.name: Everything Must Go
metas.description: EVERYTHING MUST GO is a comedy short filmed in real time as a cis/trans lesbian couple gets married, gives away their possessions, sells their house, and flees the US to escape anti-trans legislation.

metas.name: Close Friends
metas.description: Lauren had a transformative year. Her friends on the internet helped her through it.

metas.name: Maternal Instinct
metas.description: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

metas.name: New Toy Story
metas.description: When a new action figure accidentally knocks a princess doll over the backyard fence, a group of mismatched toys must work together to bring her home before dark.

metas.name: The Endless Frontier
metas.description: An urgent portrait of three scientists working to solve some of the most pressing challenges of our time, from disease to climate change, while revealing the growing threat to the American research engine and what is at stake for us all if it falters.

metas.name: Labyrinthine
metas.description: Jesse finds herself in a strange, dream-like Labyrinth after a relationship ending argument with her girlfriend. In order to escape, she must confront her own faults.

metas.name: bird's nest (the mourning dove and the cardinal)
metas.description: An animated retelling of the directors personal journey with his body as a transgender man from Texas.

metas.name: Your Name Means I Love You
metas.description: A guy becomes infatuated with a girl named after a French pop song.

metas.name: Whipple’s World
metas.description: Attorney by day and beloved entertainment journalist by night, George Whipple has been a staple on NY1 for three decades, including his eponymous show "Whipple's World." Juggling many different hats with aplomb, this documentary debut shows just how fascinating Whipple’s eccentric life is.

metas.name: House of Criticism
metas.description: Roberta Smith and Jerry Saltz are both rockstars in the world of art criticism. They’re also madly in love. Reflecting on their relationship, careers, and the ever-evolving New York City art scene, this unlikely power couple invites us into their surprisingly humble world.

metas.name: Born Melo
metas.description: This new, official documentary takes an intimate look into the life and legacy of Carmelo Anthony as he is inducted into the Hall of Fame and sees his son, Kiyan, launch his collegiate basketball career.

metas.name: Mumford & Sons: The House Band
metas.description: Mumford & Sons invite the camera onto the train for one of the most purely pleasurable concert docs in years. Featuring Noah Kahan, Darius Rucker, Lainey Wilson, Maggie Rogers, and several other special guests along for the ride, the journey captures the intimacy and camaraderie between all the performers both onstage and off.

metas.name: Beyond Files
metas.description: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

metas.name: Something in the Air
metas.description: A short documentary about the life and work of Raychel Sanner, a storm chaser, environmental advocate, and trans person living in Oklahoma, USA.

metas.name: Morals & Status
metas.description: Three Venezuelan teenagers Rodrigo, Marcelo, and Alexa, get profiled at a store which leads to an altercation with immigration.

metas.name: Flag Day
metas.description: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

metas.name: MOUTH FULL OF GOLDS
metas.description: This is the definitive documentary of grillz (gold teeth) as told through the life and times of the artforms creator Famous Eddie Plein - one of the most inventive fashion icon you’ve never heard of, an entrepreneur who changed the face of hip-hop, one gold tooth at a time.  Simultaneously developing the aesthetic of grillz as the sound of hip-hop evolved across the country giving each city their moment in the spotlight. The story of a man who found him self at the epicentre of the hip-hop, Miami bass, Southern Rap and Chopped and Screwed music scenes.  A natural born hustler whose customer base comprised of rap superstars, millionaire drug dealers, gangsters and fashion focused teenagers. An icon that built and then lost an empire after the world went digital and moved on-line without him.

metas.name: Swamped
metas.description: A 19 year old college student named Rowan lives through a day in her life, which means constant agony in her own brain. Rowan is trapped in a battle with herself, dealing with her obsessions and compulsions, as well as trying to adjust to a new social life.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: A young actress comes face to face with a volatile composer at the biggest callback of her career.

metas.name: Ata Pūao
metas.description: Amid the nightlife of a new city, a young Māori trans woman reckons with safety, isolation, and the fragile bonds of old friendships outgrown — as the promise of belonging rises just beyond the horizon.

metas.name: The Intimacy Coordinator
metas.description: Kate is an intimacy coordinator. She is also a sex addict.

metas.name: Learning to Eat Cake
metas.description: An outgoing young woman reframes a strange and coercive sexual encounter as a comical tale to her friends in order to make light of the violation.

metas.name: Badland Rising
metas.description: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

metas.name: The Journalist
metas.description: London, 1980s. When a former associate turns up dead inside his bar, retired criminal Peter Bendford is dragged back into the darkness he left behind. With a meticulous crime journalist building a case against him and the police closing in, Bendford must survive one brutal interrogation to prove he’s no longer the man he once was.

metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

metas.name: What Will I Become?
metas.description: More than 50% of transgender boys have attempted suicide. Through two life stories, directors Lexie and Logan unravel why their community is particularly vulnerable to living and dying quietly.

metas.name: Seven Deadly Sins
metas.description: A young sword swinging student avenges his master by rejecting the seven deadly sins.

metas.name: FULL DISCLOSURE: THE REALITY BEHIND SPIELBERG'S DISCLOSURE DAY
metas.description: An exclusive look at the making of "Disclosure Day," featuring interviews with Steven Spielberg, Emily Blunt and more, hosted by Gadi Schwartz.

metas.name: A Weird Night
metas.description: CAUGHT BETWEEN LIFE AND DEATH, WILL ETHAN FIND THE PEACE HE CRAVES?  Ethan Pulman, a mortally ill boy, finds himself lost in a surreal dreamscape after being prescribed morphine to help him sleep and forcing him to confront his deepest fears. Will he be able to make it through until morning to reunite with his mother?

metas.name: A Sense of Dread
metas.description: Four men working at a remote scientific outpost unravel the disturbing secrets about the facility's history, signaling the approach of a mysterious menace that will not only consume these men, but, perhaps, everyone on the planet.

metas.name: Philly Rumba
metas.description: "Philly Rumba" is a short film that features African American and Latin American percussionists and cultural keepers who have played a role in preserving the culture of rumba percussion in the Philadelphia region.

metas.name: How Not to Die on an Alien Planet
metas.description: Stranded on a distant world, a small, worn-out robot named Helen wanders through strange, beautiful landscapes, guided only by a song and the quiet weight of an unfinished mission.

metas.name: SEED
metas.description: A man is inducted into a surreal collective to prepare him for fatherhood. Though baffled by this new world, he begins to embrace the new task at hand until tragedy strikes, testing his newfound resolve.

metas.name: Paris: City of Love
metas.description: During a trip to Paris, Maggie searches for love.

metas.name: Midsummer Love Witch
metas.description: “A love witch accidentally casts a love spell on a woman in the park, now it’s up to her to undo the spell over a romantic dinner.”

metas.name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Ryan Blaney
metas.description: Eli Manning recruits NASCAR champion Ryan Blaney to go undercover at the Team Penske Race Shop in Mooresville, NC. Blaney transforms into Hamish Wimsley, a British gent who's long in the tooth and even longer in the beard. He'll get under the hood of NASCAR and Team Penske before showing diehard fans that he's still got some petrol left in the tank.

metas.name: The Stranger
metas.description: A short film adaptation of the classic novel The Stranger in a silent film style along with classical music.

metas.name: The Stranger
metas.description: A short film based on the novel the stranger in a silent film style.

metas.name: Randolph Davies and the Kickass Band: The Official Concert
metas.description: From the outrageous life of Randolph Davies comes songs about TikTok addiction, wives and lovers, Michael Jackson "did it", Dancing boat captains, a guy that can't remember his kids' names, and so much more. Randolph takes over the stage at Austin's legendary Comedy Mothership for a night of pure chaos.

metas.name: Caitlin Peluffo: Prosciutto Rose
metas.description: Caitlin’s first full-length stand-up special, "Prosciutto Rose", delves into break-ups, her love of short kings, and her fluff n’ floof (you’ll just have to watch to find out what that means).

metas.name: Perception
metas.description: As reality and nightmare begin to bleed into each other, a man falls apart inside the loop of his own ordinary day.

metas.name: Six Days To Pay
metas.description: After Eddie Wayne gets into debt from a notorious gang, he has six days to pay his debt or he gets killed.

metas.name: What Does This Mean?
metas.description: Sal and Mike explore an art museum and figure out what "art" means to them.

metas.name: The seed of tomorrow
metas.description: In a polluted world, one kid will find a way to change things for the better.

metas.name: Close The Door
metas.description: A struggling, unemployed and reclusive artist documents the last two days of his life before committing suicide.

metas.name: KPOP Smoothie
metas.description: A broke Korean American student walks into a KPOP themed smoothie store and unknowingly orders a overpriced smoothie.

metas.name: Pale Night
metas.description: In the 1930s, the solitary lives of an ether addicted doctor and a lonely housekeeper are disrupted by the sudden arrival of a Bible salesman and his troubled sister. Repressed secrets and desires surface, leading to disturbing consequences.

metas.name: Trinity: The Story of The LOX
metas.description: Travel through time and reflect on the genesis, journey, and brotherhood of the multidimensional rap trio from Yonkers, The LOX.

metas.name: The Lion Queen
metas.description: You’ve seen her face on the cover of countless newspapers. Now step into the larger-than-life world and surprising true story of a true New York original — socialite Jocelyne Wildenstein, a.k.a. “The Lion Queen.”

metas.name: Stutterbug
metas.description: A stuttering man's desperate attempts to conceal his disability lead him to insult sick children, ruin his shot with his college crush and unwittingly hate-crime her also-stammering brother. All while just trying to order a cup of coffee.

metas.name: SHAMDEMONIUM
metas.description: Young aspiring actress Barb drowns in the pool of a kids birthday party, and must survive in a new thespian purgatory.

metas.name: Contenders
metas.description: An underdog sports documentary about a long suffering high school football program and their turnaround when a former player comes back as the head coach.

metas.name: Just Look Up
metas.description: A defiant young visionary, part stand-up comic, part young Bob Dylan, part brilliant mind, leads a disruptive climate movement reinventing protest, channeling civil disobedience, and demanding a livable future.

metas.name: This Blows
metas.description: This is a heartfelt and hilarious coming-of-age short film about growing up, friendship, and learning life’s awkward lessons. The film blends humor with a touch of innocence, portraying a chaotic suburban birthday party that spirals out of control after a crude question by an 11-year-old.

metas.name: Blood Yolk
metas.description: After returning to her family’s decaying farm, an estranged writer confronts a dark secret that forces her to question her twin brother’s involvement in a string of murders — and her own capacity to kill.

metas.name: The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

metas.name: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
metas.description: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

Nine represents the Russia animation studio's rich history, depicted as a meticulous, traditional animator working with a pencil at a classic wooden light table. Sitting right next to him is Zero, representing the modern era, working casually with headphones on a digital drawing tablet.

metas.name: The Magic Behind Island Tower At Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows
metas.description: A look at the artists and Imagineers whose creativity shaped Disney’s newest addition.

metas.name: Stereolab: Live in Concert at First Avenue in Minneapolis, October 11, 2025
metas.description: Stereolab’s most recent album is 2025’s Instant Holograms on Metal Film. Five months after that album’s release, Stereolab found themselves at the storied Minneapolis music venue First Avenue, where they performed to a sold-out room filled with enthusiastic fans.  Stereolab treated the energetic crowd to a rich array of songs from the new album, as well as several selections from their back catalogue, including one from their second EP, Super-Electric, released in 1991.

metas.name: resonance
metas.description: Voice memos from various people recounting how music impacted their lives edited into a short, experimental documentary.

metas.name: I Will Be Better
metas.description: A mentally lost man goes on a journey of self-imporvement.

metas.name: Christina Grimmie: Her Voice and Legacy A Decade Later
metas.description: The official 10th-anniversary film, Christina Grimmie: Her Voice and Legacy a Decade Later, traces her extraordinary journey from bedroom recordings that ignited a following of millions, to her landmark appearance on The Voice, through the tragedy of June 10, 2016, and beyond. Told through the voices of those who knew her best, including first-hand accounts from her father Bud, her brother Marcus, childhood friend Lauren Longo, and fellow artists who shared her world, the film refuses to let that night be the final word.

metas.name: Jacked Brain
metas.description: Dr. Jack Edbrain is an Imagination Therapist who helps his patients become more creative. He's also an astronomer and discovers something in his telescope that redirects his priorities from imagination to practical science.

metas.name: Alessia Cara: Giant Desk Concert
metas.description: In the first (or maybe only) episode of Giant Desk, Alessia Cara is invited on as a guest to perform six tracks from throughout her discography.

metas.name: But Nothing Ever Happens
metas.description: Sisters Mia and Jordan respectively watch TV and go to work.

metas.name: Sleep
metas.description: A modern remake of Andy Warhol's original film.

metas.name: three twenty-five
metas.description: The final twelve minutes of a couple's relationship as they realize they aren't ready to move in together.

metas.name: Dreams of Violets
metas.description: Tehran, January 2026. Inspired by real events from 47 years of Iranian civilian resistance, through the eyes of five strangers, Dreams of Violets brings protest footage to life with raw immediacy. At dawn, as Iranian forces execute wounded protesters, one soldier discovers five hiding in a dead-end alley. Above them, Amir, a child in a wheelchair, watches from a window and decides to act.

metas.name: Stankface Standing Soldier: The Rise of Mato Wayuhi
metas.description: As Mato Wayuhi continues to rise as a musical composer and rapper, he continues to hear his father’s and ancestors’ voices in his art. Mato is known for composing the score for the Emmy-nominated series Reservation Dogs. Outside of the realm of composing, Mato engages with his community and the world through his talents as a rapper. Stankface Standing Soldier: The Rise of Mato Wayuhi provides a glimpse into the up-and-coming Oglala Lakota artist’s life as a rising rapper and composer. With the release of his recent album, Stankface Standing Soldier, the audience receives a deeper look into Mato’s personal inspiration and upbringing. This documentary showcases Mato’s versatility as a performer, showcasing his creative path led by his ancestors and his father’s voice.

metas.name: dude. where is my lighter?
metas.description: A young man wanders the streets of Shawnee, Oklahoma, searching for the thing that will bring him peace.

metas.name: Basic Bandits
metas.description: Three friends get an opportunity to move up in the crime world by taking an unconventional job.

metas.name: Open to Interpretation
metas.description: Longtime friends, Cal and Mason, accept Jasmine into their comedy group. They are both attracted to Jasmine. Mason makes a move in real life, but shy Cal can only make a move in his dreams.

metas.name: The Freedom Fighters
metas.description: An unlikely group of neighbors decide to fight back against their tyrannical HOA president.

metas.name: 4000 Days
metas.description: Chronicles the relentless fight of three families—Gary and Julie DeVercelly, Linda and Eric Oakes, and TJ and Kim Burch—who turned their personal tragedies into a nationwide movement for change. After losing their sons to fraternity hazing, the families found themselves up against a deeply entrenched system that thrived on secrecy, denial, and silence. Refusing to accept that their children died in vain, they joined forces and waged a years-long battle to expose the dangers of hazing, challenge university and fraternity accountability, and push for sweeping legislative reform.

metas.name: How to Feed a Dictator
metas.description: Five private chefs to fearsome dictators all over the world share their experiences of the kitchens and circumstances that led them to these sometimes dangerous and often morally compromising workplaces.

metas.name: Act One
metas.description: A young aspiring actress, desperate for guidance and belonging, falls under the spell of a manipulative acting coach who draws her into a web of control and obsession.

metas.name: The Knight of the Sorrowful Figure
metas.description: Don Quixote and Sancho Panza set forth on their quest in search of honor, chivalry, and legacy.

metas.name: Julie Takes a Walk
metas.description: When Julie shows up disheveled to a dive bar in the middle of nowhere, her connection with the bartender is a nice surprise.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

metas.name: Mexicanamerican
metas.description: Expertly merging old VHS home movies with new family interviews, filmmaker Eddie Sánchez traces his parents' journey from Mexico to the U.S. in this poignant and affecting documentary debut.

metas.name: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
metas.description: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

metas.name: Cucumber John
metas.description: After a devastating war in the wild west, cucumber farmer Cucumber John sets out for new beginnings in a new land. He is met with dangerous individuals who want to take his cucumbers and use them for their rival pickle business right under his nose.

metas.name: Francisco Ramos: Still Learning
metas.description: Francisco Ramos: Still Learning dives into the lessons that don't come with instructions: marriage, therapy, eating with other people, and even learning how to dance in the U.S. From cultural misunderstandings to relationship realizations, the special explores how we're all still learning… especially when we think we've got it figured out.

metas.name: The Lovers
metas.description: A woman conducts a Satanic ritual for love but reaps only suffering.

metas.name: Grad Movie
metas.description: San Carlos Charter’s 8th grade Class of 2026 compiles their childhoods into one picture, knowing it will be the last time they will all be together.

metas.name: Films about Ghosts
metas.description: A nine-minute reflection on graduating high school, featuring interviews with the class of 2026.

metas.name: Dawn to Dusk
metas.description: A series of shots representing the passage of 24 hours.

metas.name: The Original Mystery Incorporated
metas.description: Set in 1940s Coolsville, uncover the origins of some mysteries that riddled the town long before those meddling kids were born.

metas.name: Don't Stop Til' You Get Enough: The Making of Michael
Bodies of Evidence: Israel's Darkest Weapon
metas.description: Israel is the only state to have legalised torture through a ruling by its own Supreme Court. An expert who has documented these violations since 1983 says, “What the world knows today is less than 5% of what has actually occurred.”  In Bodies of Evidence, an Al Jazeera original investigative documentary, we examine the use of sexual violence, torture, and degradation against Palestinian detainees, practices that rights groups and experts say have been systematically employed by Israeli military, intelligence, and prison authorities for decades.

metas.name: Madelein Murphy: Muddin'
metas.description: Madelein Murphy has been performing stand-up comedy for over a decade and has the stories to prove it. In her debut special, she covers topics ranging from lesbian dating, family, her mom's church friends who are all named Susan, nannying, and the time a cop thought her legal name was Muddin. Filmed in front of a live and raucous audience in her hometown of Rochester NY, this special weaves together crowd work and storytelling for an hour of nonstop laughs.

metas.name: The White Wolf Rises
metas.description: After an evening of heavy drinking, Waylon Stone experiences a third life‑changing cinematic event that forces him to finally rethink his identity as the “White Wolf.”

metas.name: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
metas.description: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

metas.name: Blasphemy
metas.description: A Catholic girl in college grapples with her faith after meeting a boy in class.

metas.name: Spin Wars
metas.description: SoulCycle, Flywheel, Peloton — the billion-dollar boutique fitness revolution built on ambition, betrayal and toxic sweat. This high-energy documentary exposes the dark side of "mind, body, soul" culture with deliciously colorful insiders.

metas.name: Death Boom
metas.description: As a “spiritual follow-up” to 'Fin', 'Death Boom' “pulls back the curtain on the catastrophic mental and environmental impacts of the contemporary death care industry. The film, shown through the lens of the workers at the heart of it as they prepare for the passing of 77 million baby boomers, exposes the toll that embalming, cremation, and traditional burial have on those who’ve passed, their families, and deathcare workers, and the corruption – political, religious, and corporate – that stands in opposition to greener methods being nationally legalized and accessible.”

metas.name: Iconoclast
metas.description: A reclusive young man's dangerous obsession with a live-streaming influencer increasingly erodes his grip on reality.

metas.name: Needle & The Chronic
metas.description: With a little help from their friends, two young trans women navigate an uncertain future after a break-up.

metas.name: Never Change!
metas.description: In 2008, the graduating class of North Meadows High School had their senior year cut short due to a disastrous tornado. Now in their mid-30s, they're being forced to return home and finish high school once and for all.

metas.name: Girls Like Girls
metas.description: Coley, 17, from rural Oregon, navigates intimacy after her mother's passing. Meeting Sonya sparks new feelings, but self-doubt hinders their connection. Sonya, unfamiliar with dating girls, is uncertain. They learn to embrace emotions.

metas.name: Let's Love
metas.description: When a director, actor, screenwriter and actress reunite for the 10th Anniversary of their one-hit wonder film for a convention that suddenly gets cancelled, they must improvise and come up with ideas for a sequel while in rural Wales.

metas.name: Church of the Flying Saucer
metas.description: A young videographer finds herself drawn into the orbit of Hadrian Burns, a fledgling UFO cultist, and his gang of lost boys.

metas.name: Killing Castro
metas.description: Centered on true events when Cuban revolution leader Fidel Castro visited New York City and stayed in Harlem in 1960.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

metas.name: Why I'm Quitting Music
metas.description: Forrest opens up about a difficult decision as he begins to question his future in music. Taking place before the events of the Thank You I Guess music video, this chapter explores a turning point in his journey while continuing the story of Indie Movie Sound Track.

metas.name: Holding Out
metas.description: A 125-year-old retired superhero with dementia, and her estranged grandson, are forced to reconnect after she is kicked out of her aged care facility for failing to control her powers.

metas.name: THE JAMES RIVER P*NIS SNATCHER
metas.description: The less you are, the more you have and penises and stuff

metas.name: Gamechangers: The Ashlyn Harris Story
metas.description: Soccer champion and women’s sports advocate Ashlyn Harris is telling her full story for the first time ever, sharing her triumphs and defeats both on and off the soccer field, Ashlyn bares all, leaving viewers heartbroken at times and inspired at others.

metas.name: Montage of Vitrine
metas.description: At the end of their school year, three teenagers, Oscar, Bryan, and Rebecca, navigate the complicated emotions of teen-relationships and personal discovery.

metas.name: Capsule
metas.description: In an enclosed studio, a photographer and a writer drift between creation and desire.

metas.name: The Ropes
metas.description: Short by Erica Schreiner

metas.name: Women of World War II: More Untold Stories
metas.description: Women of World War II: More Untold Stories uncovers extraordinary, never-before-seen accounts of the women behind the Allied victory. From codebreakers and war correspondents to secret agents and resistance fighters, their courage, intelligence, and resilience changed the course of history.  Featuring rare archival footage and powerful perspectives from historians, descendants, and first-hand voices, this is a moving tribute to the women whose impact can no longer be overlooked.

metas.name: Ocean Dreams
metas.description: The ocean is the blue heart of our planet and is essential for all forms of life, including our own. It regulates the climate, provides food, produces much of the air we breathe and is an endless source of enjoyment and inspiration. Ocean Dreams will take audiences on a global adventure to reveal the fascinating, and largely unexplored, world beneath the waves. From the deep fjords of Norway where orcas skillfully hunt schools of herring, to the vibrant waters of Raja Ampat in Indonesia home to the richest biodiversity on Earth. Dive with wolffish, the guardians of the kelp forest, as they use their powerful jaws to dine on sea urchins and enjoy the splendor of the rarely seen Bikini Atoll where marine life that disappeared after nuclear testing is thriving again. The oceans are being challenged, but in every corner of the globe are inspirational stories of resilience and recovery. When given a chance, the oceans can heal and dreams can become reality.

metas.name: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live from Paris
metas.description: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

metas.name: Weighted
metas.description: Weighted is a short-film about Deacon Walker, who is struggling with his social life, his families ongoing economic crisis, and managing his grades to get into his dream school, the University of Washington.

metas.name: The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony
metas.description: The birth of a gymnastics team in Pakistan provides an inspiring spark of light for a small group of girls on the margins.

metas.name: March Forth
metas.description: This documentary is a powerful exploration into the life of Reginald Dwayne Betts, Yale Law School graduate and award-winning author, who transformed his time in prison into purpose.

metas.name: They Fight
metas.description: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.

metas.name: Procession
metas.description: June, a survivor of the Japanese American incarceration camps, takes her first pilgrimage for her 70th birthday, to confront all her demons, shame, and fear.

metas.name: That Friend
metas.description: Paul, “That Friend” who turns one drink into a full-blown bender, crashes his best friend Henry’s romantic weekend with his new girlfriend Penny, only to unleash chaos when his drug-laced cigarettes disappear into a stranger's hands.

metas.name: The Nightmare Heckler: A Crowd Work Documentary
metas.description: When your biggest fan turns against you. This was the worst show of Jeremiah Watkins' career, at least for him. Watch as he does the impossible, makes a show enjoyable surrounded in a room of hecklers. But there was one who started it all...The Nightmare Heckler.

metas.name: Funny Thing About Love
metas.description: The Funny Thing About Love is a sexy, emotional Black romance dramedy set at Atlanta’s premier fictional HBCU, Hunter College.  When bestselling author Miles Morris returns home for his ten-year reunion, he is forced to face Alice Lewis, the brilliant former love who broke his heart. But Alice’s perfect life has fallen apart. Her marriage to NFL star Derick Pennington has collapsed, and she has moved back home under the watchful eye of her powerful father, Judge Charles Lewis.  Days before the reunion, Miles releases a tell-all book inspired by their college romance, sending shockwaves through campus and online. As old feelings resurface, Alice must confront a buried secret that could change everything, including the truth about a child Miles never knew existed.  Romantic, messy, tender, and explosively funny, The Funny Thing About Love is a modern Black love story about heartbreak, healing, second chances, and the secrets that shape us.

metas.name: The Prophet
metas.description: A mighty warrior fights to save his country from an existential threat--only to discover that the true danger lies within.

metas.name: Wild Ones
metas.description: When a suspicious explosion leaves their low-rent, wannabe mobster boss for dead, $2M in un-cut cocaine lands in the hands of five queer besties. With nothing to lose and bills piling up, they launch their makeshift empire out of a crumbling Italian restaurant. But slinging powder in a sleepy town isn’t as low-key as they hoped.

metas.name: Alaina Bamfield: Untouchable
metas.description: Alaina Bamfield is a New York based stand up comedian from Williamston, Michigan.  This is her debut special.  Recorded at the Independent Comedy Club in Hamtramck, Michigan.

metas.name: All Things Gentle
metas.description: A short video poem that explores the beauty of nature and life.

metas.name: Fantasma
metas.description: Two friends are haunted by a ghost...

metas.name: The Text
metas.description: Amelia and Louise imagine all the reasons why Sam hasn’t replied to Amelia. As the night goes on and the wine bottle is emptied, their imaginations run wild.

metas.name: Stargate
metas.description: An experimental rendition of Stanley Kubrick’s famous stargate sequence from 2001: A Space Odyssey.

metas.name: This Is How the World Ends
metas.description: When a war breaks out between humanity and the AI Machine States, the world is thrown into a state of confusion.

metas.name: AAA Noche de Los Grandes 2026 - Week 2
Bukayo Saka: The Time Is Now
metas.description: Two generations of Arsenal greats are brought together as Bukayo Saka joins club legend Thierry Henry for an unguarded look at what it takes to perform at the highest level. Saka and Henry reflect on pressure, resilience, and the joy that first drew them to the game, with the conversation taking them back to Saka’s childhood home in Ealing where it all began.

metas.name: The Craving
metas.description: A pregnant woman develops strange cravings for raw meat in her first trimester. But after indulging in these taboo treats, the cravings grow more sinister over the course of her pregnancy.

metas.name: Left overs
metas.description: Sometimes left overs taste the best!

metas.name: The Bone Bandits
metas.description: When two bandits break into a paleontology museum to steal a priceless fossil, they are unexpectedly aided by an overly dedicated historical re-enactor who mistakes them for museum employees.

metas.name: FIA Formula One: Monaco Grand Prix Live in IMAX
metas.description: FIA Formula One: Monaco Grand Prix screened in IMAX.

metas.name: WATCH THIS!
metas.description: Two best friends go back in time to save their buddy from choking on a grape.

metas.name: Those Kids
metas.description: After a violent confrontation leaves a local bully dead, three teenage friends struggle to keep their lives from unraveling as guilt, fear, and paranoia tear them apart.

metas.name: Listen
metas.description: As his mother slips away into dementia, an Alaskan sound recordist listens for what remains.

metas.name: The Dark Knot at the Center
metas.description: Drawing from an archive of letters written in the 1960s, the film reimagines women's clandestine journeys from across the United States to Mexican border towns to access underground abortion care.

metas.name: Born to Kill
metas.description: From the Vietnam War to the New York streets, Vietnamese refugees built the infamous 80s gang Born to Kill, bound by brotherhood, blood, and the mantra: Love. Money. Sin.

metas.name: Switch
metas.description: Follows two women who embark on a journey to find a man to have a threesome with, raising the question: Can a relationship survive our deepest desires?

metas.name: Cookie, Love
metas.description: "Cookie, Love" centers around Taiwanese-American baker Jean Hwang Carrant and her cookie shop in Paris. Part love story, part an American-In-Paris portrait, this doc explores identity, authenticity, love, and of course - cookies.

metas.name: Sea Legs
metas.description: The revelation of a late father's second family forces his grieving daughter to acknowledge the skeletons in her own closet.

metas.name: Full Circle: The First All Black Everest Ascent
metas.description: An all-Black team sets out to summit Mount Everest not just to make history, but to redefine what it means to climb and who belongs in the mountains.

metas.name: Against the Flow
metas.description: Dayao and his pregnant wife, Tiantian, live in the countryside but work themselves to the bone in the city. Tiantian prefers the city, but Dayao prefers the tranquility of nature. When Dayao is seriously injured at a construction site, Tiantian must make major decisions about what’s best for them and their unborn baby.

metas.name: The Symphony of Dance
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes glimpse at a marathon of performances by Dancing with the Stars’ Derek and Hayley Hough becomes something entirely different when Hayley is forced to fight for her life following a shocking health crisis.

metas.name: Noga
metas.description: Fearless alternative pop singer Noga Erez is on the brink of superstardom with a unique, captivating sound and a major studio album on the way. But when war erupts and cracks appear in her relationship, Noga must redefine her role as an artist on a global stage.

metas.name: threeASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE
metas.description: threeASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE follows the visionary NYC fashion collective whose designs are an expression of unity, stitching an unshakeable ideology of peace into every garment.

metas.name: Miss Representation: Rise Up
metas.description: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

metas.name: Hollywood Does Abortion
metas.description: HOLLYWOOD DOES ABORTION  reveals how, from the 1970s to the present, film and television have too often relied on dangerously misleading distortions about abortions and the people who seek them. This provocative and lively feature length documentary explores the ways in which abortion narratives onscreen and public policy both mimic and influence one another. Extensive archival imagery spans five decades of television and film, ranging from Maude and Dirty Dancing to Jane the Virgin and Juno, and creates a historical timeline to support the “story” of the film.  In Hollywood Does Abortion, leading directors, writers, showrunners, and cultural critics share their personal and political reactions to these seminal depictions through the lens of today’s post-Roe world. Today, we see how a wide range of diverse Hollywood creators are racing to tell stories that push back against the seismic shift in access to abortion.

metas.name: The Siege of Paradise
metas.description: In Cinque Terre on Italy’s northern Riviera, fewer than 3,000 locals endure over four million tourists each summer.  Across one chaotic season, six very different lives play out in parallel, revealing a sharply funny and surprisingly tender story of paradise under pressure in the age of social media driven tourism.

metas.name: Finnegan's Foursome
metas.description: Two middle aged brothers and their respective sons travel to Ireland to play the Finnegan Family's annual golf outing, where they distribute the ashes of the family patriarch

metas.name: Caity
metas.description: Along with her newly sober father Paul, 16-year-old Caity prepares for the new Halloween season of their family-owned haunted house. When she recognizes signs of a relapse from Paul, she tries to cover them up but struggles to manage as she tests her own relationship to substances and an attraction to new employee Hannah.

metas.name: The Long Haul
metas.description: Long-haul trucking has been CJ's entire life. When she receives a letter from the parole board, everything she has been running from finally catches up to her; forcing her to deal with her past, present, and future all at once.

metas.name: Odyssey
metas.description: Using rare footage, Odyssey chronicles Apollo 13's 1970 crisis through Jim Lovell's family perspective and global cooperation efforts. After tank explosion damaged vital systems, NASA worked to bring astronauts safely home.

metas.name: Theatre of Dreams
metas.description: ‘Theatre of Dreams’ is an experimental docufiction short film inspired by the true story of the courage and hidden sacrifices of the first Qatar Women’s National Football Team - a team that first debuted in October 2010, but has not played an official match in over 10 years, mysteriously disappearing in the same decade that the country was building up and poised to host a successful FIFA Men's World Cup.

metas.name: Clean Hands
metas.description: The true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis and "the thin blue line" from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

metas.name: In Memoriam
metas.description: A veteran Hollywood actor becomes obsessed with securing a spot in the Oscars’ “In Memoriam” montage after he receives a terminal cancer diagnosis. This leads to a heartfelt journey of self-exploration as well as ego, humility, and legacy.

metas.name: Crooks
metas.description: Faye and Johnny rob a gangsters' poker den. Faye double crosses Johnny and takes off with the money and is soon pursued by the oldest and deadliest assassin in town. Worse still, Faye meets Blanche, a friendly but crazy waitress, at a truck stop.

metas.name: Bright Eyes:  21st Anniversary of "I'm Wide Awake, It's Morning"
metas.description: Join Bright Eyes in celebrating the 21st Anniversary of seminal albums "I'm Wide Awake, It's Morning".

metas.name: Forbidden Treasure
metas.description: Three unscrupulous treasure hunters finally find the treasure they seek, only to turn on each other with disastrous results.

metas.name: Paper Roses
metas.description: A blind date gone wrong. Or gone right? In Paper Roses, two individuals are set up on a blind date. Unknowing of what has yet to come, they hit things off quite well.

metas.name: Stem & Barrel: Napa Valley
metas.description: Set in one of the world's most closely watched wine regions, Stem & Barrel is an intimate, cinematic documentary that follows three acclaimed Napa Valley wineries through a single harvest season a defining moment that touches every part of the work, from vineyard to cellar to guest experience. With rare access to the people behind the process, the film reveals how each winery moves through the season in its own way balancing craft, hospitality, mentorship, and legacy while upholding a world-class reputation built by generations before them. Across early mornings in the vineyard, long days in the cellar, and moments shared with guests, each piece of the season is connected and every decision shapes what comes next. Because in Napa Valley, harvest isn’t just about making wine it’s about carrying something forward.

metas.name: Eden Avenue
metas.description: A naive artist, weighed down by perfectionism, trades his innocence for a life of independence after falling for his muse.  Centered around themes of forming one’s identity, independence, and principles, this coming-of-age drama alludes to messages that grow increasingly relevant to a complex contemporary society.

metas.name: Memory Lapse
metas.description: Sterling must relive the traumatic event of his sister's murder with the help of his therapist, through a device that allows them to enter his mind. By repeatedly traversing his memories, Sterling discovers the shocking truth.

metas.name: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
metas.description: This documentary uncovers one of the most consequential and little-known stories in modern football history and highlights the pivotal moment that helped shape Lionel Messi’s international future and altered the trajectory of global football.

metas.name: Message to Ezra
metas.description: An unexpected Instagram follow sends two high schoolers into a tailspin.

metas.name: What Happens in Vegas
metas.description: Angel and Sisterfriend are outsiders living in stark contrast with their idyllic, monotonous suburb. Dressed in black and protected by goth aesthetics on the outside, Angel and Sisterfriend are soft on the inside. They're barely adults, still learning how to express themselves. They find refuge and safety in their sisterfriendship. When Angel secretly becomes obsessed with finding out "what happens in Vegas," she tries everything. Praying to God. A seance. But nothing can answer the question at hand. While Angel wonders if there is life beyond the subdivision, Sisterfriend must grapple with the thought of losing her friend to the big city.

metas.name: The Choric Wail
metas.description: A figure walks around in circles all night.

metas.name: Broadway & Union Square, New York 2
metas.description: A sequel to Arthur Marvin's 1903 documentary in honour of the quasquicentennial of its filming that simultaneously evokes Promio's 'New York: Broadway at Union Square' (1896).

metas.name: Thou Shall Not Commit Adultery
metas.description: When Cassie, a Christian feminist icon and bestselling author, is blackmailed with videos of her affair, she must fight to protect her brand and marriage. But as her trusted assistant's betrayal escalates, Cassie faces a terrifying choice.

metas.name: THE LAST DAY BEFORE THE END OF THE WORLD
metas.description: A young woman experiences her last day before the end of the world.

metas.name: Night Shift
metas.description: A museum guard's night takes a deadly turn when criminals force her to aid a diamond heist in exchange for her husband's life.

metas.name: My Father's War: Memories from Our Honored WWII Soldiers
metas.description: Heartfelt interviews conducted by a WWII veteran's son shows the real daily world of WWII through the eyes of sailors, soldiers and airmen from all the branches and both theaters. How they stayed alive? How they came home to raise us. Why we call WWII, My Fathers War.

metas.name: Sleep Paralysis Demon
metas.description: A guy gets unlikely inspiration on how to battle The Evil Bride, his teeth chomping sleep paralysis demon.

metas.name: Stand Clear ' the Closing Doors
metas.description: When a woman makes a simple request of a fellow NYC subway passenger, an everyday moment turns into a bizarre battle for space, peace, and dignity.

metas.name: Verse
metas.description: Seventeen year-old Adam is forced to confront where his virtual persona ends and his real self begins when he decides to finally meet his VR girlfriend in real life.

metas.name: ROAR
metas.description: Tora, a non-verbal neurodivergent girl from Tokyo, navigates San Francisco’s sensory landscape. Guided by her mother and a K-pop inspired soundtrack, she finds her inner "roar" in this diaspora story.

metas.name: Insufficient Fare
metas.description: A discarded MetroCard defends its legacy against a city that’s moved on, tracing its rise as a New York icon before facing obsolescence with a nostalgic farewell.

metas.name: Imprint
metas.description: In a near-future where knowledge can be traded for citizenship, a desperate mother buys an immigrant’s expertise to give her daughter a competitive edge - at a cost she never imagined.

metas.name: I'm Not Home
metas.description: Two lifelong friends, estranged after one night that changed everything, reconnect over a box of old answering-machine tapes as voices from the past awaken the truths they’ve tried to silence.

metas.name: Homesick
metas.description: Fleeing Russia, Jenia thought New York would be her escape - she was wrong. Yet she’s determined to find her home.

metas.name: Grounded
metas.description: Left behind as others take flight, a young ladybird discovers that sometimes in life you need a helping hand… or eight.

metas.name: Fabric
metas.description: Amid the glamour and chaos of New York Fashion Week, a photographer and a model trade access and beauty as they yearn for a real connection.

metas.name: APART
metas.description: In apartheid South Africa, a forbidden friendship between two boys is tested by a life-saving act that forces them to confront the hate dividing their world.

metas.name: Violet and Marlowe Rob a Bank
metas.description: After the tyrannical President Rabbit monopolizes the world’s carrots, a pair of husband-and-wife rabbits from the countryside risk their lives in a series of factory heists to take them back.

metas.name: ChikaBOOM!!
metas.description: Chika Batstone is an aspiring young magician whose curiosity accidentally unleashes Kaboom, a chaotic magical creature, into the heart of New York City.

metas.name: Humpty Dumpty X
metas.description: Follows filmmaker Tony Kaye's creative journey after directing 1998's "American History X".

metas.name: Bullfight
metas.description: A young man grapples with unfamiliar and frightening feelings after meeting his opponent for an upcoming wrestling match

metas.name: Beyond Yesterday
metas.description: After seeing his past flash before his eyes, a man named Robby dives deep into his memories as he tries to escape his emotions and tries to look beyond yesterday.

metas.name: Me, Myself, and Mary
metas.description: Chris O'Dowd and Aisling Bea star in the viral, true story of Séamas O'Reilly, who got his days mixed up and ended up alone with his boss and the President of Ireland while high on drugs.

metas.name: The Greek Aisle
metas.description: When Georgia travels to the Greek island of Corfu to finalize an inheritance, she unexpectedly discovers that marrying her handsome co-inheritor is the only way to meet the requirements.

metas.name: A Crime Across Four Landscapes
metas.description: When a small-town crime goes awry, the evidence is scattered across four picturesque landscapes in the Southern American countryside - inviting viewers to piece together what happened.

metas.name: Deepfake
metas.description: After a breakup, rudderless millennial Jane hires a team of Gen-Z consultants to reinvent her life. But what begins as a makeover soon spirals into a sharp social media satire about image, app culture, and the cost of becoming someone else.

metas.name: Harvest
metas.description: Sondheimer, Louisiana. Population 200. Tucked in the northeast corner of the state, this rural enclave is home to the four Nelson Brothers—young, ambitious, fourth-generation commodity farmers who dream of becoming the biggest farmers in the United States.

metas.name: Time Warp
metas.description: 50 years after “The Rocky Horror Picture Show” electrified audiences, a drag theater company in the once-booming mining town of Rock Springs, Wyoming, stages a shadow cast of the cult classic. Led by the charismatic 25-year-old performer Kenny Starling, the determined troupe spotlights the ongoing fight for queer visibility and acceptance in their community.

metas.name: AI: Probably Nothing to Worry About
metas.description: The definitive documentary on AI's origins, told by the people who built it. A thriller-paced reckoning with ambition, rivalry and the question that now haunts everyone: Will artificial intelligence save humanity or destroy it?

metas.name: Here I'm Alive
metas.description: One night. One city. Migrants, sex workers and dreamers hustle New York's digital underbelly in this neo-realist urban epic driven by underground rap and spiritual jazz. Raw, unforgettable and unmistakably New York.

metas.name: Doc Meets World
metas.description: Thirty years after Boy Meets World made them teen idols, Danielle Fishel, Will Friedle, and Rider Strong reunite for a wildly popular rewatch podcast and national tour. Funny, candid, and unexpectedly emotional, their tour becomes a nostalgic ride through fame, friendship, and the messy reality of growing up on screen and off.

metas.name: Law's World: Lipstick Bandit
metas.description: A sassy pansexual sex blogger prepares for a high-profile house tour, but his plans are derailed by his narcissistic bestie, determined to retrieve something she claims is irreplaceable.

metas.name: Something You Should Know About Me
metas.description: In this sweet and raunchy trans rom-com, insecure cartoonist Al is faced with his most daunting prompt yet: confess his true feelings for his best friend or risk losing him to a handsome nemesis.

metas.name: PAPERWINGS
metas.description: In a cramped apartment that feels like it’s collapsing in on itself, two young men try to outrun addiction and each other. Jay is fighting for sobriety. Alex is fighting not to feel. When pills resurface between them, what starts as a familiar argument spirals into a breaking point that tests the limits of love, loyalty, and survival. Paperwings is an intimate, claustrophobic portrait of codependency, recovery, and the fragile hope of choosing to live.

metas.name: Human Theories
metas.description: Through forty interconnected vignettes, Human Theories is a comedic kaleidoscope exploring how people try, and often fail, to connect with one another in this weird world. Filmed over a year on location in New York City with a diverse ensemble cast of over 50 actors and non-actors, the film is an experimental love letter to the awkward struggle of modern city living.

metas.name: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs
metas.description: Nestled in the redwood forest of Northern California, the Humboldt Crabs, founded in 1945, are the oldest continuously operated summer collegiate baseball team, with their own band, ardent fans, and tradition of winning.

metas.name: Holo
metas.description: When her abusive partner dies, Claire contacts Looking Glass Technologies, a controversial company specializing in artificial encounters by means of an actor and futuristic facial technology – in order to confront him, gain closure, and control her life again.

metas.name: Only What We Carry
metas.description: Set against the windswept coast of Normandy. Described as “a meditation on love, loss, and the quiet courage it takes to move forward”.

metas.name: Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu
metas.description: Comedy legends Bob Odenkirk and David Cross tackle one of the world's toughest hikes — and each other — in this high-altitude, coca-fueled meditation on friendship, mortality, and profoundly absurd comedy from two icons still magnificently in sync.

metas.name: Rain Reign
metas.description: Rose Howard, a neurodivergent 12-year-old girl raised by her volatile single father, is forced to abandon her daily routines when a superstorm devastates their town and her beloved dog, Rain, goes missing. With the support of her uncle, Rose embarks on a determined search for Rain — a journey that challenges her resilience and compels her to make an impossible choice between her own needs and doing what is right.

metas.name: Ponderosa
metas.description: When the buffet where Zeke's mom works closes down, he's forced to entertain the wild advances of a rich regular who is weirdly and vehemently obsessed with becoming his father.

metas.name: Playing POTUS
metas.description: Explores the uniquely American tradition of presidential parody, a bold art form that has transformed our perceptions of real-world presidents and politicians for the past 60 years. These iconic impressions have an outsized and lasting impact on American politics that has gone completely unexamined... until now.

metas.name: The Last Day
metas.description: Over a single summer day in New York, the lives of two mothers briefly entwine. Julia, a writer and mother, is unsettled by creative stagnation, unprocessed grief, and the approach of her daughter’s adolescence. An unexpected encounter with Taylor—a labor and delivery nurse in the midst of a postpartum crisis—pushes Julia to reconsider the life she has built, and whether she can rediscover herself within it.

metas.name: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
metas.description: “Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

metas.name: Micronations
metas.description: From backyard kingdoms to full-blown diplomatic summits, the world's self-declared kings, queens and emperors invite you in. A whimsical and surprisingly timely documentary about borders, identity and the human need to belong.

metas.name: Savage House
metas.description: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

metas.name: Box
metas.description: David is a burnt-out pizza delivery driver who gains possession of a supernatural box that can answer all of life’s questions. However, when he opens the box, he may have gotten more than he bargained for.

metas.name: The Cheese
metas.description: After a sneak attack, two brothers start a cheese-throwing prank war.

metas.name: Iowa Vet: Dogs, Cats, Corn, & Murder
metas.description: A veterinarian reflects on growing up on an Iowa farm, building an animal hospital in the big city, confronting the upheavals transforming his profession, and navigating the unexpected chapters - Murders, Mormons, a Modern Family - that helped shape his life.

metas.name: BANGERS! The Game of Bike Invitational
metas.description: Nothing but BANGERS from all 15 Games of the Game of Bike Invitational. Tell your friends.

metas.name: Psionics: The Minds That Summon UFOs
metas.description: For decades people have been spotting strange lights in the sky, seeing unidentifiable craft dart across the horizon, and occasionally waking up with a lingering suspicion that something had been in their bedroom that wasn't there before. But what if we've been thinking about UFOs all wrong? What if these mysterious visitors aren't just little green men in flying saucers but something far weirder-something that interacts with us not through radio waves, but through our minds? Welcome to the mind-blowing world of psionics and UFOs, where telepathy and consciousness itself might be the key to unlocking the biggest mystery of our time. Patrick Scott Armstrong host of the popular podcast and YouTube channel Vetted takes a journey around America to meet those who claim they can use psionics to summon UFOs, experience them doing it in the field, and even tries it himself His aim - to get to the bottom of whether it's all nonsense or whether this is something that should be taken seriously.

metas.name: Frontier to Freedom
metas.description: Frontier to Freedom unearths the rich and often overlooked history of Michigan, tracing its evolution from a vast, untamed wilderness inhabited by Indigenous peoples in 1600 to its emergence as the 26th State in 1837. Through a blend of expert interviews, archival imagery, animated maps, and stunning visuals, the film explores the region’s formative years, its history of war and conflict on the American frontier, and the complex socio-political forces that shaped its path to statehood.

metas.name: Bleachers - Live From The Stone Pony (YouTube Music Nights)
metas.description: The day after they released their fifth studio album, 'Everyone for Ten Minutes', Bleachers played a free show at The Stone Pony for 900 fans. Some flew across the country to be there, and others were locals who had been coming to see the band for over a decade. From the second they stepped onto that stage, it was one of their favourite shows ever. Thank god they filmed it.

metas.name: You Know You Got It
metas.description: A woman struggles to come to terms with the loss of someone important to her.

metas.name: Rosemary
metas.description: After her parents die in a car crash, Rose must take care of her grandmother Mary who suffers from dementia, and who does not remember the accident.

metas.name: Intrusive
metas.description: A young woman finds herself haunted by a specter that embodies all her intrusive thoughts.

metas.name: Fragments of a Lost World
metas.description: An experimental short film regarding the director's memories and dreams from an alternate reality.

metas.name: Her Husband's Double Life
metas.description: Carrie's world is shattered when her husband is found critically injured in a car crash with another woman by his side--a woman who also claims to be his wife. Carrie discovers that someone will stop at nothing to erase her from the picture.

metas.name: Washing Machine Time Machine
metas.description: LAUNDRY DAY JUST GOT A WHOLE LOT CRAZIER.

metas.name: NASCAR vs. Navy: The San Diego Mini Movie
metas.description: A group of NASCAR drivers are called to base. Not to prove themselves, but to help the U.S. Navy prepare for the inaugural Race the Base. But when the drivers arrive, they’re met by a squadron of elite hot-shot pilots who aren’t exactly thrilled about their runway being transformed into a race track. To earn the pilots’ respect and ensure the event can move forward, the drivers and sailors go head-to-head in a series of intense yet entertaining challenges. What follows is a cinematic, high-energy, and unexpectedly authentic journey as the drivers immerse themselves in Navy life.

metas.name: Watch Me Sleep
metas.description: A conversation in a doorway.

metas.name: You Tryna Say You Love Me?
metas.description: A late-night study break turns into something deeper when a grief-stricken college athlete opens up to his philosophy class crush—and unpacks a feeling he’s never dared name.

metas.name: Hannah Berner: None of My Business
metas.description: Follows Hannah Berner as she questions her future, exposes her unorthodox career path, dishes dating secrets and admits she's "part-time hot."

metas.name: Getar Hero
metas.description: A down-on-his-luck cowboy roams Bombay's neon night in this lyrical, urban Western.

metas.name: She Keeps Me Young
metas.description: Michelle is floating through life until a surprising connection with a high schooler challenges her friendship with her overbearing best friend, in this bitingly astute and exceptionally hilarious satire.

metas.name: Rationale
metas.description: Torn on coming out to his parents, a teenage boy turns to his friend for a second opinion.

metas.name: The Breadwinner
metas.description: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

metas.name: Strung
metas.description: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

metas.name: HAIRDOO
metas.description: The night before school photos, a spirited young girl attempts to recreate the perfect hairstyle.

metas.name: Daylight
metas.description: Serving a life sentence, Joe Garcia finds an unexpected lifeline in the music of a pop superstar. From inside his prison cell, her songs reconnect him to the possibility that his life might still hold meaning. As he prepares for his first real chance at freedom in decades, Garcia goes into an emotional journey toward accountability, reconnection and redemption.

metas.name: Snippets
metas.description: Two young adults are confronted by compulsory heterosexuality and the gender binary, feeling pressured into conforming. Through self-reflection and mutual support, they find their own paths and break free from the expectations that were imposed on them. Together they find the courage to be themselves in a world that doesn’t seem ready for them.

metas.name: GALAXIES
metas.description: An aimless weed dealer has all of his product stolen along with his beloved Nike Galaxy Foamposites.

metas.name: Small Hours
metas.description: Struggling with alcohol addiction and mental illness, an artist reaches out to an old friend.

metas.name: Stop! That! Train!
metas.description: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

metas.name: Holding Water
metas.description: Over the course of an afternoon in late spring, two longtime friends reunite under a mulberry tree to confront the ways their time apart has changed them.

metas.name: GENESIS
metas.description: A widowed father unravels his conviction after being plagued with recurring nightmares of sacrificing his beloved daughter.

metas.name: Loser
metas.description: A heartbroken teen, Jared, stumbles to find new love and messes up along the way.

metas.name: The Princess Who Forges the Sun
metas.description: The Tinkerer Princess and her Mysterious Retainer to find a way to make light return to a sunless world.

metas.name: Foot Finders
metas.description: Embark on a wild adventure as Kyle Evans, a Sasquatch-hunting reality TV star, goes all in on a last ditch effort to save his failing show.

metas.name: The Last Pack
metas.description: Anxious soon to be father, Jackson, promises his pregnant girlfriend, Dylan, he’s done smoking for good. But after a quick trip to the gas station spirals out of control, he finds himself dragged back into old habits with old company on the night everything is supposed to change.

metas.name: Squatch
metas.description: After discovering a Sasquatch in the Smoky Mountains, park rangers Robert and Sam find themselves in over their heads when tech giant Alphazon plans to destroy its habitat. With no real authority and even less of a plan, they decide to relocate the creature themselves, driving it cross-country to the Pacific Northwest. Watch as Robert and Sam try to do one small, wildly impractical good thing.

metas.name: The Light-Bringer
metas.description: Nick Cash, a lifelong musician, spends most of his Tuesdays along with the band, SIDETRACKED, playing at assisted living centers to bring light into the lives of those who are lonely and tired! His love of music is contagious, and he truly loves all those around him! This documentary chronicles how he fell in love with music and how that led him to performing every week.

metas.name: Gabriel Rutledge: A Reasonable Hour
metas.description: Gabriel Rutledge performs a comedy special in Tacoma Washington, filmed at Tacoma Comedy Club.

metas.name: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
metas.description: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns to a bet that changes everything.

metas.name: Small Steps
