metas.description: After settling in with her roommates Charlyne and Sophie, mute alien Stacey happily joins them on a trip from the Riverwest neighborhood in Milwaukee to Charlyne’s dear old dad in Chicago. If figuring out how best to take care of an alien lifeform wasn’t enough, the rogue CIA agent on their take might just make things worse. Whatever the case, the sheer independence of Stacey might be at stake.

metas.name: 2 Bro's Ideas
metas.description: With their Prod 2. due next week, Daniel and Logan can't decide on what to make. Daniel wants something classic and simple, while Logan wants . . . laptops to get stolen?

metas.name: Sword
metas.description: A captive prince falls asleep; in his dreams, his doppelgangers multiply—some imprisoned, some free—and they are all searching for the magnificent Sexcalibur, which could give new meaning to their lives.

metas.name: Enter Gustaffson
metas.description: The legendary anonymous painter known as Gustaffson reveals his identity in a groundbreaking documentary.

metas.name: The Last Laugh: Stephen Colbert
metas.description: For more than a decade, Stephen Colbert has sat at the center of late night, where comedy, politics and culture collide. As he prepares to take the desk for the final time, The Last Laugh turns its lens on both the show and the man, exploring what audiences stand to lose when one of satire’s sharpest and most thoughtful voices signs off. The hour also examines the broader cultural and political forces surrounding the end of Colbert’s late-night run and the future of outspoken comedy in an evolving landscape.  Anchoring the hour is a dynamic lineup of interviewees spanning comedy, journalism and cultural criticism. The special features appearances from CNN Anchor and Chief Washington Correspondent Jake Tapper and comedians Jordan Carlos and Gianmarco Soresi, alongside key creative voices from The Colbert Report including Allison Silverman and Richard Dahm, each offering insight into the scope and lasting influence of Colbert’s work.

metas.name: Ophira Eisenberg: I Used To Be Nicer
metas.description: Ophira Eisenberg gives a Canadian middle finger to toxic positivity, parenting, marriage maintenance, aging, therapy, and the goddamn cost of eggs.

metas.name: GCW: Guilty Conscience 2026
metas.description: The lawless energy of Game Changer Wrestling returns to the Motor City! GCW takes over the legendary Harpos Concert Theatre for "Guilty Conscience 2026." Known for its gritty atmosphere and die-hard fans, Detroit becomes the epicenter of independent wrestling as the promotion brings its unique blend of high-octane athleticism and ultraviolent chaos back to one of its favorite haunts.  Tag Team Warfare: The Pillars vs VNDL48  Women's Showcase: Allysin Kay vs Vipress  Singles Grudge Match: Dr. Redacted vs Anakin Murphy

metas.name: Last Night In..."Hollywood"
metas.description: A determined young actress takes on a mysterious errand for a manipulative casting director, crossing paths with a disgraced former actor. As their worlds collide, she’s forced to question how far she’s willing to go to make it in Hollywood.

metas.name: The Janitor
metas.description: After a confusing accident, 3 high school theater students are forced to deal with very.... serious cops.

metas.name: Damnation Empire
metas.description: A man is about to be executed. Before, during, or after his death, he remembers fragments of his past, and navigates to find and save himself.

metas.name: Inside The Works
metas.description: In 1974, an eccentric millionaire by the name of Alexander Schure founded the New York Inistitute of Technology's Computer Graphics Lab. Housed in a one hundred year old pink mansion in Long Island, the lab made large advances in digital paint, animation, and attempted to create the first computer animated film twice in its lifetime. Kickstarting Pixar, creating the alpha channel, and creating art with every new tool they could lay their hands on, this is the story of the forbidden pink house in Long Island.

metas.name: Sam Pauly: A Documentary
metas.description: The film, created and directed by acclaimed celebrity photographer and artist Jasper Soloff, traces the highs and lows of Sam Pauly’s career as she sits down in her Broadway dressing room recalling the sudden cancellation of a planned world tour which forced her to confront the possibility of walking away from the profession she had fought so hard to build a place in. With work disappearing overnight and the future of theater uncertain, Pauly wrestled with burnout, financial pressure, and painful questions faced by many performers.

metas.name: Telescope
metas.description: Stumbling on the mythical House of Lost Things, an explorer must choose between her missing childhood stuffed animal and a future-telling telescope with the answer to all her fears.

metas.name: You knew, I know
metas.description: The first month of Spring in the past and the present. A follow-up to “You Are Here”.

metas.name: "LEMON-HEAD!"
metas.description: A colorfully dressed hit-man (Breccan Conroy), haunted by his darker thoughts (DeChi Peterson), faces a life-altering choice: remain loyal to his violent career or risk everything for the girl who might save him (Lola Bazile). No matter what he decides, his past will soon follow.

metas.name: Deacon Blues
metas.description: On the morning of his best friend’s wedding, Edwin goes on a strange journey deciding whether to speak his mind or forever hold his peace.

metas.name: Automaton
metas.description: The Indigoing on the Streets finale culminates in a surrealist moving picture.

metas.name: The Right Way is the Wrong Way
metas.description: Roy is heading to a job interview but keeps getting lost. Along the way, he meets two characters who change his perspective on life.

metas.name: Fossilized
metas.description: Linnie lives with her Nana in the unincorporated territory of Villegreen, Colorado - notable only for a nearby paleontological site. When Nana’s memory begins to fail, Linnie goes looking for evidence of the past.

metas.name: Bug Behind Schedule
metas.description: Bug stayed up late procrastinating and fell asleep, only to find itself running late for film class. Waiting anxiously for it's pick-up and desperate for a solution, it finds a mysterious object behind the computer that might just be the key to getting to class on time. Time travel mishaps ensue.

metas.name: Death at the Dinner Party
metas.description: When a star psychology student dies during a faculty party, Andrea Gibbs and her son Ethan are drawn into the dangerous manipulations of renowned professor Alan Jackson, a man determined to bury the truth at any cost.

metas.name: Kubler
metas.description: The Campbell family is grieving the loss of their daughter and sister after a fatal accident in the midst of the holiday season. The family is sent into ethical turmoil, however, when the father brings her back in the form of a robot replacement that shares her personality and memories. Due to some technological complications and the nature of their situation, she is totally unable to live her life as she once did.

metas.name: Vacant Aisles
metas.description: Vacant Aisles follows Thomas and Annie who are trying to navigate through their uneventful lives, trying to make the most of the small things while being confronted with the fact they need to make a change.

metas.name: Don't Shoot The Messenger
metas.description: A pickup man and a small-time criminal both face a moral dilemma.

metas.name: Raunchy Round Up
metas.description: A struggling actress juggles her pretentious ex-boyfriend, rekindling an old flame, and the steamy film that might just be her big break.

metas.name: The Knock
metas.description: Philip, living a monotonous life, has an entity develop over him when he fails to reach out to his mom and can't get it to go away.

metas.name: Power Slap 20
metas.description: Power Slap 20: Trujillo vs. Johnson takes place on Friday, May 15, 2026, live from The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan in Las Vegas. The event features a Lightweight Championship main event and streams for free on the Power Slap YouTube channel at 9 PM EST / 6 PM PST.

metas.name: A Rock Without a Role
metas.description: Beau is in search of his purpose. Everyone else around him seems to know theirs. But with the help of his friends, Beau finds his true purpose was right beside him all along.

metas.name: An Enemy Within
metas.description: On his wedding night, Caleb Wingate is ordered to kill his father-in-law before midnight or his bride dies. As a deadly assassin closes in and family secrets erupt, Caleb must uncover the truth before the night ends in blood.

metas.name: Apollo and I
metas.description: An awkward college student catches the gaze of an intriguing girl, unaware that she’s secretly a bloodthirsty vampire.

metas.name: Ultimate Spider-Man: Origins
metas.description: After the horrific death of Peter Parker, a new Spider-Man emerges. 17-year-old Miles Morales, bitten by a radioactive spider, becomes the new wall-crawler the city of New York needs. All the while, on his journey meets an unlikely ally.

metas.name: Jacob's Savings
metas.description: Jacob is hit with a financial crisis that he tries to resolve through the teachings of his idol, Rick Alton.

metas.name: The Highland Boutique
metas.description: When a world-famous rapper offers a dream job for watching over a suitcase full of weed, a recovering addict must resist the temptation of relapse to leave her boring job at a vintage clothing store.

metas.name: Purple Summer
metas.description: Connell Byrne, an idealistic coal miner who sees the way the world could be, wants nothing more than to leave his small Appalachian hometown with his best friend Lee. However, Lee sees the way the world is, and there’s one obstacle that stands between them.

metas.name: That Sinking Feeling
metas.description: Misty awakes with a cold in a bed unfamiliar to her. At the foot of the bed, the owner of the place, Ashton, obsessively attends to her. He claims to have saved Misty from an accident in which she drove her car into a lake. Misty has no memory of this event and questions why she would act in such a way in the first place. Instead of easing her worries, Ashton leaves Misty alone so she can rest, but promises to check back in later. While trapped alone in the room, increasingly strange occurrences happen to Misty, and glimpses of the accident begin to surface. What truly happened at the lake? Who is Ashton, and does he know more than he lets on?

metas.name: Aliens
metas.description: Two members of a foreign species crash land near a prep school dormitory, invading it and attacking the students within. But nothing is quite as it seems.

metas.name: Behind the 8 Ball
metas.description: A financially troubled high school senior bets her future on a pool tournament, only to discover that the real game is deciding what kind of life she wants to live.

metas.name: A15
metas.description: No one knows what happened to West Point—only that it never let go.

metas.name: Open Taxi
metas.description: Jessie and Margot meet by chance encounter at a house party the night of their high school graduation. What follows is a summer of adventure, and a year that will reveal their feelings towards relationships and the futures that will get in the way of theirs.

metas.name: Top Hat - The Musical
metas.description: Based on the classic 1935 RKO movie starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, Top Hat is a sparkling romantic cocktail laced with witty comedy, stunning choreography and tap-dancing brilliance, brought to life on stage with lavish sets and gorgeous costumes. Irving Berlin’s irresistible score includes some of Hollywood’s greatest songs, including the immortal Cheek to Cheek, Let’s Face the Music and Dance, Top Hat White Tie and Tails and Puttin’ on the Ritz.  When Broadway star Jerry Travers arrives in London to open a new show, he crosses paths with model Dale Tremont whose beauty sleep is rudely interrupted by Jerry tap dancing in the hotel suite above hers. Instantly smitten, Jerry vows to abandon his bachelor life to win her – but the path of true love never does run smooth.  Put on your top hat, brush off your tails and let this joyous romantic musical comedy sweep you off your feet!

metas.name: Irving Berlin's Top Hat
metas.description: Inspired by the iconic 1935 movie musical starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, this acclaimed Chichester Festival Theatre revival recorded from the West End in January 2026 is directed and choreographed by three-time Tony winner Kathleen Marshall.

metas.name: Dad Lifestyle
metas.description: Carter embarks on a profound journey through the world of fatherhood.

metas.name: Scene of the Mime
metas.description: A wily group of criminals must return to the scene of their last crime to cover their tracks.

metas.name: Murmur
metas.description: In a shifting, dreamlike world, a young girl begins to experience a changing body and the strange feelings it brings along.

metas.name: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
metas.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

metas.name: The Accidental Renaissance of Steven Porter
metas.description: A man at the brink of existence. To be reborn. To become undone.

metas.name: Tokyo In 33 RPM
metas.description: A musical journey through Tokyo's Jazz Cafes.

metas.name: Agatha's Almanac
metas.description: Defying modernity, 90-year-old Agatha forges a solitary existence on her ancestral farm preserving heirloom seeds.

metas.name: Dire Duplicity
metas.description: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

metas.name: Driver's Ed
metas.description: A group of teens hit the road in a stolen driver's ed car, racing against time to help a lovesick high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

metas.name: A Guardian's Heart
metas.description: Jake Bishop has been an exemplary Executive Protection Medic with a distinguished career but life hasn't always been that way for him. There have been miscues, failures, wrong turns and one day he just decides to walk away from it all. His ex boss wants to hire him for one final mission together and when Jake senses redemption for all life's twist and turns, will they survive and can the thought of love save him just in time from a path of destruction. Only time will tell.

metas.name: Better Together
metas.description: Jesse, a broken-hearted high school senior, leads his best friends on a quest left by his father. Their search for the mysterious Zion Point and a legendary meteor shower becomes a journey of friendship, identity, and rediscovering hope.

metas.name: In the Grey
metas.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

metas.name: Drive On, Mr Otter!
metas.description: Timid Mr Otter is given one final chance to evict an elderly couple from their rural village home, or risk losing his own company issued housing.

metas.name: A Last Look at the Glen Cove Taco Bell
metas.description: Jimmy Mullen looks back on his childhood at the Taco Bell in Glen Cove, NY, as it gets ready for renovations, reminiscing about memories of coming to this spot after school and how lots of modern architecture is losing a lot of its character. This Taco Bell stands as one of the final locations on Long Island that had not been given a recent makeover.

metas.name: Enough Square
metas.description: Upon settling into a new town, an investigator encounters strange villagers, and a series of peculiar events unfold.

metas.name: Teen Gay Fairytale
metas.description: It's the height of promposal season and everyone at Small Town High School is dying to know which lucky lady will get asked by star lax bro Jax McCauley. But when the school gossips out him as gay, Jax finds himself peer pressured into dating the only other gay kid in school... even though they have nothing in common, and Jax is secretly in love with his best friend, Miller. This coming-of-age satire pokes fun at the way queer characters and romances are typically presented in mainstream media, while also aiming to normalize rather than sensationalize coming out.

metas.name: Candidates
metas.description: Nadia, a young adult grappling with loneliness, goes on a string of dates after her roommate and best friend, Lorelei, downloads a dating app to solve that problem, leading to a series of "bad dates." Until she meets Jack.

metas.name: Hope For The Guadalupe
metas.description: On July 4th, 2025, catastrophic flash flooding swept through the Texas Hill Country. The river rose more than 37 feet in a matter of hours, and entire communities along its banks were forever changed. In the days that followed, an extraordinary response unfolded. Search and rescue teams, volunteers, and organizations from across the state and the nation converged on the Guadalupe. As the land and river begin to recover, so too do the people who call it home.

metas.name: Dead Zones
metas.description: How does the abundance of HAB-forming phytoplankton species correlate with environmental and biological variables along the California Coast?

metas.name: Best Cinematography
metas.description: An experimental picture by lawson saby.

metas.name: Chet Rockwell & The Milky Mob
metas.description: Kipp Norman and his best friend, Margie sell black market margarine.  When Margie gets kidnapped during a deal, Kipp must enlist the help of the Midwest's most famous private investigator, Chet Rockwell to find his friend and expose the secret corruption of Wisconsin's dairy industry.

metas.name: N/A
metas.description: Emmy winner Holland Taylor and Broadway's Ana Villafañe star as two U.S. Representatives, generations apart, who couldn't be more different. Inspired by real people and events, the play N/A is a battle of wills and wits between N, the first woman Speaker of the House, and A, the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.  Filmed from Lincoln Center's Off-Broadway theater in August 2024, N/A is part of Theater Close-Up, a collaboration between THIRTEEN and New York City-area Off-Broadway and regional theaters, shining a primetime spotlight on a diverse mix of innovative theater productions.  Go behind closed doors as these two formidable women debate power, ambition, and change. N/A is written by Congressional aide turned playwright Mario Correa and directed by Tony Award-winning director Diane Paulus (“Jagged Little Pill”).

metas.name: Scissor Slasher
metas.description: Sapphic Horror Short Film

metas.name: I Created...
metas.description: Young woman has a epiphany after an hospital stay and feels compelled to live her dream.

metas.name: Bowling Bruce
metas.description: During a first date, a young man must try not to embarrass himself while introducing a girl to his best friend: Bruce, the bowling ball.

metas.name: Why is Nathan Missing?
metas.description: When his friend, Nathan, goes missing, Ellis tries to find him but only finds his answers making less and less sense.

metas.name: Dinner at Eight-Seventeen
metas.description: On their anniversary night, a couple sits down for dinner and confronts what the future of their relationship may look like after receiving news.

metas.name: The Busby Entanglement
metas.description: A film noir following a morally ambiguous French thief escaping the police.

metas.name: DOG DOG DOG
metas.description: A scarecrow and a pirate wander the desert looking for a boat before a cataclysmic flood wipes them out.

metas.name: The Sharp Edge
metas.description: After his father’s death, a young man continues to live under the weight of impossible expectations, questioning if he was ever truly enough for the man he tried so hard to impress.

metas.name: Summer Cruisin'
metas.description: Eddie Summers, the lead singer of Summer Cruisin', has been missing for 38 years until his hit song, “Midnight Knows My Name,” is rediscovered on social media. Looking for a way to online fame, Sean Campbell takes it upon himself to find Eddie and put on a show that will bring him back to the top.

metas.name: Kanto
metas.description: Kanto by Mary Francis Cheeseman is a 3D animated short film for The University of New Mexico

metas.name: Snowfall
metas.description: A lone gunslinger wanders a snow covered forest in search for something.

metas.name: The Bug
metas.description: Director Colby Schoetz makes an observation about the world around him only to have it shut down by a bug.

metas.name: Wishlist
metas.description: A man walks around a mall creating a wishlist made of various items.

metas.name: Acrophobia?
metas.description: A college-aged couple reaches a breaking point over his irrational fear of marginal heights.

metas.name: How to be Loved
metas.description: Through the lens of a 1950's educational video, we follow Oscar, a lonely yet romantic college professor, as he tries to understand how to be loved.

metas.name: People Like Ghosts
metas.description: A nighttime montage of strangers drifting through the city, People Like Ghosts is an experimental visual poem exploring modern isolation, silent routines, and the fragile distance between presence and disappearance.

metas.name: Prison of Light
metas.description: A man descends into a nightmarish digital world as he struggles desperately for human connection with a mysterious woman.

metas.name: Not Enough
metas.description: A young couple struggles with insecurities and anxiety while on vacation together.

metas.name: Apple Music Live: Lady Gaga MAYHEM Requiem
metas.description: For Apple Music Live, Gaga presents MAYHEM Requiem, a celebration and musical reimagining of MAYHEM.

metas.name: Excerpts of a Filibustered Friendship
metas.description: Two friends struggle to remain as such amid a radically shifting political landscape.

metas.name: Can't Hurry Love
metas.description: After a tough breakup, Xavier navigates his realationship with his best friend Amy, who obviously has feelings for him.

metas.name: Inspection
metas.description: A calculated stalker poses as a facility inspector and infiltrates a university to close in on his prey.

metas.name: The Day We Switched
metas.description: Chris and Jamie go through life without dealing with the consequences of their actions; until one day something powerful makes them walk in somebody else's shoes. AKA, a womans.

metas.name: Church Girl
metas.description: A discerning lesbian pretends to be Christian to score a date with the hot choir singer, finding herself at Bushwick’s oldest queer Bible study.

metas.name: Second Responders
metas.description: Second Responders is a short documentary exploring the emotional aftermath of the 2023 Lewiston mass shooting through the perspective of public school teachers. Often overlooked in conversations surrounding tragedy and recovery, educators were forced to become emotional anchors for grieving students while navigating their own fear, trauma, and uncertainty. Through intimate interviews and observational storytelling, the film examines the invisible burden teachers carry in the wake of violence and the quiet resilience required to return to the classroom after a community is forever changed.

metas.name: Hannah of the Dead
metas.description: Kicked out of her mother's house, Hannah meets Fred, who offers her a place to crash at his seductive Airbnb. In no time at all, she strikes up a relationship with her soon to become fr-enemies, Holly and Lee, betrays Fred, scams a scandal-ridden politician, irritates a nosy neighbor and no help from a bribed detective. With no shortage of suspects to choose from, the question remains - what happened to Hannah?

metas.name: Just One More
metas.description: A recovering addict, Jess, meets Charles, a dying man praying God will use him "just one more" time. As their lives collide, Jess battles shame, and doubt-discovering faith, forgiveness, and the hope to fight for a future beyond addiction.

metas.name: You & Me
metas.description: Dual-screen movie created by two artists where images come into sync and drift apart.

metas.name: Night Plane
metas.description: Local filmmaker Salise Hughes returns with a dream about clouds and lightning and travel.

metas.name: In the Heavenly Cutting Room
metas.description: A woman on her deathbed chastises her creator in this fusion of stop-motion animation and dreamlike live-action video.

metas.name: The Traveller
metas.description: A guilt ridden man goes back in time to find and kill the person who he believes ruined his life.

metas.name: Where Are You Alice?
metas.description: In a "potential" future, the True Purity Act is enacted in the U.S.A. for "societal protection," forcing all declared traitors to be removed from each state and forced into special "rehabilitation" facilities. THIS IS ONE OF THEIR STORIES…

metas.name: Ray of the Sun
metas.description: At 24 years old, Manny sets foot in the United States for the first time. This short story recounts a pivotal moment when Manny walked into Wildcard Boxing Gym and met legendary trainer Freddie Roach. It marks the beginning of their iconic partnership and chronicles Manny's journey from an unknown fighter to one of boxing's all-time greats.

metas.name: No Sex
metas.description: A college girl must navigate her unspoken feelings for her best friend — and race to protect her — when a drunken night spirals out of control.

metas.name: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

metas.name: Death of a Lion
metas.description: A  former leader in the Black Lion Party for International Solidarity shares his story of found family, loss, and transcendence. Shot over the course of two months, this short documentary provides a glimpse into the dynamics of modern American revolutionary movements. Jeremias' film captures a very brief, but important period of transition for the Black Panther Party  in the 2020s.

metas.name: Tunggu Sekejap
metas.description: Two people meet for the first time.

metas.name: The Golden Age
metas.description: Fictional silent film star Jack Valentine struggles to make the transition to talking pictures during the golden age of Hollywood.

metas.name: It's Cold!
metas.description: Two girls go swimming!

metas.name: Don't Doubt
metas.description: Five strangers. Five impossible beliefs. One chain reaction that proves they all have enough hope. except one… don’t doubt.

metas.name: Sonder
metas.description: Taking place in the same apartment complex, three individual stories explore the perspectives of three different stages of life. A young college girl who has just moved into the complex, a couple balancing life together, and an older woman whose son is helping her move out of the complex after the death of her husband.

metas.name: Rabbitfoot
metas.description: In the midst of the Vietnam War, four friends are convinced they’re safe from the draft. But, there’s one final wrench in the works… and it takes the form of a letter.

metas.name: Snail Mail
metas.description: A snail embarks on a long journey to deliver the mail.

metas.name: Moronic Courtship
metas.description: A young nerd who is foolish and bullied by fellow youths, finds a girl and falls head over heels but must face the harsh truth and be taught the true meaning of living from a one above.

metas.name: I'm Fine
metas.description: When her friend calls to check in, Tori is asked a simple question. We hear everything she would say: the anxiety, the feeling of being trapped inside her own mind and body, the exhaustion of it all. But when the moment comes, she says nothing. She never does.

metas.name: The Tales of Mission and Zaalbar
Bite Back
metas.description: At the end of their first date, Lexie tries to let Tristan down easy. Unable to handle the rejection, Tristan kidnaps Lexie to “teach her a lesson” with the help of his friends Luke and Kyle. However, their arrogance quickly wears off as they realize that they are in over their heads and they kidnapped the wrong girl.

metas.name: The Case of the Lipstick Killer
metas.description: Detective Sam Phelps and his partner Henry Vincennes try to solve a case of mysterious murders.  Written and directed by Brennan DeCow, produced by the Davis catalyst center

metas.name: Dance Fight
metas.description: Dance Fight is an action-comedy about a young man with a penchant for dance who enters the tournament of a lifetime against his long-time idol, the greatest dancer in the world!

metas.name: Matt "The Horror" Bilella
metas.description: A documentary that follows New York–born MMA fighter Matthew Biella as he prepares for his final fight.

metas.name: Meeting Yourself
metas.description: A young aspiring actor, Kevin Connors, is about to audition for the role of a lifetime—until he’s swept away by his older self: Connors, a time traveler determined to steer his younger counterpart toward a very different future.

metas.name: Withering Hellebore
metas.description: Bronte battles a giant monster who is keeping tortured souls

metas.name: Will of the Kirin
metas.description: Kirin may be sick, but he refuses to slow down. As the day unfolds, one question remains... will it be his last?

metas.name: The Lunch Table
metas.description: A group of friends sitting at their school lunch table discuss plans for their final two days before graduating high school.

metas.name: The Interdimensional Pickup
metas.description: Phineas, Winsley, the Gnomes, and the Minions embark on a wild interdimensional adventure.

metas.name: The Adventures of Slinger the Cowboy Rat
metas.description: Set deep in the desert, this three-and-a-half-minute short follows Slinger, a cowboy rat who duels supernatural creatures.

metas.name: Staring at Stairs
metas.description: Avid stair enthusiasts Ricky and Bobby go head-to-head in a heated race for president of the Albuquerque Stair Watching Community.

metas.name: Ride or Die
metas.description: A night out goes wrong when three girls have to face what to do when they kill a man. while also mending their friendship

metas.name: Relentless
metas.description: After the death of two brothers, Milo and Victor, who were best friends with a young cowboy, Jason. Jason faces struggles with faith and searches for life meanings, in the midst of becoming an adult. After many questions he soon comes to find God’s Relentless love.

metas.name: Polarity
metas.description: When a violent knock breaks the silence of the night, Jane comes face-to-face with the version of herself she buried, now she must confront her past to move into the future.

metas.name: Promise
metas.description: A story of a woman and her decision of whether to keep or break a promise to her dad

metas.name: Dumb Little Horse Hooves
metas.description: After Humpty Dumpty suffers yet another great fall, the King orders his horses to do the impossible... put him back together again.

metas.name: Crushed
metas.description: After a drunken night, Jack becomes convinced he fatally struck his sister with his car. Years later, the weight of that night still haunts his family as they struggle with guilt and grief inside the walls of their father’s business.

metas.name: Caught in the Act
metas.description: A reality TV finale is plagued by scandal and a heinous murder! Now that's good television!

metas.name: Cardboard Skies
metas.description: Cardboard Skies follows Ivy, a young woman fighting to keep her little brother safe after eviction leaves them living out of their car. When a run-in with their drug-addicted mother threatens to unravel the fragile life Ivy's been holding together, she's forced to make an impossible choice between family and survival.

metas.name: Black and White
metas.description: A couple’s relationship unravels through the sound of an electric guitar in this one minute animated short.

metas.name: BALD THE MUSICAL
metas.description: Arthur suffers from peladophobia, the irrational fear of bald people. He attends therapy, where we meet Brett, his therapist. In therapy, he relives his shiny-scalped nightmares, from failed job interviews to surreal exposure exercises that blur the line between dream and reality. As his treatment escalates into a full musical spectacle, Arthur must face the ultimate test: shaving his own head and joining the chorus of baldness he fears most.

metas.name: Hunt For Stoutfoot
metas.description: When University of Wisconsin Stout student, Scott Daniels' roommate goes missing, all evidence suggests he was taken by the creature known as Stoutfoot. Scott must embark on an adventure to find the beast and save his friend.

metas.name: Vanilla Willa
metas.description: A college student's night in becomes a fight for survival after his friends' love of soda goes a little too far.

metas.name: Gray Hound
metas.description: When a party animal grandma underestimates the power of drunk decisions, her family catches a glimpse of someone they never expected her to be, and she must overcome the fear of being vulnerable with her loved ones.

metas.name: Rx
metas.description: A slacker taking care of his ailing grandfather finds himself in over his head when he invites his best friend over to get high.

metas.name: Apophenia
metas.description: When a conspiracy shakes a small corporation, it’s up to one employee to discover the truth.

metas.name: Doll Parts
metas.description: When Magnolia becomes entranced by a make-up infomercial, her bottled up jealousy towards her friend, Florence, comes flowing out in a mixture of arguing, hallucinating, and creating.

metas.name: Bigfeels
metas.description: After being abandoned by their father on a winter camping trip, siblings Beck and Lexi must mend their relationship when a sought-after cryptid enters their lives.

metas.name: Flowerbags for Palestine
metas.description: In 2025, a young artist reckons with his past right-wing views and attempts to chart a new path through organizing a charity concert for Palestine.

metas.name: Two Balaclavas
metas.description: Two men, bound by grief, carry out a suburban home invasion to avenge a past crime, targeting the attorney who defended the killer. One’s all fire, the other’s all doubt, and neither is much help when things tilt sideways.

metas.name: Asking for a Friend
metas.description: Henry Ball, a struggling background actor, befriends outcast members of a friendship support group to help him navigate his new romantic relationship with an adult film star.

metas.name: One Party After Another
metas.description: After a difficult breakup, Hailey goes on a journey of self-discovery - by going to as many parties as possible.

metas.name: The Mimic
metas.description: In this ode to Maya Deren, a mirror man attempts to assimilate into the nature surrounding him

metas.name: Idol
metas.description: A devout young girl is tempted by the siren song of a mysterious musician.

metas.name: Crasher
metas.description: Everything is awesome at a crochet and liquor club, until... it's not...

metas.name: What The World Needs Right Now Is Passion
metas.description: After watching everyone around him get opportunities, a young actor, Jacob struggles to regain his former glory and make art while his world crumbles around him.

metas.name: Late Shift
metas.description: A potter has an unexpected late night encounter with her apprentice; their divergent personal lives stir up emotional friction.

metas.name: Fitted Sheet
metas.description: When the dryer cycle ends, a man is confronted with one of life's greatest challenges.

metas.name: Best of Luck
metas.description: A selfish and destructive android adapts to the life of a cowboy in the desert wasteland.

metas.name: Depresso
metas.description: A man in New York City spirals into performative masculinity and starts a support group to fix it—only to realize he never wanted healing, just an audience.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: Inspired by a visit with Orlando’s vibrant Moroccan community, Central Florida “arts instigator” Terry Olson travels to Rabat to uncover the human stories behind the 1975 Green March—when 350,000 unarmed Moroccan civilians crossed into the Western Sahara, prompting Franco’s Spain to relinquish its colonial claim. Through firsthand accounts and historical reflection, Olson and Moroccan director Ahmed Bouchalga explore the legacy of that pivotal moment and the decades of regional tension that followed. Olson also delves into the enduring, little-known bond between Morocco and the United States, whose diplomatic relationship stretches back to 1777, when Morocco became the first nation to recognize American independence. Timely and illuminating, this powerful documentary reflects on one nation’s struggle for independence amid the global pressures of decolonization, and the lasting lessons that continue to resonate today with those who choose to heed the call of freedom.

metas.name: Maid Robot 2
metas.description: A ruthless tech CEO plots to steal secret plans for a maid robot, sparking a high stakes battle over control of the technology.

metas.name: Am I Funny Yet?
metas.description: A comedian confronts his own thoughts of suicide on stage, turning his personal crisis into an uncomfortable comedy.

metas.name: [MV]
metas.description: I was supposed to make another music video but I couldn't. I couldn't do it anymore. I needed to make a weapon. A device I could finally torture myself inside of, for real, forever.

metas.name: A Chef's Tale: The Real Story of Duet
metas.description: A documentary crew follows two New York City chefs and the life of their restaurant, but when tragedy strikes, the crew must go down a genre-bending search for the truth.

metas.name: SPLAT
metas.description: A man falls in love with ice cream.

metas.name: Images: Making "Peter Hujar's Day"
metas.description: Documentary on the making of the 2025 film "Peter Hujar's Day".

metas.name: Muppet Treasure Scriptland
metas.description: The Muppet Script returns to bring you MUPPET TREASURE SCRIPTLAND! When most people think of the Muppets, they think of the colorful characters made out of fleece and foam. But as with every movie, it all starts on the written page. And before returning to the big screen, the Muppets team returned to the writers' room. Another literary classic was turned on its head when Muppets scribe JERRY JUHL skewered ROBERT LOUIS STEVENSON'S tale of nautical adventure, joined this time by KIRK THATCHER and JAMES V. HART, and directed once again by JIM HENSON'S son, BRIAN HENSON. This performance will be a treasure worth its weight in gold!

metas.name: Save the Pigeons
metas.description: The story of Fred Ferguson, whose mission to SAVE THE PIGEONS of the city of Chicago led to his ultimate demise, as captured by the legendary British documentarian Gary Gervais.

metas.name: Simca Vega Cricket
metas.description: Simca Vega Cricket are the automobiles that the actor Gail Fisher, the first Black woman to win an Emmy, as the secretary Peggy Fair, drove in the United States hit television show Mannix.

metas.name: The Beginning.
metas.description: An artist struggles to create a piece that resonates with her. Follow her along the journey.

metas.name: 100 Dates in Dallas
metas.description: A forty-something former actor navigates online dating in Dallas.

metas.name: Fisherman Documentary
metas.description: Three college students make a documentary about the fishing on Milwaukee River

metas.name: The Hybrids
metas.description: A thought-provoking documentary examining personal accounts of alleged alien abduction, hybridization, and non-human identity.

metas.name: The Family Recipe
metas.description: Alison is determined to host the perfect Thanksgiving dinner for her unpredictable family. But as traditions collide and tensions rise, the day quickly spirals into chaos. Between clashing personalities, unexpected distractions, and everything that can go wrong… going wrong, she’s left trying to keep the peace before the entire day falls apart.

metas.name: The President vs. The Fed
metas.description: President Trump’s unprecedented challenges to the Federal Reserve — and what it means for the economy. FRONTLINE traces the battle between Trump and the Fed as the central bank steers the economy through an increasingly precarious moment.

metas.name: The Mystery of Richard Simmons: A Diane Sawyer Special
metas.description: The beloved fitness personality's remarkable rise to fame; examining the cultural impact that made him a household name.

metas.name: I Just Wasn’t Made For These Times
metas.description: A student wakes up to a world that has moved on without him, drifting through fragments of memory and connection with only a bowling bag in hand.

metas.name: Treasure of the Lost Reel
metas.description: An out of work, fantasy-prone film preservationist finds the only print of a sought-after animated film that a corporate assassin has been sent to destroy.

metas.name: 20 Parts Per Million
metas.description: An emerging adult with Celiac disease hosts Thanksgiving with her intolerant family while trying to attain the funds that would cover her fiancé's life-saving medical treatment.

metas.name: Hundred-Proof
metas.description: An office clerk meets a god in a bar who assists him in reuniting with a lost love

metas.name: Jamie Vardy
metas.description: From part-time footballer to Premier League legend, this is the story of Jamie Vardy's unprecedented path and his rise to the top against all odds.

metas.name: 99 Names: My Liberation Is Tied to Yours
metas.description: 99 Names is an immersive, audio-visual story that combines sonic rituals of oral storytelling, recitation of the Quran, and calling on the 99 names of Allah to venerate the Divine. The film asks audiences to sit with the grief of colonization within the Afro-Arab diaspora and invites them to imagine how we can collectively hold, transmute and release this weight.

metas.name: Eauquation – Water Distribution at Douiret-Sbâa
metas.description: This documentary explores the ancient water system of Douiret-Sbâa, Morocco, a remarkable network fed by a local spring that has sustained the community for centuries. Highlighting the ingenuity of traditional hydro-technologies, the film examines how these systems continue to shape life in arid lands today.

metas.name: The Land Smiles Back
metas.description: For generations, the Samburu people and their livestock have had a deep connection with water, depending on the rains for their survival. The Land Smiles Back is the story of the Samburu community in Westgate Conservancy, who made the land “smile” again by returning to ancient hydrotechnology.

metas.name: Where the Water Meets Us
metas.description: The film shines a light on the long and rich history of Bonthe, a town on Sherbro Island, and the island’s immense contribution to the formation of Sierra Leone. Beyond celebrating its heritage, the film addresses the ongoing challenges threatening the island’s survival—climate change, mangrove loss, and rising sea levels—while highlighting a new generation rising to find solutions and safeguard its future.

metas.name: The Big Break
metas.description: A costumed mascot, fueled by an unyielding ambition to break into the entertainment industry, unexpectedly finds himself in a high-stakes situation: a chance encounter with a renowned Hollywood agent at a boisterous children's birthday party, where he must use his comedic timing and infectious energy to make a lasting impression, all while navigating a chaotic environment filled with cake, confetti, and the boundless enthusiasm of screaming kids…& Adults.

metas.name: Jurassic Ward
metas.description: A troubled employee for the “wishes come true foundation” needs to bring a dangerous dinosaur through the hospital to fulfil a child’s wish.

metas.name: Home Entertainment
metas.description: As television eclipses live theater in the early 1950s, a headlining tap-dancing showgirl is offered a shot at national fame - if she'll trade her artistic integrity for the constraints of the studio system.

metas.name: Still Water
metas.description: A small-town beauty pageant queen, trapped by scripted smiles and expectations of perfection, secretly finds freedom in fishing and must decide whether to maintain her poise on stage or reclaim her true identity before the State pageant.

metas.name: The Signature
metas.description: A mute Turkish wife imagines her future during a viewing of a cold and uninviting New York apartment.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.

metas.name: The Punisher: One Last Kill
metas.description: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

metas.name: A. Rimbaud
metas.description: Follows French writer Arthur Rimbaud from his schoolboy days in Charleville to his final years in Africa.

metas.name: Pink Ozs
metas.description: Khris, a shy lesbian haunted by a Greek chorus of judgmental church ladies in her head, must silence her internalized shame and confront romantic rivalry at her art gallery job to finally embrace her sexuality and pursue love.

metas.name: Joan's Teeth
metas.description: Every morning Joan wakes with blood in her mouth and wonders: is it mine? In an assisted living residence, she recalls lovers and old friends as her mutinous dentures remind her she is not finished yet.

metas.name: Cadillac DeVille
metas.description: In 1977, four mismatched teens  flee their dead-end Long Island town, colliding over identity, dreams, and the cost of freedom on the road to California.

metas.name: The Ballad of Max Thunderfist
metas.description: Seeking redemption for his violent past, martial arts master Max Thunderfist, gifted with extraordinary abilities, must rescue a little girl from his former boss and nemesis Mojave Mike and the Mojave Mob

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A short film about a game that challenges friendship, empathy, and the importance of legumes.

metas.name: Tsundoku
metas.description: An emotional hoarder since childhood, she has spent her life shelving the too big to handle emotions to process another day.  Every formative memory, from first crush to first messy heartbreak, are encapsulated in glowing orbs that she vomits, pickles, and tucks away on a shelf. She grows to realize that with each orb she puts away for safe keeping, she becomes more numb to her experiences. She has to lose nearly everything in order to realize there’s no way around but through.

metas.name: Dead Man's Hand
metas.description: The Devil has summoned four players, all playing to grant their greatest wishes, to the deadliest poker match on the face of Hell.

metas.name: Rubik
metas.description: In 1975 Erno Rubik invented the Rubik's cube. It took him a month to solve it.

metas.name: Koda
metas.description: After graduating from college, 23-year-old Malcolm returns to San Diego to find a whirlwind of memories and emotions, and an invitation to his ex-girlfriend’s concert.

metas.name: Hit Me Harder
metas.description: A former boxer takes on one more fight after his brother dies in the ring

metas.name: Meet Me at the End
metas.description: A teenage girl comes to a crossroads when she's manipulated into feeling that she must choose between her sexuality and her faith.

metas.name: N’Dobine
metas.description: "N’Dobine" follows a traveler navigating his heart and past, guided by ritual and spirituality, as an unforeseen obstacle tests his journey of offering.

metas.name: SIGNAL
metas.description: A pair of astronauts on a rescue mission discover a strange signal coming from deep space.

metas.name: Threadbare
metas.description: A boy crowns himself as king, unaware his kingdom is already losing someone.

metas.name: Ann Wilson – In My Voice
metas.description: Chronicles the life and career of the HEART lead singer. It features intimate, in-her-own-words storytelling, utilizing personal archives, home movies, and journals to explore her five-decade journey as a trailblazing rock vocalist.

metas.name: Into Sound
metas.description: A conceited guitarist, insecure about his mark in the world of music, isolates himself in his apartment to write a masterpiece. But as time passes and inspiration wears thin, his sanity spirals, and his body undergoes an unexpected transition.

metas.name: B
metas.description: Rules: 1. I must click on every video in my photobooth application 2. In chronological order 3. No skipping 4. How little or long I stay in the video is my choice 5. One take 6. After the first screen recording 7. Factory reset laptop 8. Delete 9. Delete 10. Delete 11. Sell to stranger the same day

metas.name: Again Again
metas.description: After reliving the same day over and over again for 10 years, Agatha awakens to realize she's escaped and now faces the horrifying reality of a brand new day.

metas.name: Evergreen
metas.description: A quiet character mosaic hinged on a shy German traveler in the fading town of Evergreen, New York.

metas.name: A Fistful of Hours
metas.description: Cowboy hat-wearin' high school juvenile known as The Kid must fulfill his missing community service hours in order to graduate. The twist? Kill school-wide outlaws in exchange for hours. Will our protagonist be able to restore all his hours before it's too late? Will a notorious wrongdoer not caught for ages stand in his way?

metas.name: Everlasting
metas.description: Everyone wants to leave something behind. For sculptor Cornelius Pepsi Lyon, this is the driving force behind his creativity. Over the past four decades, he built the largest sculpture garden in America made by an individual artist, with over 800 pieces of his work scattered around his 40 acre property. Everlasting is an examination of Cornelius’ life’s work and the very nature of what inspires us to create.

metas.name: The Fool Always Wins
metas.description: On Christmas Eve, a man in crisis is invited to his neighbour’s apartment for dinner.

metas.name: Gilded Rage
metas.description: In the wake of being deferred from her Ivy League dream school, a spoiled Manhattan teenager throws a murder mystery party for all of her friends.

metas.name: Between the Islands
metas.description: At summer’s end, a father and his two sons share a day under the influence of San Pedro, where fleeting moments of connection give way to the realization that their time together is running out.

metas.name: Bloodline
metas.description: While seeking refuge with her estranged brother's family after a horrifying incident, a vampire comes face-to-face with the cycles of violence that shaped her childhood.

metas.name: Lacuna
metas.description: A young woman revisits an underground party in Athens in hopes of reconnecting with her elusive ex. What she finds out there, however, is a fever dream of her erasure.

metas.name: What Happened to Janet
metas.description: Locked in their apartment during a global pandemic, two roommates descend into madness among a fantasy world, but as they are constantly interrupted by the increasingly distressing abuse of their elderly neighbor, they decide they must avenge her.

metas.name: Poachers
metas.description: In the wake of her mother’s death, 12-year-old Maura struggles against her repressed family and domineering godmother to rescue the sanctity of her mother’s memory.

metas.name: skimmer
metas.description: When Mila, a 20-something charismatic shopaholic, buys stolen credit card information on the dark web for a blowout shopping spree with her boyfriend, Theo, she gets more than she bargained for. The consequences of her addict consumerism will change her and Theo forever.

metas.name: Beyond the South
metas.description: In a mist-covered mountain village, a young woman's life begins to shift with the arrival of two wandering musicians, as their fleeting melodies awaken her to the invisible ties between the living, the land, and the spirit.

metas.name: WINDBURN
metas.description: A farming couple in rural Indiana struggles to make it through the holidays on the one-year anniversary of their son’s suicide.

metas.name: Raghs (Dance)
metas.description: A single diaspora Iranian man seeks connection and belonging at a lively family & friends party.

metas.name: Astor
metas.description: A tense game of control spirals into violence when a boy’s rebellion against his domineering stepfather leads to a devastating accident.

metas.name: Thieving Days
metas.description: A lonely, hungry and ill-equipped French cowboy is travelling through an unknown land and find himself without food nor company, save for his beloved horse Fidéle. On a quest to find both, he passes a village where no one speaks his language. Meanwhile a pair of musicians sing of his endeavours.

metas.name: Howl
metas.description: In an overgrown abandoned factory, an overlooked 11-year-old mimics his older brother’s cruelty to finally be seen– until his first taste of power goes too far.

metas.name: Two Sides, One Coin
metas.description: When a high school senior, Ava, visits her older sister before graduation, their close relationship is tested as they unravel the unseen ways their parents shaped them.

metas.name: L'Improv
metas.description: The leader of a struggling improv group convinces them to perform a sketch that he wrote and pretend it’s improvised in a desperate attempt to save them from eviction.

metas.name: Woksape: Wisdom
metas.description: On Pine Ridge Reservation, a Lakota boy opens a portal to 1876 and witnesses his ancestors fighting to protect their songs, discovering that memory itself is a form of resistance.

metas.name: Glance
metas.description: A struggling photographer's fragile bond with his visiting mother fractures during her brief stay in New York.

metas.name: Bronx Girl
metas.description: A sheltered young adult in Yonkers escapes her strict, religious mother to have a wild night with a friend.

metas.name: There is No Wind
metas.description: A mysterious sonic boom rumbles above Taipei, prompting Ssu-Ning, an orchestra conductor, to reflect on the meaning of music. Simultaneously, her concert faces cancellation due to an impending typhoon.

metas.name: Hot Girl
metas.description: A plus-size woman wears a bikini to the beach for the first time, where a chance encounter with a young stranger forces her to face how she sees herself.

metas.name: The Void
metas.description: Dom lives in a bleak reality. After the government mistakenly declares his grandmother dead, he struggles to restore her Medicare insurance before it’s too late.

metas.name: Hannah at the Table
metas.description: Hannah goes to her widowed father’s apartment to meet his new girlfriend. When he makes a surprising announcement, she must decide whether to stay or go.

metas.name: Self-Tape
metas.description: A Hungarian filmmaker sets up a pop-up portrait studio on the streets of New York, where eager pedestrians step in like it’s a public audition. The quick encounter escalates into confessions and a collective reflection on self-image.

metas.name: Didukh
metas.description: A Ukrainian chef pours everything into one Christmas dinner to win over investors and save her restaurant dream — but as the night unravels, she finds that the only person who truly sees her is the stranger who delivers her flowers.

metas.name: Girl Egg Rocket
metas.description: A young girl in a small town finds a fragment fallen from the sky and carries it through the night, trying to return it to where it belongs.

metas.name: Teen Spirit!
metas.description: An intimate peek into a pregnant teenager’s life on the reservation as she considers moving away from her chosen and biological family as her looming due date encroaches.

metas.name: Second
metas.description: A teenage air-rifle athlete tampers with his rival’s rifle to secure a place in the provincial trials—only to discover that the real distance between them cannot be measured in points.

metas.name: Mississippi Sunrise
metas.description: In rural Mississippi, Mike and Lucky - uncle and nephew - must confront the memory that’s divided them when Lucky returns home to dig for the treasure he buried with his late cousin years ago.

metas.name: Crawling Hour
metas.description: Over the course of 24 hours, an immigrant's quiet struggle for dignity collapses into violence, testing how far he'll go to provide for his family.

metas.name: Blood Orange
metas.description: Four days before the sun dies, a milk delivery man falls for another man's wife.

metas.name: Big Dogs
metas.description: Desperate to earn the respect of a new group of friends, middle schooler Carl submits to a series of escalating humiliations, pushing him to confront how far he’s willing to go for a place to belong.

metas.name: The 8th Actor
metas.description: An unknown young actor cast only as a corpse seizes his chance to shine when he single-handedly performs all seven roles in a hit play, sparking both acclaim and deadly envy among his fellow cast members.

metas.name: Rewired: Identity in the Age of Mass Distraction
metas.description: In an age where everyone is connected, our identities start to become shaped by a second life online. Our story follows the patterns of thinking and shared experiences brought upon by a digital world. Many generations are following unwritten rules and guidelines on how to act online, which affect their interactions.  Childhood is not the same as it once was, due to an all-consuming digital landscape. The lack of accountability and empathy that exists with the world's future generations has led to an uptick in mental health crises and people feeling more isolated than ever. If we are so connected, then why is there silence?

metas.name: Homogenized
metas.description: The process of homogenization of milk shown through various vignettes.

metas.name: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes: Ugly Baby
metas.description: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes shines in her 7th comedy special, exploring the adventures of family dynamics, embracing her current stage of life, and becoming a first-time mom in her later years.

metas.name: My Name Is Roscoe
metas.description: Roscoe, a man who displays a lack of empathy and excitement for the world around him, takes us through the final days of his life. A bartender by trade, Roscoe doubles as an information broker to pay the bills. After sleeping with the wife of a criminal kingpin, he ends up selling the exact info that would lead to his murder throughout an absurdist series of events.

metas.name: Uncovering Amy Hennig's Uncharted 4
metas.description: Reconstruction of the original vision for Uncharted 4 through extensive research into developer files, cut content, and internal concepts from before the project was extensively reworked in 2014.

metas.name: Freya
metas.description: A week before his wedding, Nick Foster's dreams are haunted by a woman in white.

metas.name: Do You Love Me?
metas.description: Katie's mind spirals into alternate scenarios, each shaped by a different answer to the same impossible question.

metas.name: Chuck & Charlie Got Into A Scrap
metas.description: Two friends, Chuck and Charlie, are brought back together by a third friend, Chip, begging them to reconcile after the two had an outlandish fight regarding Charlie's favorite show.

metas.name: My Sweet Pala
metas.description: Born to Tibetan immigrant parents in America, 11-year-old Pema has always felt the protective embrace of her close-knit community, and the overprotective eye of her father, Kelsang. However, an unexpected incident reveals the harsh realities her father has been shielding her from, and Pema begins to understand the complexities of her minority status in society for the first time.

metas.name: Wall Wizards
metas.description: Wall Wizards follows a young couple, Jamie and Brooke, as they move into their first home together. They’re expecting a fresh start, not a magical infestation. When their belongings begin to mysteriously disappear, they uncover a hidden world of tiny, mischievous wizards living inside their walls. What starts as a cozy move-in day quickly turns into curiosity, chaos, and unexpected magic.

metas.name: The Soul of Africa
metas.description: Set against the Festival of Black Divinities in Togo, this captivating documentary explores the origins, resilience, and contemporary relevance of African spiritual traditions before and beyond Christianity and Islam.

metas.name: Caleb
metas.description: A grandson attempts to connect with his Nigerian grandmother as the woman he once knew quietly begins to fade.

metas.name: Whispers Next Door
metas.description: Suzanne hides her daughter’s shocking secret to protect their family, but when their charismatic Pastor takes a disturbing interest in the baby, their lies ignite a chilling battle between faith, control, and truth.

metas.name: The Roast of Kevin Hart
metas.description: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

metas.name: We Corrupted Few
metas.description: A BroHo documentary that tells the story of 4 schmucks, and how they sought to change the Overton Window by creating bizarre videos and pushing a philosophy of loving the corrupted.

metas.name: Blooky: The Book Who Wanted To Be Read
metas.description: A brand-new little book gets lost in the vast maze of a grand library and journeys through every section in search of where he belongs, only to realize that the most meaningful place to be isn't always where you fit in best.

metas.name: Cat-Tasrophe
metas.description: While searching for his missing cat, Conrad meets an unlikely friend.

metas.name: The Good Assassin
metas.description: A naive contract killer becomes the roommate of his apathetic target, who he must find the strength to dispose of by the end of the week or face the wrath of the highest authorities of the criminal underworld.

metas.name: The Ryan Rooms: Pilot
metas.description: Follow a group of friends that find themselves exploring the creepy newly abandoned basement, before quickly finding that they are trapped inside with a savage cannibalistic monster. Will they escape, or will they be picked off one by one by a killer, and have their story end in Ryan’s Rooms?

metas.name: The Dao of Thao
metas.description: Performer Thao P. Nguyen prepares for her next comedy show while struggling to remain true to herself as a queer Asian American mother in the face of constraining social, cultural, and familial expectations.

metas.name: New Life: The Movie
metas.description: New Life is a raw and authentic faith-based coming-of-age story about a college student navigating his relationship with Christ and all the bumps and struggles that come with it. The story follows Peter, an African American college freshman who is struggling to believe in Christianity. After experiencing a traumatic breakup, Peter begins to question his life, purpose, and identity. He blames his Christian upbringing and decides to walk away from his faith during college. At freshman orientation, we are introduced to Melissa, a college sophomore and enthusiastic follower of Christ. She is a student leader at a Christian fellowship group on campus called New Life. When Melissa meets Peter, she invites him to join the fellowship. After hearing his doubts, she compassionately challenges his unbelief.

metas.name: BIG MEAT
metas.description: A pair of siblings try to take down a mega-corporation by making an exposé documentary in the middle of the night!

metas.name: Cultural Capital: African Art, Restitution, and Repatriation
metas.description: Exploring the repatriation of African Art and how it stolen loot was reframed ar African art by art dealers

metas.name: Un Niñx De Dos Mexicos
metas.description: In my first time returning to Mexico, I revisit old memories of childhood, exploring my journey as a Chicano. Understanding ever further what was sacrificed to give me & my siblings better opportunities. Un vida mejor, and return no longer wondering; "What if I was born in Mexico?"

metas.name: Interlocked
metas.description: An inventor tries to parent her wall-powered robot son. When he tries to discover a world beyond the boundaries she designed for him, she has to choose between keeping him safe and letting him live on his own.

metas.name: Come Clean
metas.description: A man finds himself in a sticky situation.

metas.name: Young Man
metas.description: A young man fulfills his teenage goals before he becomes an old man (20)

metas.name: Piano Hands
metas.description: An experimental retelling of the tortured artist, structured around four elements: water, people, landscape, and night. While the narrative is fictional, the film originated from a story my father told me about encountering a dead body in the woods as a child.

metas.name: Miss Matched
metas.description: After a messy divorce, an architect who believes his rare skin condition makes him undateable hires a quirky matchmaker—sparking a partnership that forces them both to rewrite their own rules on love.

metas.name: On The Road
metas.description: In the early 1970s, young hippie Julie James embarks on a solo road trip to pursue her dream of being a singer, but quickly realizes she is in way over her head.

metas.name: Altar Boys After Mass
metas.description: Two deviant altar boys in masks of Saint Peter and Saint Paul investigate a hidden memoir written by a group of former altar boys.

metas.name: Seat at the Table
metas.description: In immersive vérité style, Seat at the Table follows several prominent South Asian political candidates during the 2024 election cycle, alongside a community galvanized by the groundbreaking campaign of the first South Asian presidential candidate. Within a hundred years, South Asians in America have gone from being disenfranchised, to seeing the first South Asian presidential candidate on a major party’s ticket.  With unprecedented access to congressional and state-level campaigns, as well as grassroots organizing efforts, the film captures a historic year for the South Asian diaspora as more candidates than ever run for office, providing us a rare front-row seat to an immigrant community awakening to its power in America.

metas.name: Procedures
metas.description: Simon Liu, 2026

metas.name: Who Smoked The Bones of Saint Jerome?
metas.description: When an ambitious priest is passed over for a coveted parish, his jealousy drives him to sabotage an innocent deacon, triggering unintended and miraculous consequences.

metas.name: Palos Verdes Landslide Complex
metas.description: At disparate points during the landslide of Palos Verdes, a man's generator loses power and a woman hikes down a cliffside.

metas.name: The Exchange Rate
metas.description: After a bank heist, two criminals try to escape the law, sparking a chain of emotional, financial, and romantic fallouts that forces three different stories to collide in unexpected ways.

metas.name: ONE HOUR PARTY
metas.description: Landon and Sky try to host a party...

metas.name: pennies
metas.description: A journal-paper doll is visited by his friend.

metas.name: Beast Mode
metas.description: All Mark wanted to be was a superhero but he became a monster instead.

metas.name: Spring Cleaning
metas.description: Compulsive hoarder Jannette dies in her home, and her estranged daughter Beth must come back and deal with the mess.

metas.name: Hoop Like This
metas.description: Explores the emotional and physical demands placed on the world’s first professional Indian basketball team as they pursue history. India does not allow dual citizenship, meaning generations of elite athletes of Indian heritage have been ineligible to represent the national team across all sports.

metas.name: dEATH
metas.description: In a rain-soaked city, a cynical private eye hunts a serial murderer who's mutilating privileged men, only to confront his own jealousy and insecurities.

metas.name: Homecoming
metas.description: A small town's annual ceremony is put in jeopardy after a reluctant high school senior is selected as the winner. As expectations mount, he must decide whether to continue his town's violent tradition or break free from it.

metas.name: Under a Million Stars
metas.description: Experts and homeless neighbors alike bust myths about Seattle’s homelessness crisis in a deeply reported, humanistic dispatch from the front lines. Homelessness was declared a civil state of emergency in Seattle in 2015. Since then, the number of people sleeping outside has actually risen by more than 67 percent. Chezik Tsunoda's documentary Under a Million Stars, which received the Satterberg Foundation's Courageous Documentary Filmmaking Grant, is a deeply reported yet humanistic dispatch from the front lines of this crisis. Armed with facts and empathy, the film busts pernicious and all-too-common myths about homelessness.

metas.name: short stop
metas.description: Short Stop is a short film about a kid with cystic fibrosis trying to join his college baseball team but can't due to his condition and needs to find a new meaning for his life other then baseball

metas.name: All's Fair in Love and Mahjong
metas.description: Ronni is living a full life as a school nurse and mom, hosting a longtime mahjong game with her best friends Shelley, Carly, and Melissa. But when her daughter leaves for college, everything shifts at once. Her hours get cut. Her ex is pushing to sell the home she loves. And suddenly she's staring down an empty nest wondering what comes next.

metas.name: One Last Detour
metas.description: After agreeing to drive him to a job interview, Dean reconnects with his old friend Travis.

metas.name: Love, Again
metas.description: Caroline and Henry's 30-year marriage faces upheaval when he's diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. As Henry's memory deteriorates, Caroline finds comfort in friendship with Leo while coping with losing her partner.

metas.name: dawn
metas.description: Torn between the girl he loves and the future he’s always dreamed of, a boy must make the difficult decision of whether he should leave or stay.

metas.name: In Her Care
metas.description: A poetic exploration of the Black healthcare industry through the personal history of Philadelphia nurse Patricia Curtis.

metas.name: When Nigeria Happens
metas.description: Misfit dancers Fagbo, Pokko, Lighter, Movement, Colos, and Poppy are bound by art and friendship. When Fagbo's mother falls ill, their world shifts, testing their dreams, loyalty, and what it means to fight for a future in Nigeria.

metas.name: Mabuhay
metas.description: An artistically inclined college sophomore struggles to balance the traditional expectations of her Filipino mother with finding a fulfilling vocation. Along the way, an unexpected reunion with her estranged cousin allows her to test the boundaries of her burgeoning adulthood.

metas.name: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
metas.description: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

metas.name: The Male Experience
metas.description: Remy tries to hop on the game, but life gets in the way.

metas.name: The Giggle Minute: The Pilot
metas.description: The year is 2026, and the world has fallen into a dystopian hellscape. In this state of chaos, two geniuses, Professor Doctor and Doctor Professor, finally crack the code to time travel and go back to find ancient philosophers in the hope of saving the world together.

metas.name: In the Mood for Ghosting
metas.description: Adoration turns to delusion for Jonathan when Maggie suddenly stops responding, hurling him into pastiche and melancholy.

metas.name: Heartstone
metas.description: A grieving widow reflects on the last gift she received from her late husband.

metas.name: Kings County
metas.description: After decoding a ritualistic clue found on a dead MMA fighter, a young, untamed detective infiltrates Brooklyn's underground fight world to unravel a string of murders.

metas.name: Moto Nineties: Rub Some Dirt on It
metas.description: Go behind the scenes of the wildest era in motocross

metas.name: subhuman
metas.description: A man orders food from a delivery app.

metas.name: The Trail (La Trace)
metas.description: A woman decides to go camping with her friend to help overcome her lingering anxiety. It only intensifies when she meets a passerby on the street.

metas.name: The Prankening 2
metas.description: One year after the tragic prank war Dave and Alex find that a new prankster with that same jacket has come to terrorize them once again

metas.name: Sentimental Value
metas.description: Dr. Rick Nelson, a victim of the Oklahoma City bombings, learns what it feels like to live in an alternate reality.

metas.name: Limelight
metas.description: Following an encounter with the Irish Mob, an Actor (Theo Creager) copes with his new life inside the Witness Protection Program.

metas.name: Swim for Me
metas.description: Seventeen-year-old Darcie believes she is responsible for the drowning of her younger sister, Stella. As she begins seeing visions of Stella that blur the line between memory and reality, she must confront the truth about what really happened, before her guilt consumes her.

metas.name: The Librarian Stops the Drug Problem
metas.description: A 90 year old Librarian and her intern must team up when they find out that someone has been stashing drugs in their library.

metas.name: Knights of the Old Republic: Escape from Taris
metas.description: An engineer and war veteran must save a Jedi Knight from a blockaded world.

metas.name: Vampire Variety Hour
metas.description: Vampire Variety Hour presented by FirstName Watkins brings you a variety of exciting story segments that go exactly as planned.

metas.name: Flamingo's Cousin
metas.description: The artist's interpretation of a longtime institutional feud within the School of the Art Institute's film program.

metas.name: The Silence of the Inner Circle
metas.description: A troubled group commits a heist.

metas.name: SUMMER TOUR '25
metas.description: A documentary about the EveryHeart tour, with a specific focus on the impact and heart behind our 2025 outreach.

metas.name: I'm so tired of being me
metas.description: It's hard to be the same person doing the same things over and over again every single day. Sometimes you need something to pull you out...

metas.name: England's Next Top Prince Consort
metas.description: England’s Next Top Prince Consort turns Elizabethan politics into a chaotic reality competition as Queen Elizabeth I momentarily abandons statecraft to evaluate a lineup of suitors—Philip II of Spain, the Duke of Anjou, Charles II of Austria, and the ever-intrusive Robert Dudley—under the dubious guidance of judges Walsingham, Cecil, Dudley, and a confused Shakespeare. Confessionals function as court intrigue, alliances form and implode, and a cryptic lady-in-waiting named Balthazar quietly tracks every secret. Assassination rumors, theatrical entrances, and relentless scheming pile up as each contender fights for the queen’s hand and the power attached to it.

metas.name: Bobby Rahal: True American Racer
metas.description: Fox Sports documentary celebrating the life, legacy and 1986 Indy 500 victory of the legendary driver and team owner, chronicling his journey from fighting for opportunities to becoming a three-time CART champion and influential IndyCar team co-founder.

metas.name: Inebriated
metas.description: One crazy party goes totally wrong when a masked killer is on the loose.

metas.name: Call Girl
metas.description: A broken hearted Gilbert meets his ex-girlfriend’s doppelgänger, an ethereal phone sex operator who exists inside of his television.

metas.name: Smardiez
metas.description: Smallz tries to earn money for his grandmas dying wish before she goes to hell. So why not make money by selling Smarties?

metas.name: HIVEMIND
metas.description: When a dysfunctional friend group finds an abandoned bunker hidden below the surface, they find a videotape that is the key to a twisted government secret. This discovery prompts them to explore the bunker again, resulting in the group's downfall.

metas.name: The Sale
metas.description: It’s 1993 and Sita has recently immigrated to California. She is desperate to make an encyclopedia sale as a first step to learning how to sell and starting her own business. Her lack of commissions have cost her family comfort and weigh heavily on her.  As pressure mounts, she goes out to her 3 leads for the day and attempts to make a sale. Met with frustration, fear and humiliation, she fights every urge to give up.

metas.name: Pool Drain
metas.description: Short horror film about the horrors of the pool drain

metas.name: Amara:The Statue
metas.description: Amara (Maureen Ruby Jackson) has spent a hundred years standing perfectly still in the center of the City Museum. To the tourists, she is just a beautiful statue—but when the clock strikes twelve, she breathes. Amara is a girl of gold and magic who can only stay "awake" as long as there is music playing.  As she explores the quiet halls of the museum, she meets other pieces of history that come to life, but she longs to see the stars outside. Featuring magical, orchestral-pop songs and a "frozen-in-time" dance style, Amara is a sparkling adventure about freedom and finding your voice in a world that expects you to stay silent.

metas.name: Blood Night
metas.description: On Halloween night a couple gets lost in a maze

metas.name: Werewolf Summer
metas.description: A lone hitchhiker must survive the night as she becomes the subject of a werewolf's hunt.

metas.name: The Secrets of the Matriarch
metas.description: Danielle travels to New Orleans to meet her grandmother and uncover the truth about her mother's death. Drawn into a dangerous feud with the rival Benoit family, Danielle learns her mother’s death was no accident and must navigate treachery, uncover secrets, and decide whether to destroy both families' legacies to find justice.

metas.name: Give Me Back My Baby
metas.description: When a couple chooses a surrogate for their baby, they unknowingly open the door to an obsession that could cost them everything.

metas.name: Crime, Love, and Soda.
metas.description: A wannabe detective finds himself looking for love after a chance encounter with a fortune teller.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time the Documentary
