metas.description: The making of a street legend. From Compton to the Hills, Once Upon a Time the Documentary follows Jay Worthy through the grind, the glory, and the making of a moment. Go behind the scenes of the album, step into real-life stories, and witness raw conversations with the figures who shaped the journey.

metas.name: Mera Lyari
metas.description: A story resilience, identity and the courage to rise, even when the odds are stacked against you.

metas.name: My Girlfriend Turned Into a Worm
metas.description: When his girlfriend inexplicably turns into a worm, Arthur builds her a miniature world in an attempt to process his grief.

metas.name: Scratch
metas.description: A lonely woman aspires to be a beatboxer.

metas.name: The Doghouse
metas.description: Brothers Steve and Stu scramble to put on a last-minute birthday show for Steve’s daughter - because if they fail, Steve’s in the doghouse and Stu might end up… dead.

metas.name: Halal Bodies
metas.description: Several Muslim Americans reflect on how familial, cultural, and societal pressures shaped their worldviews on the topics of sex and relationships.

metas.name: Murphy Hates Humans
metas.description: The plucky angel Theo tries to convince his pessimistic, ex-assigner Murphy that humans are worth caring about.

metas.name: Sleeping Dog
metas.description: Investigative journalist Jeremy Corbell emerges as a key figure in a dangerous fight to uncover the truth about UAPs, driven by rare access and knowledge few possess. As his pursuit deepens, so do the risks of exposing what was never meant to be seen.

metas.name: Together in Song: A Community in Music
metas.description: How does being in a choir benefit different phases of peoples lives? From being in school, to adult life after school, to elderly life, this documentary shows light on how people can continue to make music and be in a community, such as a choir.

metas.name: Suffs
metas.description: Created by Tony Award winner Shaina Taub, this musical recorded from Broadway tells the story of the American suffragist movement and the remarkable friendships, heartbreak, and action that brought women together—or, in some cases, tore them apart. The ensemble cast features Taub as Alice Paul, Tony winner Nikki M. James as Ida B. Wells, Tony nominee Jenn Colella as Carrie Chapman Catt, and Grace McLean as President Woodrow Wilson.

metas.name: Broad Trip
metas.description: When buttoned-up daughter Alice plans a “bachelorette” road trip with her wild and impulsive mother, Jeanie, to talk her out of marrying a guy she just met, they rediscover their unbreakable bond, confronting old wounds and old flames, while learning the lesson that sometimes life doesn’t follow a plan — and maybe that’s okay.

metas.name: Another Man's Wife
metas.description: A millionaire makes a shocking offer to a married couple in crisis, who are financially devastated and caring for a terminally ill parent. What begins as an act of survival spirals into a high-stakes emotional reckoning about trust, love and the ultimate cost of sacrifice.

metas.name: Neglected
metas.description: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: Little Lamb
metas.description: After her parents' death, Lily moves into the vacation home they left for her and discovers she's far from alone.

metas.name: Takeover
metas.description: Guy Miller is on parolee and trying to rehabilitate his life, but circumstances bring him back to the dangerous Atlanta. And he must live up to his reputation as one of the slickest street operators in a deadly race against the clock.

metas.name: Camp Salvation
metas.description: What happens when such blasphemous work is discovered at a Christian summer camp??

metas.name: The Unitrix Saga Movie
metas.description: Kyo and Ryzen's journey nears its end as they transcend time and space to stop Unitrix at all costs.

metas.name: Mr. Eclectic
metas.description: A performative male goes to a library to show off, but things don't go as planned...

metas.name: Patton Oswalt: Tea & Scotch
metas.description: Follows comedian Patton Oswalt with new takes on parenting, living with a cat who sees ghosts, yard cleaning videos, artificial intelligence, and more.

metas.name: autism is an altar
metas.description: Three vignettes across three generations of japanese americans explore the intersections of incarceration, ableism and anti-Asian racism from the perspectives of a first-generation Issei woman at Angel Island Immigration Station, a second-generation Nisei woman incarcerated at Amache “War Relocation Center” and a fourth-generation Yonsei’s process of autism diagnosis.

metas.name: Home Visit
metas.description: A queer couple prepares lunch for one of their mothers, hoping the meal might change her mind about their relationship.

metas.name: Enjoy the View
metas.description: A recollection of memory in honor of caretakers everywhere.

metas.name: The Magic Words
metas.description: In Nazi Germany, a Jewish father gives his son "magic words", his only shield against the horrors of war.

metas.name: Shadow of Hope
metas.description: Far from home, a young Burmese man struggles to escape the weight of a brutal and unforgiving military coup, threatening both his nation’s freedom and its very survival. Now, in Australia and unable to return home, he’s doing everything he can to stay connected to his people.

metas.name: Made With Love
metas.description: Inside a top-secret government facility, Agent Boro, an intense and serious veteran, along with his partner Agent Maltrax, the dimwitted newbie, question and interrogate Talon Penndle, a disgruntled and laid-back coffee barista who wants to go home after his eight-hour shift. Talon is under fire, however, because he is rumored to have overheard a huge government secret from one of the other agents during their coffee break, which could mean mass panic if it were to get out to the masses.

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: Yo (Love Is a Rebellious Bird)
metas.description: After losing her friend Yo, Anna builds a detailed 1/3-scale version of her friend's house. It is just big enough for Anna to squeeze into, and inside lives a puppet of Yo. When the pair first met, Yo was 73 and Anna 24.

metas.name: Gangland
metas.description: A weathered tribal cop and his new trainee must find a ruthless fugitive, whose return to their rural Indigenous reservation has exposed its darkest secrets and could ignite a violent gang war.

metas.name: ROOM TONE: The Sound of 'The Room'
metas.description: The production sound mixer and boom operator on Tommy Wiseau's "The Room" trade war stories from their time in the trenches alongside the man, the myth, the legend.

metas.name: Embrace
metas.description: A year after her father’s funeral, a Korean American daughter returns home for the first time to find every trace of him erased. As she tries to talk about loss, her immigrant mother turns to faith, and the two collide. Before leaving, they sit at the same table and recognize they have been grieving in different languages.

metas.name: Pescador
metas.description: Parallel stories of two siblings. One follows a marine biologist searching for a mythical sea creature in Costa Rica, who perhaps has dark intentions. The other follows her shipwrecked older brother who is saved by a Costa Rican fisherman who believes he has found his new son.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
metas.description: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

metas.name: Michael
metas.description: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

metas.name: Me & My Big Mug
metas.description: A 23 year old corporate door sales employee navigates her day before getting lost inside of her childhood rug.

metas.name: Shattered Silence: Imitation of a Perfect Life
metas.description: Pastor Edmond Henry's appears to have the perfect life. But when a mysterious murder shatters the calm, his darkest secret is exposed, unleashing a chain of events that unintentionally destroy his family and everything he fought to protect.

metas.name: Lone Rider
metas.description: After stealing his dad's old '89 Mustang, a lonely millennial drifts through midnight summer drives, fleeting reunions, fractured friendships, old regrets, and the pull of roads that keep leading him back to the life he's trying to outrun.

metas.name: Ramy Youssef: In Love
metas.description: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.

metas.name: Yuki Johnson - Detroit's Vigilante
metas.description: In racially divided Detroit, Yuki Johnson, a biracial teenager, transforms into the Detroit Vigilante after his father, a police officer, is targeted by a menacing gang.

metas.name: Return to the Moon
metas.description: A half-century after American astronauts walked on the Moon, NASA and its international partners are taking the dream of Apollo a giant step further. In the coming years, the Artemis missions – named after Apollo's twin sister in Greek mythology – aim to bring astronauts back to the Moon and establish a lunar space station for scientific and commercial exploration. Follow the four members of the Artemis II crew as they embark on a perilous 10-day journey to orbit the Moon, venturing beyond Earth orbit for the first time since Apollo and farther into the Solar System than any humans have gone before. And get an inside look at the preparations needed to overcome the extreme engineering challenges of human-crewed spaceflight, all the way from launch to splashdown.

metas.name: Don't Make Me Bless You
metas.description: Don't Make Me Bless You is a gripping urban drama about Raine, a salon owner who falls for Dre, a charming ex-con rebuilding his life after prison. a dangerous cycle of control and violence, forcing Raine to confront the truth about love.

metas.name: Providence
metas.description: Erica Schreiner short.

metas.name: Brad Wenzel: Desperate Times
metas.description: Full stand up special from comedy's own, Brad Wenzel.  Brad Wenzel is a product of the Detroit Comedy scene, spent a 7 year stint in Los Angeles, and over the last 15 years has toured the country performing in 38 states. Wenzel has made 3 stand-up appearances on CONAN and more recently performed on Netflix is a Joke Radio and Don't Tell Comedy. His 2017 debut comedy album Sweet Nothings was released on Jack White’s rock label, Third Man Records and can be heard on SiriusXM. Paste Magazine described Brad’s 2023 special, joke. joke. joke. as “Watching Wenzel feels like hanging out with your funniest, weirdest friend; it's relaxing and utterly enjoyable" Paste also listed joke. joke. joke. as one of the 20 best comedy specials of the year.

metas.name: My Other Half
metas.description: In this tense urban thriller, grief opens the door to danger as Mia becomes the target of a calculated scheme, forcing her to outplay her predators before they finish the job they started.

metas.name: CROSSED
metas.description: A young lady is seemingly going "crazy" while being tormented by and unknown source, when attempting to confide in her boyfriend and friends they slowly withdrawal from her "nonsense"

metas.name: Dragongate USA: The Gate Of Sin City
metas.description: High-speed technical wrestling and legendary tradition collide in the heart of the desert as Dragongate USA presents The Gate Of Sin City, a premier event held at the Horseshoe Las Vegas as part of The Collective 2026.

metas.name: PoderMania~! 2026
metas.description: The ‘Power of Lucha' ignites the Las Vegas Strip as PoderMania~! makes its high-octane debut as part of The Collective 2026. Streaming live on TrillerTV+, this afternoon spectacle at Horseshoe Las Vegas kicks off the Wednesday festivities of The Collective and TrillerTV's Mania Week.

metas.name: Mouthful of Soil
metas.description: Trees, Flowers, Hands and Mirrors. An exercise in movement and focus. Black & White, Silent.

metas.name: The Loud House: European Adventure
metas.description: The Louds are headed to Europe, where they'll attend a knighting ceremony in London, search for the world's best pizza in Italy, spend a night in a creepy castle in Transylvania, ski the Swiss alps, and time-travel to ancient Greece!

metas.name: The Bunny Mask
metas.description: The main character has a completely normal life, until one day a strange bunny mask appears on their bedside table. No matter what they do, this mask will not go away. The mask begins to deteriorate along with the main character's life.

metas.name: Trip Ziggurat
metas.description: A road trip to a Ziggurat in Colorado sparks connection between Arabs in the state. Filmmaker, Usama Alshaibi, embarks on a journey to the Crestone Ziggurat. His personal pilgrimage intertwines with the stories of other Arabs in Boulder who find ways of bringing their homelands to the state.

metas.name: The Ovvlog
metas.description: Documenting a group of thespians as they traverse NYC, visionary director Ovcharov takes the audience up close and personal as we see their triumphs... and their pitfalls.

metas.name: Dreams
metas.description: Plagued by stressful dreams and wrestling with grief, an anxious man reaches out for help from a—let’s say—nontraditional mental health provider.

metas.name: The Proctor
metas.description: A 56-year-old man stuck repeating senior year since 1986 gets one last shot at graduation when a new state exam system forces him to face the test he's spent decades avoiding.

metas.name: VAPE SHOW (1-3)
metas.description: A snapshot into the lives of several people living in small town Minnesota.

metas.name: The Black Bart of Taco King #17
metas.description: A suave larcenist searches for a new partner at a dive bar and finds the perfect Bonnie to his Clyde. He takes her to dinner to put her to the test, yet she has all the answers... and more.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: Two friends, Alex and Jordan, reflect on their past, one last time.

metas.name: Know Who You Are At Every Age
metas.description: An excerpt from a dream

metas.name: Artemis: To the Moon and Back
metas.description: The inside story of the Artemis II mission - filmed over three and a half years at NASA. How did four astronauts travel to the moon, going deeper into space than ever before?

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

metas.name: The Hollywood Rabbi
metas.description: How does the child of immigrants, raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, become Frank Sinatra’s personal rabbi, win two Academy Awards, mingle with four kings, three popes, eight presidents and a who’s who of Hollywood royalty while dedicating his life to healing the world through tolerance?

metas.name: The Straight & Narrow
metas.description: A young man realizes that post-graduation life isn't all it's cracked up to be. As he struggles to adjust to the mundane nature of the 9-5, he questions life's true meaning and the value of a dollar over one's goals and dreams.

metas.name: The Happiest Time
metas.description: A man looks back on his childhood.

metas.name: Betting On A Dead Man
metas.description: Benny Grimm is a well-renowned mafia boss who runs the streets of Gilbert. But one night, everything changes.

metas.name: Delirium
metas.description: Jude, tormented by a relentless dream, has each night stolen by fear everyday consumed by exhaustion. His avoidance then search for understanding descends him into madness.

metas.name: Dual Citizen
metas.description: In 2012, the Haitian government amended the country’s constitution to allow dual citizenship. Filmmaker Rachelle Salnave is eager to reclaim her Haitian citizenship, but the process is far from simple: To do so, her father, Edouard, must reclaim his first before she can. Edouard, a New York Republican who has not set foot in Haiti in more than 50 years, reluctantly agrees to help his daughter, which means engaging with a country and government he has kept at arm’s length since his family’s political exile in the 1960s. This humorous and heartfelt documentary is both a father-daughter road trip and a meditation on what it means to hold two national identities.

metas.name: Capio
metas.description: An amateur astronomer discovers a strange new star in the sky that leads him into the heart of a dark conspiracy to control humanity by exploiting its addiction to technology.

metas.name: Tag! You’re It!
metas.description: One night in an art museum, Sunny and Pippin, two girls living inside of the paintings, play a game of tag spanning the history of human art.

metas.name: Fly
metas.description: A queer coming-of-age romance about Skylar, a young Black ballet prodigy navigating the cost of perfection. A scholarship student at an elite ballet academy, Skylar channels fear and the weight of expectation into absolute discipline. When their mother falls behind on tuition, and the academy announces a paid professional apprenticeship, Skylar’s pursuit of excellence becomes a matter of survival. Their carefully controlled world is disrupted by Jay’ko, a gifted classmate whose free-spirited artistry contrasts sharply with Skylar’s precision. What begins as rivalry slowly deepens into intimacy, challenging Skylar’s belief that greatness comes from control alone. As the final audition approaches, Skylar must decide whether to cling to perfection or risk vulnerability in pursuit of artistic freedom.

metas.name: Birthday Boy
metas.description: Rae is an artist going through an identity crisis. They’re unsure of their gender, struggling to find success, and starting to feel a little invisible. Today is Rae’s birthday, and when their father Jeff comes to visit, along with his troubled wife Mandy, things start to deteriorate. Tragedy strikes the house within minutes, but Jeff insists that they stick to the birthday plan: a family meal at his favourite Mexican restaurant. As the day goes on, Rae fights to hold the family together, comfort their grieving partner Alice, keep an eye on the increasingly-drunken Mandy, and deal with the non-stop stress of Jeff’s personality, all while being ignored and misunderstood by everyone around them; until the tension bursts and they finally confront their father, with awkward results.

metas.name: A Homecoming
metas.description: Doug, a newly transitioning trans woman, has yet to take a new name. When she returns home with her pregnant partner for her parents’ 40th Anniversary, her mother unexpectedly struggles. Recognizing the fear behind the resistance, Doug extends to her mother an extraordinary gesture of grace.

metas.name: The Connection
metas.description: When three roommates discover their everyday items start going missing, they each try to figure out the source of the mystery.

metas.name: Lost In Thought
metas.description: After finding a photo of a girl in the pocket of a vintage Coat, Charlie introduces himself to the love of his life. As he dates the love of his life, Hope, he must decide whether a relationship with her is reality, or is it all in his head.

metas.name: COACH
metas.description: After receiving some tough news from her upset mother, Ellie gains a mentor in the midst of trouble.

metas.name: Copper Oxidizing
metas.description: The gradual transformation of copper through oxidation reflects the spirit of deconstruction, turning material change into a metaphor.

metas.name: The Climate Change Volumes: Fall
metas.description: Following the changing seasons of the Mountain West, The Climate Change Volumes: Fall ponders fall’s delay as warmer summers extend and keep this transitory season from occurring during its normal time on our calendars.

metas.name: what does it feel like to live inside of a pomegranate?
metas.description: A young woman discovers a giant pomegranate in the middle of the forest and decides to live inside it.

metas.name: Stay Until You Can’t
metas.description: Two women must navigate a growing relationship and a zombie outbreak that turned only straight people.

metas.name: Kenopsia
metas.description: After falling into the strange liminal world of her own canvas, struggling artist Alex must revisit her past and confront her fears in order to find her way home.  Inspired by liminal spaces and The Backrooms, Kenopsia was written to explore the phenomenon of liminality and what happens when we go through stages of liminal space in our real lives. Liminal space isn't just physical, we enter periods of liminality in our lives whenever we transition from one life stage to the next, e.g. graduation, coming of age/adolescence, breaking up, marriage, pregnancy, moving house, grief. Liminality is something we will all experience at some point or another in our lifetime, and as such it's important to know how to navigate and grow from the experience. After all, you wouldn't want to be stuck in limbo forever would you?

metas.name: Three Angles
metas.description: On the night before the Final Four, a rising college basketball star relives the same dream across shifting timelines. Trapped between past, present, and potential, he must overcome his deepest fear before it costs him everything. This non-linear psychological drama explores identity, trauma and the silent struggle with mental health in the athlete community.

metas.name: Dreaming Ecosystems
metas.description: A collaborative botanicollage film poem by participants in the festival workshop, Dreaming Ecosystems, led by poet Mita Mahato and filmmaker Caryn Cline.

metas.name: Joe Dombrowski: Dad on Arrival
metas.description: In his latest special, Joe Dombrowski steps into his biggest role yet...Dad.  Filmed live at Olsen Run Comedy Club in Eugene, Oregon, the hour captures Joe on the brink of fatherhood as he and his husband prepare for their first child, while realizing he may be wildly unprepared. With his signature sharp wit, Joe dives into the chaos of IVF, the shock of how little he knows about the female anatomy, and the trend of babies being given names better suited for retirement communities. He also hilariously tackles the question every gay couple hears: “So... who’s the dad?”

metas.name: Ruins Within Ruins
metas.description: A group of dancers positions themselves between the ancient and modern ruins of the island of Crete, Greece.

metas.name: Grandpa's Graveyard
metas.description: After the death of his father, a young TV writer must face his family’s trauma head on with the help of his new assistant, Gary the Horse.

metas.name: Coming Back Home
metas.description: A short documentary that reveals the background to the historic restoration of Money from Home.

metas.name: NOTHING WILL COME OF NOTHING
metas.description: Nurture, nature, voicemails, photographs.

metas.name: 12 Angry Men
metas.description: A juror attempts to convince the other 11 jurors to question the guilt of a 16 year old boy accused of killing his father.

metas.name: Caught in the Crackdown
metas.description: FRONTLINE and ProPublica trace the violence, protests and arrests stemming from federal immigration sweeps across the United States. The documentary examines the tactics, legal cases and impact — from Los Angeles to Chicago to Minneapolis.

metas.name: The Story of the Cricket Queen
metas.description: The “Story of The Cricket Queen” recreates digital media tropes, trends, and aesthetics with analog film techniques.

metas.name: Vaivén
metas.description: Vaivén follows three generations of beachgoers from sunrise to sunset in Barcelona - a study of patterns, rhythm, and the natural cadence of a day at the beach.

metas.name: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
metas.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

metas.name: Modern Art
metas.description: A withdrawn security guard drifts through life until an encounter with an artist sparks a quiet awakening, leading him to begin exploring where his own sense of art might lie.

metas.name: The Birthday Gift
metas.description: In this playful, cross cultural family drama, an unexpected guest upends the lives of an Argentine mother and daughter over the course of an intimate birthday dinner one icy Chicago night.

metas.name: Florence is for Lovers
metas.description: A fragmented encounter on a Tuscan train leads to an unsettling meditation on intimacy, violence, and communication in this part-travelogue, part-city symphony.

metas.name: Untold: Jail Blazers
metas.description: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.

metas.name: what does it feel like to live inside a pomegranate?
metas.description: In ‘what does it feel like to live inside a pomegranate?’ Iranian-American filmmaker Kamyar Mohsenin transforms a giant pomegranate into a portal. The protagonist ambiguously consumes the fruit in interludes, reflecting the tension between nourishment and the discomfort of engaging with one’s cultural heritage.

metas.name: Special Op: Rent-a-Cop
metas.description: After falling in love and leaving Special Ops, special agent Brock Belfry finds himself working security in a small town and ends up escorting a van full of senior citizens to Las Vegas for their summer trip. But the trip will not go smoothly as he realizes that his archenemies have tracked him down and plot to take him out.

metas.name: HVAC
metas.description: In a blue-collar Missouri town, a 13-year-old HVAC apprentice grappling with confusing desires becomes entangled in a surreal, dangerous encounter at the local theatre—where longing and innocence bleed together in one irreversible night.

metas.name: First Date Conversations
metas.description: Zoe and Scott's first date is upended when she receives a difficult phone call about her estranged father. As the two delve into questions of morality, family, and conviction, the night becomes a self examination of choices and old wounds.

metas.name: The Highest Stakes
metas.description: Five strangers are invited to a luxurious hotel for a high-stakes poker game. What begins as a contest for fortune quickly spirals into something far more dangerous. As tensions rise and secrets surface, the players realize the stakes aren’t just about money—they’re about survival. In a night of escalating peril, trust becomes a weapon, and every choice could seal their fate.

metas.name: Once a Week for Life
metas.description: NYPD Lt. Adam Galanis leads the Fugitive Task Force as he tumbles through a merciless life while balancing on a razors edge. Adam fights personal demons and addictions when he's forced to take revenge on plotting traitors and the mafia who are trying to kill him.

metas.name: Rise of the Conqueror
metas.description: In the 14th-century, as the Silk Road crumbles and rival factions tear the land apart, fearless warrior Timur emerges from exile. Stripped of everything, he fights to unite the fractured kingdoms, using strategy and sheer will to carve an empire from chaos. Undefeated in battle and widely regarded as one of history’s greatest military leaders and tacticians, not to mention one of its most brutal, Timur would found the Timurid Empire, which ruled over modern-day Afghanistan, Iran and Central Asia.

metas.name: Hansel and Gretel
metas.description: A comedic music take on the classic Grimm’s fairytale.

metas.name: Loss
metas.description: Amy is having the worst day of her life. Her 16-year-old daughter, Emma, is finally undergoing a heart transplant after waiting over two years. As Emma fights for her life, Amy sits alone in the hospital waiting room, overwhelmed by fear, exhaustion, and a deep anger towards God. She tries to pray but can’t find the words, consumed by rage at the unfairness of it all.

metas.name: Hearts
metas.description: A mob boss casino owner and his apprehensive daughter have a deadly conversation over a game of Hearts in this student produced 1920s drama.

metas.name: Blue Girl
metas.description: A queer coming of age film, that follows a girl named Olivia as she struggles to hide her relationship from her mother Carrie.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: Narrated by Javi, the only family member able to cross the border, Hope revisits his parents' migration story and the difficult reality that keeps them from returning home.

metas.name: Treasure Reboot
metas.description: Lincoln and his friends go on an adventure to find his grandpas hidden treasure.

metas.name: Queer Blue Sky
metas.description: After realizing many of the best parts of their relationship were maybe kind of queer, Beth and Chris decide to break up in a queer way too.

metas.name: Hand
metas.description: Trapped between duty and despair, an undocumented Chinese cook begins to question the cost of survival in a country that sees him as invisible as anti-Asian aggression rises outside his kitchen walls.

metas.name: For You
metas.description: Jordan (Demarcus Jackson) enters a time loop after a masked man breaks into his house, sending him on a trip backwards in time.

metas.name: Sudden Death
metas.description: Obsessive film professor Charlie is one long-take away from realizing his magnum opus film, SUDDEN DEATH. As problems spring up left and right, Charlie begins to put into question his legitmacy as a director and person.

metas.name: Brandie Posey - Milk Job
metas.description: Brandie Posey's debut comedy special

metas.name: The canticles of a ghost,
metas.description: In a single, unbroken drift through the night, a solitary figure moves between fragments of life—intimacy, conflict, and celebration—never quite entering any of them.

metas.name: Five Stages Until
metas.description: When her husband chooses to stop treatment, a grieving woman leans on dance to survive the silence, while her daughter struggles to bridge the gulf between denial and acceptance.

metas.name: The Last Hand
metas.description: Down on his luck, a single father stumbles into a casino in hopes of winning big to support his daughter. Things take a dark turn when he follows a mysterious dealer deeper into the casino...

metas.name: Baby Cigarette
metas.description: for anyone who's ever been a baby... or a cigarette

metas.name: Forgive You
metas.description: Since the death of his wife, Marla, Henry just can’t seem to find life funny anymore. And yet, he must come to terms with the reality of a life even God himself seems to be laughing at.

metas.name: Sympathy
metas.description: A man tries to come to terms with a crime he committed

metas.name: the road where i go to die
metas.description: A short abstract visual poem of a film about the grief a guy experiences driving through the road his best friend lived on before committing suicide.

metas.name: The Forest of Oscar Geppetto
metas.description: A further exploration of how Oscar Geppetto views music and reality. A sequence cut from the original film.

metas.name: shoemotion
metas.description: comprised of over 1600 photos, this short films follows a converse on an adventure

metas.name: If You Really Love Me, Outlive Me
metas.description: The colourful life of Texas honky-tonk hero Dale Watson and his wife, Celine Lee - a Miami-born ex-playboy bunny turned singer. Stars of their very own southern fairytale, Dale and Celine formed a magnetic bond that went beyond their love for the rockabilly scene and inserted itself into the mic between them, launching a life of lyrical adventure. Across a landscape where Americana roots defy commercial trends and keep the soul of country music alive, we travel with the electric duo from Texas dancehalls to Memphis landmarks, meeting the characters and communities that shape their unapologetically free life.

metas.name: Riding the Rails with Geoffrey Baer
metas.description: For generations, seemingly all paths led through Chicago as trains carrying passengers, livestock, and freight crisscrossed the country. In a new WTTW special and companion website, Riding the Rails, lifelong train enthusiast Geoffrey Baer hops aboard all kinds of trains to tell the story of this essential mode of transport and how it shaped our city. Along the way, he uncovers clues all around us to railroads of the past, recalls the colorful characters who built them and the unsung workers who toiled on them, and reveals why our current rail system is just as vital to Chicago’s existence today.

metas.name: The Falicornia Institute of the Rats
metas.description: Four ambitious acting students hone their crafts at the prestigious Falicornia Institute of the Rats.

metas.name: The Heartbreak Kid: Becoming Shawn Michaels
metas.description: Follows the life and career of WWE performer Shawn Michaels, tracing his rise, personal struggles, and eventual comeback with an unfiltered look at his journey.

metas.name: Stay for the Q&A
metas.description: Following a feature film premiere, at a prestigious film festival, a routine Q&A devolves into a familiar and unhinged experience.

metas.name: Hungy Ghost
metas.description: 'Hungy Ghost' is an emotionally unhinged comedy set in Earth's last botanical garden starring a ghost who is prone to bouts of world-destroying imposter syndrome every time he tries to prove his worth to others.

metas.name: Clean Slate
metas.description: A woman confesses her biggest secret to the man she loves at the most inopportune time.

metas.name: Embrace
metas.description: When a bar bathroom hookup takes an otherworldly turn, two men must work through their problems to move forward.

metas.name: Wasteland Cop
metas.description: After avenging the death of his family, an ex-soldier wanders through a post-apocalyptic landscape fending off nomadic tribes that prey upon outsiders. During his travels he meets an odd group of survivors, who convince him to become the law in a land where there is no law.

metas.name: Henry
metas.description: Montana and Henry have broken up, but now it's October and they are trying something new.

metas.name: Roommates
metas.description: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.

metas.name: A Royal Romance in Ibiza
metas.description: After a painful breakup with her ex-business partner, Dylan Harper, a talented American developer, is determined to prove herself on her next big contract - creating a luxury wellness hotel for His Royal Highness King Edward on the breathtaking island of Ibiza. The opportunity is a dream come true for Dylan - until she comes face to face with the king's son, Prince Nicholas, a dashing bachelor with his own ideas on how to execute the hotel project.

metas.name: Boris Is Dead
metas.description: A struggling actor, working as a waiter, unwittingly becomes involved in a violent heist gone wrong, where his boss—deep in debt—has been stealing from employees and running the restaurant as a front for the mob.

metas.name: Slowburn Shoot: An Indie Wrestling Story
metas.description: Documentary that goes behind the curtain, exploring the intimate relationships and untold stories that shape the pro wrestling industry.

metas.name: Deep in My Heart is a Song
metas.description: An aging country musician who's struggling to make ends meet receives an offer for an unusual private gig. Based on the life of cowboy singer Johnny Bencomo, who plays himself in the film.

metas.name: Private Browser
metas.description: Jane questions her boyfriend's attraction to her after seeing porn on his phone.

metas.name: The Patchwright
metas.description: In the sprawling slag heaps of NiiroCradle, a fugitive android visits the Patchwright, an unlicensed body mechanic, begging him to trace a fragment of a childhood memory.

metas.name: Our Song
metas.description: Through the highs and lows of life, Hank and Sarah's love story is forever tied to their special song. What begins as a tune that sparked their love becomes a bittersweet echo of what was. Some songs never end - even when love does.

metas.name: So Glad We Never Met
metas.description: Cheeto dust is just the surface of this dark satire... while the name Bentin Barantino may seem familiar to you, Flossie, a young female film student, knows him all too well.

metas.name: This Is Private
metas.description: A stripper cunningly decides to use her private dances as therapy sessions in order to prevail in her collegiate psychology class.

metas.name: Jaylah
metas.description: After receiving a text from her crush, a naive 17-year-old must choose between looking after her grandmother and losing her virginity.

metas.name: The Despicable Speeder-Man
metas.description: A masked vigilante saves the day, and nothing bad ever happens.

metas.name: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
metas.description: Brad Williams is back with his fourth stand-up comedy special LIVE ON SHORT STREET!  A fearless, high-energy hour packed with outrageous true stories, brutally honest observations, and nonstop laughs from one of the most electrifying comedians in the world.  Filmed live in front of a sold-out crowd in Lexington, KY, Brad dives into everything from relationships, marriage, and fatherhood to disability, sex, therapy, and the absurd realities of modern life. With razor-sharp punchlines and explosive storytelling, this special proves why Brad continues to sell out theaters around the globe.

metas.name: Paid For
metas.description: A woman pays for an hour in a hotel room, but not for what you’d expect. What unfolds between two sisters is a confrontation neither of them is ready for.

metas.name: Johnny Bronson
metas.description: A rage-bait streamer is reached out to by next-door neighbor, forcing him to confront his views on humanity. Also he's an alien from outer space sent to get humanity to destroy itself, so conflict is inevitable.

metas.name: Low on Fuel
metas.description: A tumultuous meeting between supposed friends leads Mike on a path of self discovery that lands him in the wrong place at the wrong time.

metas.name: The Grossfarken and the Boy
metas.description: Despite stories of a monster upstream, a young village boy ventures into the creek and discovers the truth behind his town's lore.

metas.name: Structural Changes
metas.description: A camera moves through the architecture of the renowned private art school, California Institute of the Arts, while a man touches up paint on the neglected exterior. Somewhere inside, the upper administration drafts increasingly dire emails to send to its faculty and staff.

metas.name: Exquisite Corpse
metas.description: Inspired by the surrealist game of "exquisite corpse," the film pieces together the story of a Harris mud crab who is a new species in the waters of the Baltic Sea since 2011. The film unfolds a layered story of "invasive species," disrupted ecosystems, and the questions they raise about human values in a world of constant environmental flux.

metas.name: Chew This!
metas.description: Influenced by Yoko Ono's 1964 performance "Cut Piece," the film is an explosion of energy, anger, and spirit that explores sexual exploitation and violence against female/femme bodies. Short, fast, and sweet like an angry spitfire punk song, blink and you'll miss the show!

metas.name: My Structuralist Film
metas.description: How shall I cater best to your desire for me to be visible? Set up as a confessional-cum-guided meditation, My Structuralist Film uses performance artist Tehching Hsieh's One Year Performance (“Time Clock Piece”) as a framework to illustrate the filmmaker's (presumable) insides. How thoroughly should a trans body want or need to be visible? On what terms is the filmmaker obligated to narrativize, perform, or even fabricate visibility for the sake of an audience? Considering the limits and limitations of disclosure, this project positions the act of looking not as an offering or an exchange, but as an unyielding neoliberal, capitalist thirst to consume.

metas.name: A is for Apple
metas.description: A semantically unstable encounter with objects, images, and words.

metas.name: I Feel At Peace Thinking Of Today
metas.description: After going through a painful period, ceramicist Heloisa Guedes underwent a transformation that came from the inside out. She left behind the hectic pace of the city for a new life in São Luiz do Paraitinga, in search of a reconnection with her own needs. Little by little, she began to live in alignment with what felt meaningful to her: self-care, artistic expression and being close to nature.

metas.name: The Following Day
metas.description: It's a sweltering summer in New York. Morgan, a soft-spoken young woman prone to daydreaming, finds refuge inside the cinema where the boundaries between fantasy and reality blur, on screen and off.

metas.name: Betty St. Clair
metas.description: When an anxious Chinese American drag queen hosts an all-AAPI showcase for an unconventional audience, a surprise guest sends her spiraling into self-doubt. Meanwhile, backstage shenanigans from her chaotic drag family threaten to derail the whole show.

metas.name: Kit
metas.description: A teenager with dwarfism is hidden away from an unforgiving world by his superficial mother but discovers that his talent for drawing can set him free.

metas.name: Cleaned Out
metas.description: In this twisty comedy, a maid who works for a mob boss must stand up for herself when he refuses to pay the money he owes her.

metas.name: The Eye
metas.description: In this sly comic zinger from Director Deanne Bray, a hearing Hollywood casting agent is having no luck casting a Deaf role authentically. When an actor named Frank (played by John Maucere) walks in, however, the casting agent gets more than she bargained for.

metas.name: MAINTAINED
metas.description: A maintenance worker goes deep into an overgrown forest to inspect an abandoned watchtower site. As he dutifully records his findings, he is surprised when the forest seems to start sending him messages.

metas.name: Fluent
metas.description: A quirky new hearing employee joins a Deaf-owned business and quickly begins to drive her boss crazy.

metas.name: Medal Chase
metas.description: Meet Rudolfs Stupans, one of the top Deaf competitive swimmers in the world. This exhilarating film follows Rudolfs as he gives us a glimpse of his training routine and what drives him to push forward to the top of his game.

metas.name: From Invisible To Invincible
metas.description: This upbeat self-portrait chronicles the personal journey of Donald M. Falls. Born Deaf and raised without adequate support, Donald transforms into a confident young man with pride and purpose.

metas.name: The Power of Goodbye
metas.description: Margot is a woman whose health is slowly degenerating from ALS. When she asks her mother Christiane to help her end her life on her own terms with dignity, Christiane is forced to confront a profound challenge to her maternal love.

metas.name: Wait and Remain
metas.description: Eddie Reyes wakes in an unfamiliar room with no memory of how he got there. Guided by an unnerving presence, he's drawn through fragments of his life in a space that defies explanation. As reality fractures, Eddie must face who he's been, and who he might become.

metas.name: Scout’s Honor
metas.description: Desperate to attend the concert of their dreams before heading off to college, two friends join the legions of a fake girl scout troop in hopes of earning the money in time.

metas.name: The Axe Forgets
metas.description: Inspired by a true a story. In 1888 James S. Jameson, heir to the Jameson Whiskey dynasty, returns to Ireland after a year long expedition to the Congo. Things start to unravel as he attempts a return to normality. Will he choose to face the truth? Or will he choose the axe once more?

metas.name: Unfinished Work
metas.description: Eric Chavez has a heart of gold, a magnetic personality, and a knack for telling stories–but the young artist and his vibrant family are haunted by the shadow of a past tragedy in this dreamlike, observational documentary that was filmed over 12 years.

metas.name: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
metas.description: Fantastica Mania USA 2026 was a professional event co-produced by American promotion Major League Wrestling (MLW), Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on April 12, 2026 at Festival Hall in Charleston, South Carolina, USA.

metas.name: Vermilion
metas.description: Haunted by the memory of his mother's death and suffocated by his father's controlling grip, an obsessive painter ventures to the brink of madness in his pursuit of artistic perfection.

metas.name: Ten Thousand Reasons for Revenge
metas.description: After a struggling single mom's daughter takes money from a dying bank robber, the two become entangled in a tense investigation that threatens everything they love.

metas.name: After Words
metas.description: An ambitious actress and a disillusioned writer meet by chance, igniting a fragile romance that forces them to confront jealousy, insecurity, and the sacrifices love demands.

metas.name: Castration Movie Chapter iii.ii Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
metas.description: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

metas.name: AEW Dynasty 2026
metas.description: Dynasty 2026 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on April 12, 2026, at Rogers Arena in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The show was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship, dubbed "The Devil vs. The God of Pro Wrestling."

metas.name: Jerry the Ginger Eater
metas.description: A man who eats red-headed women befriends a sex worker in hopes to eat her red-headed lady pimp.

metas.name: Legends of the Lost Ark
metas.description: Chronicles archaeologist Dr. Chris McKinny’s search for the Ark of the Covenant. Supported by insights from scientists, historians, and biblical scholars, he explores three ancient legends pointing to final resting place of the iconic relic.

metas.name: Winter Hymns
metas.description: A palliative care doctor meets with a series of dying patients.

metas.name: Hollis
metas.description: After leaving New York City behind, Hollis checks into a quiet roadside motel where she meets Adam, a young male escort she’s hired—not for sex, but for something stranger. As the night unfolds, Hollis guides Adam through an unsettling, intimate experiment that blurs emotional and psychological boundaries. But just as she returns to her routine, a sudden, senseless act of violence shatters the illusion of control she tried to reclaim.

metas.name: Crudo
metas.description: A year after her dismissal from a Michelin-starred restaurant, Chef Grace Collins, now managing a more modest eatery, has an unsavory encounter with the critic responsible for her firing.

metas.name: Pig(s)
metas.description: A less than innocent young woman gets pulled over by a cop and his strange partner.

metas.name: Shaggy's Big Break
metas.description: Reality, fiction, and performance overlap when an employee asks his boss for a two-week vacation.

metas.name: Ghost Town
metas.description: Man learns to love his new home and is moved to song.

metas.name: Time Life Volume 9. Life Model
metas.description: The mechanical gaze of a book scanner becomes a hyper-speed collage of anatomy.

metas.name: Foil and Doo: A Tale of Two Jokers
metas.description: Foil and Doo are two clowns working a dead-end job in a supermarket. One day, they decide to branch out and go to Clowns Anonymous, where the leader is secretly working for the Clown Bureau of Investigation and recruits the two clowns.

metas.name: The Judgement of the White Cube
metas.description: CATPC argues that white cube museums have been funded by profits extracted from plantation worker communities. In 2017, they erected their own white cube exhibition space in Lusanga. For CATPC, this White Cube stands for all museums and galleries throughout the world. In 2023, the collective placed their White Cube on trial. The performance-film The Judgement of the White Cube shows this Indigenous trial and features several members of the collective demanding justice for the extraction of wealth to finance museums. In the film, the judge, Mbuku Kimpala, convicts and sentences the White Cube to dedicate its energies for the good of the post-plantation. CATPC hopes their story sparks change and will ripple across the globe.

metas.name: My 7 Grandmas
metas.description: 17-year-old Gigi (Kate Larson) moves with her mom (Candace Kirkpatrick) from California to small-town Minnesota, where she cleverly plots to help her Grandpa (comedian Jeff Allen) get his life back on track after the loss of his wife.

metas.name: HOT!
metas.description: A mother penguin and her daughter are driving under the scorching summer sun to an amusement park. When they start fighting over the air conditioning, they end up breaking it, turning the ride into a little adventure.

metas.name: Double act
metas.description: Two acts take place at once.

metas.name: Gold leaf
metas.description: Glinting surface washed up on the shore.

metas.name: Bottle highlight
metas.description: Fluid finds its way around a bottle.

metas.name: On tape
metas.description: The final bit of tape billows about as Locky holds the roll.

metas.name: Silver roll
metas.description: Reflective garbage walks along the beach.

metas.name: Toe poke
metas.description: A toe pokes a container full of liquid.

metas.name: Nobody Knows Me
metas.description: Nobody knows me nobody knows me nobody knows me like you know me

metas.name: Never to Return
metas.description: After being forcibly removed from his university class, Daniel faces an obstinate investigator threatening to expose him if he does not comply with a little-known, Lavender Scare inquisition. Daniel must choose whether to name names, including betraying his former lover, or face the consequences of being outed in 1950s Florida.

metas.name: The Man Milker
metas.description: A man must face his greatest fear.

metas.name: Bleeding Edge
metas.description: A young Korean-American figure skater must bear the tough-love parenting of her mother, the mind games of her coach, and her own insidious self-doubt as she recovers from an injury.

metas.name: When We Dream Of Rockets
metas.description: An experimental film about the morality of space travel, based on a child’s dream

metas.name: This is Football
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of a football-obsessed culture, This is Football dives into the personalities, chaos, and absurdity that orbit the sport. As rivalries intensify and egos clash, the line between competition and spectacle begins to blur.

metas.name: Almost Funny, Season 3
metas.description: Almost Funny: Season 3 is a comedy anthology filmed in VRChat, hosted by BardicRJ, with musical performances by WHSPRS. Each entry is a standalone short film spanning absurdist fiction, dark satire, and genre parody - connected by musical interludes and an ongoing narrative thread. The season follows a misdelivered package that draws in a hitman, a mobster who can't get anyone to disrespect him correctly, a magic academy thrown into chaos by a new student, and a direct-to-video psychic rivalry stretched across multiple sequels. A noir detective works nights and narrates over a deal gone wrong, while a volatile detective's interrogation methods prove difficult to justify. Running between the one-offs is "The Plot" - a recurring storyline that builds across the season toward questions of memory, identity, and whether its characters are who they believe themselves to be.

metas.name: Chugwater, Wyoming
metas.description: In the town of Chugwater, Wyoming, a man finds himself in the center of a U.S. missile attack. Very quickly, he discovers that it's entirely his fault.

metas.name: TNA Countdown to Rebellion 2026
metas.description: TNA Rebellion 2026 PPV pre-show featuring analysis, interviews, and matches live from Cleveland, Ohio!

metas.name: UNTITLED_.MOV
metas.description: Two young men lose themselves over the course of a year as they try to create the most interesting media project put on the Internet.

metas.name: Partners in Crime
metas.description: Desperate for cash to move out of her mom's trailer, convenience store cashier Vic, her best friend Tally, and Tally's clueless boyfriend John stage a robbery, but things quickly spiral into chaos when two overbearing customers get involved.

metas.name: RADIOHEART: The Drive and Times of DJ Kevin Cole
metas.description: RADIOHEART is a documentary that explores the life and career of DJ Kevin Cole, following his journey from his disco DJ days in Minneapolis through the founding of alternative radio station REV 105, his role in launching Amazon’s first music store, and his pivotal influence on the groundbreaking Seattle radio station KEXP.

metas.name: The Pit
metas.description: Hand gestures from a trading-floor handbook flicker alongside fragments of Chicago's LaSalle Street, where signals once used to move commodities echo in stone, glass, and air. Through rapid collage, the film explores how capital appears not as an invisible force but as a rhythm that circulates between hands and architecture, leaving its patterns behind.

metas.name: Call of the Void
metas.description: Will the siren sound? This agitprop piece featuring banned words and phrases is necessary pushback against oppressive forces attacking human rights, personhood, economic inequality, and environmental advocacy in the United States.

metas.name: Single Double Triple
metas.description: A silent psychological mystery set in the Whitgift Shopping Centre, Croydon. The film was shot on B&W Reversal Super 8 and was first exhibited as part of a group show at Conditions Studio Programme.

metas.name: Emergency Exits
metas.description: Thematically prompted by the word "trouble," the author of this video-diary frolics throughout the city relieving himself via windows and staircases with some Hi8 observations in-between.

metas.name: Câine pierdut
metas.description: In a dense, opaque city, a man walks at a distance, cut off from the world. He collects fragments, post-its that he keeps without really knowing why. This absurd system becomes a method, an attempt to fit into the world.

metas.name: Everkeep
metas.description: A haunting and tender fable of innocence, wonder, and the passage of time, "Everkeep" follows Odette, a lonely girl who dwells in the vast, enchanted expanse of a castle garden. Wrapped in her own world, she clings to childhood magic, convinced she can remain in this place forever.

metas.name: i'm sorry, aidan.
metas.description: A prestigious short film circling the (fake) ending of a friendship.

metas.name: When He Leaves
metas.description: When He Leaves is an exploration of memory, heartbreak, and the struggle to move forward after a difficult relationship. The narrative centers on Brie, who navigates the lingering emotional impact of her past relationship with Matthew while dealing with her current, strained dynamic with Ethan

metas.name: RADIOHEART: The Drive & Times of DJ Kevin Cole
metas.description: RADIOHEART: The Drive and Times of DJ Kevin Cole explores the life and career of DJ Kevin Cole, tracing his path from the club dance floors of Minneapolis’ First Avenue to the digital halls of Amazon.com, to the global stage of Seattle’s KEXP. Through intimate interviews, archival footage, and the music that defined his career, the film tells the story of a man who revolutionized radio, faced personal demons, and ultimately, used his passion for music to create a lasting legacy of community, healing, and innovation.

metas.name: Come Talk To ME
metas.description: Imagine you have a disease likely to leave you unable to talk or write. “Come Talk To ME” shows Parkinson's disease (PD) activist Jackie Christensen, husband Paul and friends with PD reflecting on how it has affected their own  speech and relationships.

metas.name: Injured?
metas.description: Need help? Crashouts, manifestation influencers and injury lawyers collide in this breakneck ride through the Midwest. 50 years after attorney ads were first legalized in the United States, their ubiquitous self-portraits (allegedly) invoke a churn-and-burn economy of volume, velocity, fears, and veneers.

metas.name: Too Romantic
metas.description: In a glossy rom-com world, Samantha Carr is a struggling influencer known for her anti-love love songs and carefully curated online persona. When she collaborates with viral creator Mac Mayhew, their instant chemistry turns a songwriting session into an unexpectedly perfect date. But after an awkward and emotionally confusing sexual experience, Samantha’s world begins to crack, forcing her to question whether she’s chasing real connection - or if it’s all just for show.

metas.name: MANIAC PRODUCTIONS & OMEN LIVE INTERVIEWS
metas.description: Documentary short by Samspicolli featuring Maniac Productions, Leather Church, Crossbreak, Parasite Trveforce, Fortress and Omen.

metas.name: The Joy of Cooking
metas.description: A figure casts out tennis balls that find their place amongst new ecologies within a memory-cave on the banks of the Ohio river.

metas.name: The Joy of Cooking
metas.description: A figure casts out tennis balls that find their place amongst new ecologies within a memory-cave on the banks of the Ohio river.

metas.name: Solace
metas.description: A teenage boy struggling with depression reaches the tipping point as he remembers the simple but powerful moments in his life.

metas.name: The Last Day of Byron Bray
metas.description: Legendary character actor William Sadler (The Shawshank Redemption, Bill & Ted’s Bogus Journey) delivers an unexpectedly heartfelt turn as an elderly gay man who has a dream portending his nearing death and tries to impart some final wisdom to his young friend in this stirring film featuring music from M83 and Japandroids.

metas.name: Edge of Oblivion
metas.description: After a catastrophic collision in the orbit of a black hole, David must confront both the relentless pull of gravity and the consequences of his own choices.

metas.name: Jackrabbit Biker
metas.description: They took his lucky foot. Now he'll take their lives. Jackrabbit Biker. This summer.

metas.name: Thick & Sweet 甜腻腻
metas.description: The uprooted, the American dreams, the thick and sweet sauce, and an empty dining hall—too much for one to face and survive. It is far easier to demolish a closed restaurant. Composed of cutouts, reenactments, found footage, and fragments of earlier films, the work attempts to rebuild personal and collective memory while reflecting on the immigrant experience through the Americanization of food.

metas.name: I Have to Kill My Neighbor
metas.description: Lauren’s idyllic suburban life is shattered when her husband, Tom, is kidnapped. His anonymous captors give Lauren a strange ultimatum: she must kill Madeline - the next-door neighbor that Lauren despises.

metas.name: Spit Out Your Bones
metas.description: A Filipino-American college baseball pitcher navigates parental and physical pressures as he prepares to lead his team to a long-awaited championship.

metas.name: Down West Avenue
metas.description: A dramatic, musically inspired film about the son of a famous musician, and his best friend, an up-and-coming music prodigy. The two begin to drift apart when one of them is offered their dream job, leaving the other to fend for themselves.

metas.name: Implantability
metas.description: Mobsters interrogate a Deaf man in the basement of a church over a missing flash drive, evoking comedy in the most unusual of situations.

metas.name: Ghost Sandwich
metas.description: In this charming animated gem, a Deaf entity tries to order a sandwich in a hearing restaurant, with humorous results.

metas.name: Glass Cage
metas.description: A Deaf woman battles an internal force gnawing at her will to live, in a haunting cinematic mood piece that explores isolation and resilience.

metas.name: The Tales of Victor The Misfits Creator
metas.description: In a castle deep in an enchanted forest, a mad scientist brings to life a creature who can't hear. When their communication breaks down, the creature sets out to find someone who understands him.

metas.name: Refrain
metas.description: A Deaf maximum-security prisoner undergoes an experimental medical procedure to earn early release and be reunited with his daughter. However, the procedure results in unexpected consequences.

metas.name: Between Signs and Tides
metas.description: A young Brazilian man shows two female tourists around a romantic island. As he does so, bittersweet memories of a lost lover flood back.

metas.name: TIT FOR TAT
metas.description: Two lovers, Crystal and Iniya, engage in playful pillow talk about their breasts one morning, with some unintended consequences.

metas.name: Idle Hands
metas.description: During a reluctant visit to his mother's house with his son, a Deaf father (played by James Caverly) must confront a toxic family dynamic and find a better way forward for their future.

metas.name: I See A Voice
metas.description: A Deaf woman struggles in the aftermath of her father's passing. Friendship, an unexpected turn of events and a simple moment of connection are her salvation.

metas.name: Healing Hands
metas.description: When young Jonah is taken to a faith healer to cure his Deafness, his parents must face a new reality. Featuring Sandra Mae Frank in a supporting role.

metas.name: Dinner Table Syndrome
metas.description: A lonely Deaf boy has cochlear implants, but that doesn't fix the barriers he must navigate at Thanksgiving dinner with a family that may as well be strangers to him.

metas.name: TNA Rebellion 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Rebellion is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on April 11, 2026, at the Wolstein Center in Cleveland, Ohio. It will be the eighth event under the Rebellion chronology and will feature wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand due to the ongoing partnership between the two promotions.

metas.name: Heavy Healing
metas.description: Much like Rock ‘n’ Roll before it, heavy, aggressive music, including, but not limited to Heavy Metal, Punk, Hardcore and underground Hip-Hop, has gotten a bad rap since inception. Be that as it may, many who have been impacted by a wide variety of enervating conditions have come to rely on the output of heavy artists to successfully assist them through severe illness, weighty medical conditions, as well as debilitating mental health challenges. Heavy Healing seeks to dispel rumors and shine a much-deserved light on the healing powers of aggressive music. You will hear directly and candidly from artists, fans and industry types; remarkable individuals who have leaned on (or even become) “controversial” music makers in order to inspire and be inspired through the grueling process of recovery from the grips of cancer, anxiety and depression, strokes, heart attacks, cerebral palsy, complex blood diseases, juvenile diabetes and HIV/AIDS to name a few.

metas.name: Welcome
metas.description: This is an inspiring portrait of Shawn Welcome, an acclaimed spoken-word poet finding his true passion for empowering others with poetic expression as he works to cultivate a literary arts community in Orlando, FL.

metas.name: Correspondence
metas.description: Narrated from transcripts, the filmmaker conducts a mediated interview with the man convicted of murdering his grandmother in a robbery in 2005.

metas.name: Return from Tomorrow
metas.description: Randy Moore’s follow-up to the (in)famously filmed-in-secret Disney World fever-dream Escape from Tomorrow is an absurdist paranoid conspiracy thriller featuring the original cast in a completely new scenario. After the loss of his father, a middle-aged dad spirals into a Lynchian crisis of masculinity while on family vacation in Miami. As his inadequacies and unspoken desires drift him further away from his wife, he uncovers a mysterious plot involving his father, the gas company, cocaine, prostitution, and . . . Walt?

metas.name: Me Time Is Not Long
metas.description: A trip up north for the funeral of my grandfather

metas.name: Man-O-Wolf: The Axe Wielding Werewolf from Hell
metas.description: A werewolf slasher film created by prolific underground filmmaker Sam Hel.

metas.name: Miami Magic
metas.description: Nora has been living in NYC, following her dreams of “aspiring comedy writer,” but teaching took over, a job she’s just quit or been fired from — it’s complicated. Before she can figure out her next move, Nora finds herself back home, in Miami– Kendall, to be exact, dressed as a dancing grape, performing at children’s birthday parties with her Abuela and Tio.  This particular party turns out to be Nora’s worst anxiety nightmare come to life. All of her high school nemesis, crushes, and most memorable classmates are there, watching her fail. Except, maybe she’s not failing at all. Maybe she’s just growing, transitioning from one version of herself to a better one. And maybe, just maybe, those Octo/Nonagenarians she’s working with might have something to teach her after all.

metas.name: Neuman
metas.description: A recovering alcoholic clings to her daily routine after a well liked newcomer disappears just days before his first sober anniversary.

metas.name: A Little Park Music
metas.description: When a piano appears in the park gazebo, interfering with important work, city manager Allie joins forces with rookie cop Ryan to remove it, only to find both music and love are hard to resist.

metas.name: Shells: Shaped by Nature
metas.description: Since the dawn of time, Nature has sculpted the oceans with her delicate hand, weaving the tapestry of life in the shimmering depths and sunlit shallows. With infinite care, she conjured snails and mollusks to inhabit diverse marine realms around the African continent, each a reflection of her boundless creativity and wisdom. These delicate spirals, with their tender curves, ensnare our imagination, inspiring art, shaping cultures, adorning garments, and even serving as currency in ancient economies. "Shells: Shaped by Nature" is an artistic tribute to the enigmatic splendor of shells, celebrating these intricate marvels that grace Africa’s marine realms.

metas.name: Hands On
metas.description: The final two contestants in a Hands On A Hardbody competition are forced to find common ground when the challenge takes an unexpected turn.

metas.name: Bee My Love
metas.description: Private chef Hannah Jones, competing for her dream job with a celebrity restaurateur, finds inspiration in her mother’s recipes, the sweetness of honey, and a struggling beekeeper who teaches her to believe that life, and love, are sweetest when shared.

metas.name: Burnout
metas.description: A young man spirals through nicotine addiction in reverse, uncovering how one moment with a girl led him to his lowest point.

metas.name: A Fair Trade
metas.description: In this unfinished black comedy crime epic, eighth grader Tommy Uris is pushed into a teenage drug dealing business run by his two classmates Frank Newton and Patrick Reynolds after walking in on a drug deal between them. As their business falls apart, so does their trust for each other, and they need to either resolve, or kill each other in the process.

metas.name: Drinking and Driving
metas.description: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

metas.name: Waiting for Vera
metas.description: A lone, elderly oil painter prepares to begin a new painting. After readying his materials, he waits for a final, key ingredient.

metas.name: Beast
metas.description: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in one championship against the brutal champion Xavier Grau.

metas.name: The Solanges: Angels of the Sun
metas.description: A story of two women, of defiance, faith and legacy across time and continents, and how courage can echo across centuries.

metas.name: You, Me & Tuscany
metas.description: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

metas.name: PH-1
metas.description: A promising politician is held hostage in his luxurious penthouse by a remote captor, forced to watch his life destroyed by social and conventional media as he tries to figure out who is behind it and why.

metas.name: Look Out The Window
metas.description: A group of adults daydream about playing childhood games but are interrupted by their terrifying boss known as the “Figure”. They must break free from their boring job and regain their childlike sense of wonder.

metas.name: Bruno Mars: The romantic tour live
metas.description: Bruno Mars Romantic tour breaking all records

metas.name: Dream Girl
metas.description: Two girls who see each other in their dreams.

metas.name: An Instrumental Start: A Model for the Nation
metas.description: Located in the heart of Miami’s Liberty City, the African Heritage Cultural Arts Center, under the visionary leadership of Marshall Davis Sr., has spent over 50 years shaping young lives through a rigorous and transformative arts education. Its students have gone on to perform on Broadway, win Academy Awards, and appear in films and productions around the world—while others have carried that same discipline and purpose into careers as lawyers, police officers, and community leaders. This film is a powerful testament to the impact of arts education in underserved communities, featuring contributions from Phylicia Rashad, Savion Glover, and Tarell Alvin McCraney, alongside alumni, current students and educators from the Center, and dedicated members of the broader community.

metas.name: The Magnificent Mendez
metas.description: A Miami movie producer must confront his dark past when his long-lost love returns.

metas.name: Ditches & Dreams
metas.description: In a Baghdad that’s finding its footing again, 19-year-old Yas transforms its cracked asphalt into his skateboard runway, gliding beyond childhood shadows and carving out his horizon.

metas.name: Worst Contact
metas.description: Movie night is interrupted by a pesky alien invasion.

metas.name: Girls Own the Void
metas.description: In a chance encounter over a bag of Adderall,  two neurodivergent women form an unlikely romantic bond which questions if love is real for people like them.

metas.name: Million Dollar Tiger
metas.description: After a Kung Fu master spots them in a TV commercial, two reckless car salesmen are sent on a dangerous mission to rescue a stolen tiger from a powerful villain and deliver it to a sacred temple in China.

metas.name: Eddie Cochran: Don't Forget Me
metas.description: Despite his brief 21 years, Cochran’s musical legacy resonates across generations and genres, influencing icons from David Bowie to The Sex Pistols. His timeless hits like “C’mon Everybody” and “Summertime Blues” continue to shape the soundtracks of countless lives. This landmark documentary explores Cochran’s journey from country roots to rock & roll pioneer, showcasing his profound impact on music history, including his influence on legends ranging from The Beatles to Rod Stewart to Yungblud.

metas.name: If I Can't Have You
metas.description: Lust evolves into obsession when a married man embarks on an affair with a seductive and enigmatic woman who soon realizes he'll never leave his wife.

metas.name: Steakout!
metas.description: Sean's going to a steak dinner. Patrick's going to a stakeout. Unfortunately they're both in the same car.

metas.name: I'll Always Be There
metas.description: As a man watches his husband’s mind fade, their shadows come to life to reenact cherished memories and spark a final moment of recognition.

metas.name: Journeys
metas.description: A deep dive into the rapidly expanding world of Psilocybin Psychedelic Therapy. How it's being used in large (Heroic) and microdose form for PTSD, depression, end-of-life care, as well as the science, ethics and structure of the practice.

metas.name: A Score in Absence
metas.description: At seventeen, Ukrainian pianist Khrystyna has already fled war twice: first from Crimea, and then from Irpin as Russia’s invasion advanced. With her brother still in Ukraine under martial law, she turns to music to find agency in exile.

metas.name: RMH15: Back To Me
metas.description: After a summer away, Felix returns to campus with a new mindset, new friends and the same ex boyfriend. After running into each other at a party Montgomery and Felix have to decide if this is love or a thing of the past.

metas.name: Clownspiracy
metas.description: A small town high school misfit investigates the appearance of creepy clowns before an upcoming election, discovering the clowns are more than they appear.

metas.name: The Letter
metas.description: The Letter follows a recently arrived immigrant and his family as they face an impossible deadline to leave the United States or risk deportation. Told through the lens of the filmmaker’s close friendship with the subject, the film centers on the slow dismantling of the family’s home—an act that becomes both practical and symbolic—capturing fear, love, and resilience as neighbors, church members, and community activists rally together, leaving a visible absence where a family once belonged.

metas.name: Hollywood's Mermaid: The Esther Williams Story
metas.description: "Hollywood’s Mermaid" takes a deep dive into Esther William’s remarkable life’s story. We follow Esther from a 16-year-old Olympic hopeful to a 90-year-old Hollywood icon and see first-hand how her unique blend of athleticism, grace, and charisma continually captivated audiences across the globe for decades.

metas.name: The Zoo
metas.description: A caged lion festers in anger and silence until an unlikely friend comes along to help him tell his story. Poignant and timely, the lion’s story offers a mirror into human nature.

metas.name: Stop to Stop
metas.description: Carolyn is flooded with political text messages. When a chance encounter reveals the identity of one of her tormentors, she seeks revenge, but finds a spark.

metas.name: Plastic Sun
metas.description: A shackled man crawls through the desert in search of water across parched land. Not long after, he meets a tall man who informs him of all the unusual sins he has committed in the past. The tall man disappears, while the shackled man continues on his path, carrying the consequences of his actions on his shoulders.

metas.name: Missed
metas.description: June, a 35-year-old woman reeling from a missed miscarriage, returns to her car to find an uninvited passenger: a loud, cheerful puppet named Daisy. What begins as a waking nightmare becomes something unexpected. Daisy shifts from nuisance to companion, helping June navigate grief, logistics, and the impossible pressure to just "get over it." A dark comedy about loss, motherhood, and the strange forms comfort can take.

metas.name: The Checkout
metas.description: A young grocery store clerk unintentionally confides in his customers for love advice.

metas.name: Kid A Mnesia: The Movie
metas.description: A 75-minute immersive audiovisual film. It combines music from the Kid A and Amnesiac albums, remixed in 6-point surround sound with visuals based on Thom Yorke and Stanley Donwood's artwork.

metas.name: Carry My Couch
metas.description: After a steamy (and slightly ill-advised) fling with her charming neighbour Zeek, Gladys decides the only way to move on is to sell the couch where it all went down. Armed with a questionable CouchFinder™ ad, she sets out to banish both the furniture and the feelings tied to it.

metas.name: La Partenza
metas.description: In a peaceful Italian town, a mother prepares her family for a long awaited trip to New York, carrying every responsibility on her own. As the pressure mounts, her inner world begins to fracture, revealing the invisible weight she can no longer hold alone.

metas.name: Arquebusier
metas.description: Collage of siphonophores and the apparatus of war.

metas.name: Pismo Beach
metas.description: At a gig, drag performer is confronted by a lonely stranger with an eerie coincidence to share.

metas.name: Invisible - Revealing Hidden Disabilities
metas.description: A short documentary that brings light to the experiences of those who live with hidden disabilities. Through eight heartfelt interviews, participants share their struggles, strengths, and realities of their everyday lives.

metas.name: Arrangements for Robotic Arm
metas.description: Arrangements for Robotic Arm is a series of looping animations composed through repeated acts of computational output, robot-actuated drawing and sequencing. Each segment resolves seamlessly into itself and creates a perfect loop without a fixed beginning or end. Here, repetition functions as both process and subject: every animation begins as a software program whose code is written to run a motion sequence before being brought back to a “zero frame” which enables both the software program and its visual output to repeat in perpetuity. The series approaches repetition as a condition which unfolds in time. Meaning emerges through this consistent and sustained return to an initial form before starting once more.

metas.name: Dominion
