metas.name: I Got Bombed at Harvey's
metas.description: 1,000 pounds of dynamite. $3 million in cash. One casino at the edge of disaster.

metas.name: Cornbread Mafia
metas.description: Cornbread Mafia is the true story of the rise and fall of Kentucky farmers who built the largest domestic marijuana syndicate in U.S. history. Part true crime, part cartoon, a whole lot of weed.

metas.name: Same Same But Different
metas.description: An Iranian immigrant agrees to marry her boss's son to stay in the U.S., but their simple green card wedding on Cape Cod gets complicated when her two Iranian best friends arrive with their own American boyfriends and cross-cultural baggage in tow.

metas.name: December, Day Zero
metas.description: A recovering alcoholic comes face-to-face with his bartender ex-girlfriend when he attempts to drop off a Christmas gift at her bar.

metas.name: My Brother's Killer
metas.description: The unsolved murder of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, was an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, and seek a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. Drawing on a rare trove of VHS and personal footage, the film reveals a chilling overlap between the victim and some of the suspects who were captured on camera in films made in the narrow window of Billy's death.

metas.name: Seekers of Infinite Love
metas.description: Kayla Bachman, an author who struggles with emotional connection, Zach Bachman, a lawyer who dreams of being a folk singer and Wes Bachman, a graphic novelist / gambling & pill addict, meet to discuss their younger sister Scarlett who joined a cult in Kentucky. Zach and his dysfunctional and absent parents have hired cult deprogrammer Rick Delacroix to help them rescue Scarlett. They embark on a roadtrip to save their sister, and bring their family together.

metas.name: My NDA
metas.description: Three people bound by non-disclosure agreements face extreme personal risk to expose how a simple intellectual property contract is weaponized to silence, manipulate and control.

metas.name: In Spite of Ourselves
metas.description: Hannah, a determined Portland baker, and Archie, an up-and-coming Los Angeles comedian with a tendency to dodge commitment. What begins as immediate, undeniable chemistry turns into two blissful weeks together—until real life intervenes. Pulled back into their separate worlds, the pair must navigate distance, doubts, and their own hilariously messy insecurities to determine whether love can truly go the distance.

metas.name: Wishful Thinking
metas.description: WISHFUL THINKING follows Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician, who are at a loss for how to repair their volatile relationship. After attending a couples-therapy seminar run by mysterious twin healers, they find that the ups-and-downs of their relationship have supernatural effects on the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their passionate love can survive amidst so much chaos.

metas.name: Anima
metas.description: A young woman and an old man embark on a road trip to preserve his consciousness at an experimental facility.

metas.name: Stages
metas.description: After the tumultuous breakup of his band, Ben Garza embarks on his first-ever solo tour. Life on the road feels different now, and Ben must find his footing alongside Rita, his steadfast tour manager, and Jessie Ramos, his charismatic, spotlight-stealing opening act.

metas.name: Perfect
metas.description: During the worst drought on record, a wealthy pregnant woman living out an escapist fantasy falls in love with a younger woman starting her life over.

metas.name: A Safe Distance
metas.description: After a woman is abandoned by her boyfriend in the forest, she befriends a couple and gradually realizes they are a pair of notorious bank robbers on the run from the law.

metas.name: I Love Boosters
metas.description: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

metas.name: Kill Me
metas.description: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub after having tried to kill himself. Or, at least, that’s what it looks like to his friends and family. Jimmy is pretty sure he didn’t do it… maybe. Together with Margot, the 911 operator who took his call, Jimmy sets out on a mission to solve a vitally important whodunit: did someone try to kill him, or are they chasing the spectre of depression?

metas.name: Mile End Kicks
metas.description: Grace Pine, a 24-year-old music critic, moves to Montreal to write a book on Alanis Morissette's Jagged Little Pill, but her plans are complicated when she becomes romantically involved with two members of an indie band she is covering and decides to become their publicist.

metas.name: Marc by Sofia
metas.description: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer.

metas.name: The Green Bench
metas.description: A heartfelt film celebrating ten years of the #ElderWisdom movement, The Green Bench follows five remarkable residents from Schlegel Villages as they return to meaningful places in their lives. Joan Demetriadis journeys to St. John’s, Newfoundland to reconnect with her roots and reflect on the community that shaped her. Doug Robinson travels to England, revisiting memories of love and adventure. Tom Farr returns to Elmira, Ontario, where his lifelong connections to family and faith come full circle. Doug and Jan Nash visit Ottawa, sharing stories of family, resilience, and changing perceptions of aging and care. Together, their stories illuminate the campaign’s mission—to honour the wisdom of the elder and bridge generations through conversation on the green bench.

metas.name: Short Film: A Short Film
metas.description: Vin Bush's directorial debut in which two friends try to make a short film.

metas.name: Where Are You, LaoLao?
metas.description: Grieving the loss of her mother, a despondent Chinese-American woman surrenders to a sudden impulse to travel with her two-year-old daughter to Taiwan in an ethereal pursuit to pass down her Asian heritage.

metas.name: The Second Life of Freddie Nole
metas.description: When Freddie Nole drives to meet a man walking out of prison, he’s not just offering a ride, he’s offering hope, dignity, and a path to permanent freedom. As this vérité road trip unfolds, we come to learn the remarkable story behind Freddie’s mission, a staggering mistake that cost him 50 years of freedom but ultimately brings him right back to the prison door.

metas.name: Sharlotte's Web
metas.description: Louise Monroe has been groomed from childhood to manipulate men. She discovers that her entire life has been controlled by her aunt, forcing her to untangle a web of lies, betrayal, and buried trauma before her own Karma comes for her.

metas.name: The Roots That Bind Us
metas.description: The Roots that Bind Us explores the origins of non-unanimous juries in Louisiana and the impact of this racist law today. The film focuses on three men - Jermaine, Herman and Lloyd - whose fates were sealed before they were ever born. Through their stories, as well as expert testimony, archival research, animation, and poetry, the film exposes a system grown from the roots of slavery to incarcerate Black people. The film elevates the voices of those who fought and continue to fight for the justice that's owed to hundreds of people incarcerated all over Louisiana today.

metas.name: Ice Gold: A Journey from Worst to First
metas.description: The true story of the underdog 2002 U.S. Paralympic Sled Hockey team that went from dead last to Gold Medal champions.

metas.name: Another Time
metas.description: While seeking an escape from her own engagement ball, a woman encounters her closest friend, and long-held feelings come to light.

metas.name: Speak Out
metas.description: A family is interrupted from their regularly scheduled program causing a fierce debate over empathy and responsibility, ultimately ending in an ironic twist of fate.

metas.name: Love Is Blind: The Reunion
metas.description: After the weddings, the Pod Squad from 'Love Is Blind: Ohio' shares relationship statuses and receipts in this tell-all reunion special.

metas.name: Vegetable Frat House
metas.description: In a world where vegetables are people & people are people, Carson the Carrot is trying to get litty "Ay Eff" at his awesome vegetable frat rager but everyone keeps dying and totally killing the vibe.

metas.name: Dimension 20 Live: Viva Más Vegas
metas.description: The Gunner Channel heads to Más Vegas for another action-packed adventure.

metas.name: Two Dreams About the End of the World
metas.description: Two lovers each recall a dream they had.

metas.name: Of the People: The Women of the Civil Rights Movement
metas.description: Of The People: The Women Of The Civil Rights Movement shines a light on the often-overlooked women whose courage and leadership shaped one of the most transformative eras in American history. While names like Martin Luther King Jr. and Malcolm X dominate popular narratives, this work centers the voices and stories of women who organized, strategized, and sacrificed to dismantle segregation and secure voting rights. From grassroots activists to national leaders, these women such as Ella Baker, Fannie Lou Hamer, Septima Clark, and Dorothy Height fought not only against racial injustice but also gender discrimination within the movement itself.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.

metas.name: Optic
metas.description: A surreal anthology

metas.name: Remaking the Middle East: Israel vs. Iran
metas.description: The documentary traces Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s long campaign to destroy Iran’s nuclear capabilities and counter its proxy forces, the conflict with the Palestinians, and the role of the U.S. through decades of difficulty in the region.  Drawing on new, insider interviews, this two-hour special examines how long-running and escalating tensions between Israel and Iran erupted into all-out war in June 2025. The film also explores how multiple U.S. presidents have tried to manage the volatile issues at play.

metas.name: When I See You At The End Of The World
metas.description: After dying hundreds of times, Meg comes to see her world for what it is—a fragile, lower-dimensional construct, built only to be undone.

metas.name: Remake
metas.description: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

metas.name: A Scarf for Joey
metas.description: After his father's murder, a young man hides in his abandoned family home, surviving while confronting suspense, horror, and supernatural events leading to an unforeseen climax.

metas.name: Not Anymore
metas.description: A loner teenager struggles with the death of his late best friend, and the only way to cope is to have one last conversation with him.

metas.name: Mario Adrion: My Struggle
metas.description: Follows German-American comedian Mario Adrion as he tackles his cultural experience living in America, exploring German guilt, his German/Jewish marriage, and cultural differences between Los Angeles and his Black Forest hometown.

metas.name: Where the Waters Meet on the Breathing Shore
metas.description: "Where the Waters Meet on the Breathing Shore" is a 25 minute science documentary exploring the Mullica River-Great Bay Estuary in Tuckerton, NJ, where freshwater rivers meet the saltwater sea. Graduate student and science storyteller Shaniya Utamidata joins marine scientists at Rutgers University Marine Field Station, Dr. Thomas Grothues, Dr. Ken Able, Dr. Oscar Schofield, and Lisa Auermuller to reveal how these “breathing shores” sustain biodiversity, filter water, and buffer communities against climate change. Blending scientific insight with reflection, the film transforms field research into a personal journey of discovery. Using a Science-in-Action Storytelling Model, we invite young audiences, especially students from underrepresented backgrounds, to see themselves in the story of science. In connecting the marshes of New Jersey to the coasts of Indonesia, "Where the Waters Meet on the Breathing Shore" shows how one estuary’s story belongs to the entire planet.

metas.name: Mister Gates
metas.description: Real-estate mogul Christopher Gates becomes homeless after losing his family, only to discover the sinister connection to their deaths.

metas.name: Scarred
metas.description: A husband's infidelity causes a painful scar in the heart of two women but the consequences that follow are more than expected.

metas.name: The Worst That Could Happen
metas.description: Harold, an anxiety-ridden college student who can't tell the difference between his intrusive thoughts and reality, has decided today is the day to finally ask out, or rather first talk to, his crush. Along for the "ride" is his good pal Skip, whose antics are the perfectly wrong match for Harold's anxiety.

metas.name: SHOOT!
metas.description: A cascade of feminine horror!

metas.name: breakup
metas.description: Created by Tanner Richard Craft. A video collage cataloguing intense emotions.

metas.name: Salamanderfilm 2
metas.description: Scale movie variation. Creative Commons/Public Domain image and sound.

metas.name: Mossunguê – A Donnas do Novo Mundo
metas.description: The Mossunguê neighborhood was colonized by Italian immigrants from the city of Donnas in the Aosta Valley region at the end of the 19th century. Now that the neighborhood has become hyper-urbanized, there is nothing left associated with the agricultural past that kept alive for almost a century the traditions of the place of origin of the Juglair, Nicco, and Perretto families.

metas.name: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic
metas.description: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.

metas.name: Training Day
metas.description: A tired and hungry Tramp gets the opportunity to work at a movie theater. The Tramp must train in the different positions while dealing with his own clumsiness and a mean boss.

metas.name: Out Of Character
metas.description: Kevin's life is a mess and his youtube channel is failing, what will he do to set his life back on track?

metas.name: Laundry Room Rumble
metas.description: A man suffers the consequences of stealing another man's laundry detergent.

metas.name: The Hitchhiker
metas.description: The lines between a mentally ill and a normal world begin to blur when a hitchhiker sticks his thumb back out into the world.

metas.name: Her Song
metas.description: In a secluded village in the French Pyrenees, American writer Olivia returns to her family’s ancestral home – where her grandmother fled Paris during the Nazi invasion in World War II – seeking material for a long-stalled novel. There she encounters Madeline, a talented local woman whose ingenuity and spirit echo memories of her grandmother. As Olivia incorporates details from Madeline’s life into her fictional narrative, three storylines intersect: her grandmother’s past, her novel and Olivia’s present-day experiences.

metas.name: Find Your Heart
metas.description: After discovering he shares his mother’s fatal heart condition, a desperate medical student follows her advice to confess his love to his lifelong crush and “find his heart” before time runs out.

metas.name: Say Less
metas.description: Left home alone while their parents are out of town, teenage siblings Cassie and Max see their petty sibling warfare take a dark turn when they make a shocking discovery about their father.

metas.name: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
metas.description: The definitive account of Japan’s struggle as it faced a nuclear catastrophe while still reeling from the devastation of an earthquake and tsunami.

metas.name: Amityville Versus Galactic Samurai School Girls From Outer Space
metas.description: Three Galactic Samurai Women Aliens visit the small town of Amityville on a mission to find human men.

metas.name: Reminders of Him
metas.description: When Diem's custodial grandparents adamantly refuse Kenna's attempts to see her daughter, Kenna discovers unexpected compassion, and then something truer and deeper, with former NFL player and local bar owner Ledger. As their secret romance develops, so do the dangers for both of them, leading Kenna toward heartbreak and, ultimately, the hope for a second chance.

metas.name: Leaves Are Weird!
metas.description: Learn about the incredible process of photosynthesis from a professional botanist, a puppet, and a leaf! Thank you to everyone who helped make this project happen.

metas.name: Camp Dewling 2026
metas.description: A young devoted man (Ben Dewling) travels across many lands and seas to meet the mighty and elusive prophet of the Most High, Hilusen (as himself). There he learns the value of hard work, good company, substance abuse and a good smile.

metas.name: The Voicemail
metas.description: A man leaves a voicemail confession disguised as him worried for his partner, revealing himself as a murderer, but only after walking the audience through the entire crime scene of his partner’s murder.

metas.name: Grey Busches
metas.description: In the lead up to Big Top Brawl, a film crew was sent out to follow the legendary wrestler and starlet Rusty Busches and her manager/nephew F.W. Busches. The hope was to get some great stories from the territory days of pro wrestling from the living legend, Rusty. What was captured was a little different than expected. Join the Busches family in their sprawling Metro Detroit mansion and see where her head was at as she goes into a career threatening match.

metas.name: Utah in the ’70s
metas.description: Take a trip back to Utah in the ’70s, when a new emerging culture clashed with tradition and institution. More than just disco and drugs, the 1970s were a time of great upheaval, socially, politically, and economically. Hear it from the mouths of the people who lived it, and see how the 1970s helped deﬁne Utah as a place for growth and a groovy new outlook on life.

metas.name: Jonah and Blake in: Dude, We Solved Bullying!
metas.description: Jonah and Blake are back in an all-new adventure! It's the first day of school, and the boys have already made an enemy! Will the two step up and become heroes of the school, or become the laughing stocks of the semester? Meanwhile, dear old dad confronts his new boss... who resembles someone very close to him.

metas.name: David Cross: The End of the Beginning of the End
metas.description: So here we have it, my latest special, The End of the Beginning of the End recorded last year at the 40 Watt in Athens GA. I touch on a bunch of different topics ranging from climbing Machu Picchu with Bob, people who collect shoes, my impression of a very inappropriate Rabbi trying on a pair of shoes that are way too small for him and many others. Just know, the story about the Chinese massage place is 100% true.

metas.name: A Santa in February
metas.description: Billy is at a loss of motivation, struggling to move forward with his life. His biggest problem? He still hasn’t put away a Santa Claus decoration... even though it’s already February. February!

metas.name: My condolences
metas.description: A quick conversation between friends takes a very unexpected turn.

metas.name: I Have Ten Fingers but I Cannot Count
metas.description: An accountant struggles with his job as his headspace and self-perception begin to slip and his work and personal lives collide.

metas.name: Aetherbee
metas.description: A transaction of experimental technology takes place between an onierologist and an unnamed government official.

metas.name: give ME
metas.description: A teen has moved into a new city for his studies. He writes to his mother opening up of his new found addiction.

metas.name: Close Encounter
metas.description: A skeptical teenage girl, Riley, reluctantly joins her UFO-obsessed father, Jerry, on a road trip to a UFO convention, only to experience an otherworldly encounter that brings them closer together.

metas.name: Eight Bridges
metas.description: Shots of 8 bridges from the continental United States - the Golden Gate Bridge from Sausalito, California; the Rio Grande Gorge Bridge from Arroyo Hondo, New Mexico; the Edmund Pettus Bridge from Selma, Alabama; the Seven Mile Bridge from Little Duck Key, Florida; the George Washington Bridge from Fort Lee, New Jersey; the Dubuque-Wisconsin Bridge from Dubuque, Iowa; the High Bridge from Valley City, North Dakota; the Astoria-Megler Bridge from Astoria, Oregon.

metas.name: Fort Valor
metas.description: The story follows 10-year-old Conner, who is struggling with his father's long deployment and is withdrawn, spending all his time playing a world-building video game. His Uncle Sean takes him on a drive in an attempt to reconnect, using the game as a bridge. Together, they embark on a mission in the game, rescuing a hostage in a high-stakes, action-packed adventure. The playful yet tense game mirrors Conner's feelings about his father's absence, and through teamwork, Conner learns about sacrifice, bravery, and trust. The story blends real-world emotions with action-packed virtual experiences, leading to a heartfelt connection between uncle and nephew.

metas.name: Biggy: A True Story
metas.description: Join That’s Life productions in celebration of their one year anniversary! Everyone’s favorite cryptid is back and this time he must face his greatest threat yet…

metas.name: Eden's Choice
metas.description: In a time when the abortion debate continues to divide culture, politics, and communities across America, this deeply emotional film cuts through the noise to tell a raw and unforgettable human story, one that challenges audiences to see the person behind the issue. EDEN’S CHOICE follows the journey of 13 year old Eden, a young girl facing abuse, poverty, and an unplanned pregnancy. As her family crumbles and her circumstances spiral beyond her control, Eden is forced to make a decision that will shape the rest of her life. Choosing courage over fear, she makes the life altering decision to choose life. What follows is a powerful journey of sacrifice, perseverance, and ultimately, redemption, as Eden comes to understand the profound impact of her choice years later.

metas.name: Of New England
metas.description: An Italian-Irish American family. A legendary professor. A cult classic jazz record. A historic theater. A personal journey into the heart of New England.

metas.name: TALK SHOW
metas.description: Talk Show is the final film in Jordan Strafer’s Loophole trilogy. The narrative unfolds across two periods of time: the turn of the millennium, shot in color, and the afterlife, shot in black and white. Structured around a talk show, the work examines 1990s celebrity culture, violence against women, and justice as televised spectacle. Its screenplay draws on sources ranging from news footage to self-help media, blending historical fact with fiction. [Overview courtesy of The Whitney]

metas.name: Amaltaas
metas.description: In a foreign home, a newly married woman drifts through incense smoke, tea rituals, and beauty masks. The echoes of wedding drums, once celebratory, now linger as a haunting reminder of her displacement, silencing her beneath routines of obedience and appearances.

metas.name: Outlaws of the Everglades
metas.description: When mounting fishing regulations prevented them from making a living, they turned to marijuana smuggling to survive. Outlaws of the Everglades...a story of loyalty, survival, determination and grit.

metas.name: Chongqing Pink
metas.description: Addled underworld figures Zhou Jim and Z.H. live in Los Angeles, China 2. The duo searches throughout Chinatown and Hollywood for their mind-altering substance of choice, the elusive "Chongqing Pink," with help - and hinderance! - from friends and family as they joust with the shackles of addiction.

metas.name: The Time Step
metas.description: A portrait of the filmmakers grandmother made from self scanned 8mm footage from 1940's-1960's. Commissioned for the 2026 True/False Film Festival.

metas.name: You Have Arrived At Your Destination
metas.description: On the way to a facebook marketplace deal, two friends trapped in their malfunctioning car face a ridiculously stubborn red light.

metas.name: One Way Ticket To Nowhere
metas.description: "One Way Ticket To Nowhere" follows Michael Mulligan on his first day of freedom after years of incarceration. With nowhere to go and no one waiting for him, he moves through a world that has continued on without him.

metas.name: A Paralyzing Redemption
metas.description: A star basketball player finds his world turned upside down when a serious car accident leaves him a quadriplegic.

metas.name: Babes in The Shed
metas.description: A pretentious filmmaker is faced with a hoard of fans that thirst for his blood.

metas.name: EVE 146: Wrestle Queendom VIII
metas.description: EVE 146: Wrestle Queendom VIII was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro-Wrestling: EVE that took place on March 8, 2026, at Indigo at The O2 in London, England, and was headlined by Rhio (c) vs. Session Moth Martina for the EVE Championship.

metas.name: (MOURNING) AFFIRMATIONS
metas.description: (MOURNING) AFFIRMATIONS is a dreamy short film that drifts through mental struggle, grief, and fractured memory, structured around the relentless voiceover of a self-help tape. Set in the gloomy landscape of Berlin, the film exposes the quiet violence of compulsory wellness, the demand to cope, to heal, to be “okay,” and explores what emerges when we stop performing stability and allow ourselves to unravel.

metas.name: CLAY JACKSON
metas.description: A once famous action star, Clay Jackson tracks down his friend Jack Howitzer after Jack was kidnapped at his office.

metas.name: Punch Hard
metas.description: After Mike Rotch escapes captivity from the IMP Faculty, Dick John goes over for a visit with an old friend, Ben David.

metas.name: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.
metas.description: In a special one off concert in Manchester, recorded on the evening of March 6, Harry Styles played his new album, ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.' for the very first time.

metas.name: Currents
metas.description: A TV field producer travels to Catalina Island to film an interview with a retired fisherman, but as the shoot unfolds, unresolved pieces of his past begin to surface.

metas.name: The Couple Across the Street
metas.description: When a family seeks refuge with their "doomsday prepper" neighbors during a community lockdown, they start to suspect their hosts have dangerous intentions, until a shocking twist reveals the real threat was far closer than they ever imagined.

metas.name: I Sassi
metas.description: Alessandra and Elisa are fifteen, bound by an intense connection that shifts between closeness, desire, and subtle jealousy. Elisa is about to move abroad, and the looming distance charges every gesture with new weight. They tease, provoke, and cling to each other, as if holding on and pushing away were the same thing. What they can’t express surfaces in silences, in glances, in the fragile balance between them. Over the course of a long afternoon, following the path of a river, they drift along the edges of their world: boys who bully, men who blur boundaries, glimpses of an adult world they observe without fully understanding. In that uncertain space - shaped by fear, confusion, and desire - something cracks. An extreme act begins to take shape, driven by something deep, unspoken, and unresolved.

metas.name: Buddies
metas.description: Two strangers meet on a day when they fake their identities, but reveal their true selves.

metas.name: Prettier in Whittier
metas.description: Nestled in a mountainous rainforest in Alaska is the town of Whittier, where nearly the entire population lives in a single apartment building. They bring new meaning to the idea of getting along with your neighbor.

metas.name: Nothing but the End
metas.description: A young couple living in a rural area are confronted with the end of the world.

metas.name: We Want the Virus
metas.description: After a blacked out night of drinking, two lifelong friends and struggling actors wake up and realize they raised 22 thousand dollars falsely claiming they had the Coronavirus, and now must go to extreme lengths in order to obtain the virus and collect their cash.

metas.name: Reservation Redemption
metas.description: Teenage Marchand Rice sentenced to life for murder. In prison, he meets a spiritual leader who asks "Who do you want to be?" Follow Rice's transformation into a respected leader, and his commitment to cultural healing that inspires others.

metas.name: Katelin Describes a Crisis
metas.description: A family invents a series of rituals to describe the trouble they're in: first a burial, then an alien invasion. A cappella songs composed for the film act as a twisted guide, describing different ways the world has already ended. This is a musical portrait of a family trying to survive.  Filmed on location in Manistique, MI.

metas.name: From Cult to Queer
metas.description: For twenty-six years, Abigail Hobbs’ true identity was completely suppressed by the manipulation, surveillance, and enforced silence of a strict religious cult. The narrative exposes this invasive childhood through personal narration, archival footage, and dramatic re-enactments, showcasing a world where she never knew she had choices. The heart of the story follows her escape and the profound queer awakening that shatters her old worldview. Breaking free requires more than just leaving; it demands that Abigail trust herself for the first time, opening up a life of radical self-discovery. Her journey evolves from a struggle against religious captivity into a triumphant celebration of her queer identity. Ultimately, the plot charts her transformation from a silenced captive into a woman reclaiming her autonomy to live openly, authentically, and free.

metas.name: Destiny
metas.description: On his 18th birthday, Eli makes a wish to see his future. Moments later, he is pulled through a mysterious portal and comes face-to-face with his 40-year-old self. But the life waiting for him isn’t the one he imagined. Together, they travel further into the future and meet the one person who might hold the answers. What follows is a powerful conversation about regret, identity, purpose, and the one question that shapes every life: Who do you choose to become?

metas.name: You're Doing it Wrong
metas.description: A fun, youthful romantic comedy about modern dating. Three friends invite three guys for a triple-date dinner that turns playful, messy, and full of unexpected chemistry.

metas.name: Resonancia
metas.description: In the heart of Havana, Grammy-winning composer Ted Nash invites young Cuban musicians to find inspiration in the colors and forms of a museum’s paintings. What begins as a search for melody becomes an awakening, as students uncover hidden voices within themselves—discovering passion, courage, and untapped creativity. Their week of exploration blooms into a radiant concert before more than a thousand people, where art and music merge into a testament of self-discovery and the boundless power of expression.

metas.name: When Pigs Fly
metas.description: A hardened ex-rocker with a 62-year sentence finds redemption behind bars when a Bible study - and one extraordinary moment - transform his life forever.

metas.name: Andy Anderson - The Shape of Paris
metas.description: In which Paris serves as a canvas for Andy Anderson to masterfully craft a mélange of freestyle and street skating.

metas.name: Cameron Esposito: Nine Months
metas.description: In an impromptu stand-up special recorded 48 hours before giving birth, comedian Cameron Esposito elaborates on life as a nonbinary pregnant person, the shady intricacies of donor screenings, and the bizarre reactions they've experienced from strangers.

metas.name: Thank You
metas.description: In Cambodia, where the ancient city of Angkor once flourished, a temple sits on a man-made island in the middle of a reservoir. In Awkun (meaning “thank you” in Khmer), Cambodian American director praCh Ly shares a day in the life of the surrounding community, filmed on-site in West Baray and at the island-temple West Mebon.  A fisherman navigates to the reservoir in his boat before dawn. A merchant woman barbecues skewered fish from the same waters. A group of young monks accepts offerings, eats, prays, swims, and takes a boat out to the temple. Through such everyday moments, Awkun draws attention to the often-overlooked relationships that bridge sacred and urban spaces, from past to present.  This film was commissioned specially for our exhibition Vishnu’s Cosmic Ocean.

metas.name: Sometimes: A Collection of Poems About the Progression of an Ending
metas.description: A collection of three poems that explores the ending of a love that was once seen as everything.

metas.name: I Blame Chalamet
metas.description: A fake documentary-style film submitted to the Gimme Truth! 2026 Competition at the True/False Film Festival in Columbia Missouri. “I Blame Chalamet” recounts Luke’s awful first date in high school that ended in ice cream induced vomit all over the date’s car. The premise of the movie is to determine whether or not they are telling the truth- is this story fiction or did Luke really have to live through that experience?

metas.name: Gary Owen: No Hard Feelings
metas.description: In his latest comedy special, Gary is at his unapologetic best as he takes fans on a journey from growing up in a trailer park to moving to D.C. and raising twin boys, while leaving nothing off-limits.

metas.name: Library Dreams
metas.description: Elle's life is turned upside down when elements of magic take over the library aisles, allowing them to relive their past love and change the future.

metas.name: A Baby's 1st Birthday
metas.description: A nostalgic glimpse into a baby's first birthday, captured through the eyes of family.

metas.name: The Adventures of an Office Drone
metas.description: An office worker tries to fight off boredom.

metas.name: Experiences and learning. And parenting.
metas.description: O is very curious and busy discovering the world.

metas.name: Jawn
metas.description: An exploration of light and texture in Philadelphia.

metas.name: GCW So Alive 2026
metas.description: GCW So Alive 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Game Changer Wrestling (GCW), held on March 7, 2026 at The Valley Dale Ballroom in Columbus, OH.

metas.name: Before 1984
metas.description: In a dystopian world where loyalty to Big Brother is law, Marcus, a newly minted Thought Police officer, struggles between duty and conscience. As he uncovers forbidden knowledge in a mysterious notebook, his devotion to the party clashes with his love for Breanna, forcing him to confront the cost of freedom, loyalty, and personal truth.

metas.name: The Sharp Point of Time
metas.description: An immigrant Filipina mother who had dreams of being a filmmaker just wants her America-born son to not smoke weed, wash the dishes right and be more like his brother.

metas.name: NXT Vengeance Day 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Vengeance Day was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE for its NXT brand, held on March 7, 2026, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, and was headlined by Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ricky Saints for the NXT Championship.

metas.name: Pushing Past the Bad
metas.description: Stann is the head of a three-generation troubled French family that he struggles to support through petty crime. He puts on a strong front, but is floundering and he hates his life until a beautiful Black woman, Gloria, arrives on the scene. They secretly marry against the family’s will – not only is she Black but she is also an American. PUSHING PAST THE BAD tells an unusual story of love that transcends romance. Gloria and Stann find themselves in a world falling apart. Stann is tortured by his crazy brutal father and the rest of the family. Meanwhile, the police pursue Stann for murder but it was the father who was the assassin. Stann refuses to denounce him, and he disappears, leaving the family to Gloria who had already left behind a troubled world in the United States. Gloria is now both provocateur and mediator. A strange and poignant fable.

metas.name: Sugar & Vice: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
metas.description: Hannah finds a body at the grand re-opening of the Lake Eden Inn. When a storm traps everyone inside, Hannah must find the culprit before the road clears and the killer escapes.

metas.name: Pinktoned
metas.description: Stoltz constructed Pinktoned and Pinktoned (Exploded View) using footage of passersby he filmed from his art studio in East Hollywood interspersed with still images from an archive of photographic slides he found at a rummage sale at the Echo Park Film Center. These images picture the streets of Los Angeles covered with wheat-pasted movie posters for Underground, a 1976 documentary about the Weather Underground.

metas.name: Ghost School
metas.description: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Rumours are rife in the village and the authorities are no help. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption and a wall of silence.

metas.name: Tycoon
metas.description: Los Angeles on the cusp of the 2028 Summer Olympics: a series of devastating livestock viruses have wiped out meat and poultry production across the nation, leaving genetically-modified cockroaches the most viable alternative. Meanwhile, a cockroach infestation of biblical proportions overwhelms the city, triggering a rash of eminent domain abuses. Two young grifters dream up their next big score in a paranoid landscape perpetually reshaped by the collapse between legitimized and illegitimate forms of celebration and theft.

metas.name: Vanished in an Instant
metas.description: After her daughter disappears from a gas station, a mother's race against time uncovers a chilling truth buried beneath a quiet town's surface.

metas.name: Most Likely
metas.description: Shy high schooler Henry and outgoing friend Max attend Model UN in 1990s New York. Amid tensions and uncertainties, Henry connects deeply with Lucy, reconciling with Max and gaining confidence.

metas.name: GIVE ME BACK MY BICYCLE!
metas.description: An obsessed medical student chases down a bike thief on an electric scooter in a desperate attempt to find his stolen bicycle.

metas.name: HOTHEADS
metas.description: In the midst of a snowstorm, two student journalists venture through backroad towns in hopes of finding a make or break story.

metas.name: Veils
metas.description: Veils is a short experimental film about humans finding themselves outside of the technological advancements of the world today. It is inspired by the fogginess and blurriness humans can go through when they use different technologies like smartphones, artificial intelligence, and much more. What happens when humans break outside of the bubble that they created?

metas.name: Who Moves America
metas.description: Across America, UPS workers come together to demand better working conditions as they go about criss-crossing the world, delivering packages and connecting lives.

metas.name: Crossroads
metas.description: Kyle loses everything when he makes the terrible decision to drive drunk.

metas.name: The Wench
metas.description: A father searches for his daughter in the Whispering Pines forest, where he encounters an entity of the woods that induces horrifying hallucinations that threaten to derail his efforts.

metas.name: One of the Good Ones
metas.description: In a system corrupted by politics, greed and sex, there's an honest man in Buffalo who's made it his life's mission to hold his peers accountable. Dean Alessi is an attorney in Buffalo's Lawyer Disciplinary Office who fights for justice, even as he battles his own personal demons. Dean took an oath to protect the public from bad lawyers, and is willing to risk everything to keep that sacred promise. As the bodies pile up, Dean puts his own life on the line when he disobeys orders to expose a corrupt District Attorney who has committed the ultimate ethical wrong - murder.

metas.name: Unplug
metas.description: When a mysterious Orb is discovered, a group of high schoolers are forced to face both strained relationships and past actions in an effort to combat the deceitful temptation of misconstrued justice that resides within...

metas.name: Dorkapalooza: How the Nerds Won
metas.description: What started as a small gathering of sports nerds at MIT became one of the most influential events in modern sports.  “Dorkapalooza: How the Nerds Won” traces the rise of the MIT Sloan Sports Analytics Conference, from its scrappy beginnings two decades ago to its outsized impact on the way teams, leagues, and fans understand the games they love. We explore the big ideas that reshaped sports, the backlash that followed, and what the future of analytics might look like.  Featuring reflections from Bill Simmons, Daryl Morey, Jessica Gelman, Zach Lowe, Shane Battier, Michael Lewis, and more.

metas.name: Field Recordings
metas.description: Sound Recordist Effie Meyers goes around capturing the tiny frequencies that make up her world. Commissioned for the 2026 True/False Film Festival.

metas.name: Escape Artist
metas.description: Director Robert Kolodny draws parallels between the Harry Houdini's conjuring power of sleight of hand and the creative process of hand crafting works of film. Commissioned for the 2026 True/False Film Festival.

metas.name: Back to Tilicho
metas.description: As a young woman prepares to get married, she becomes consumed with demons from her past. To reconnect with who she was before the trauma, she and her new husband walk 500 kilometers on the Great Himalaya Trail to a significant place from her youth: Lake Tilicho, one of the highest lakes in the world. But when faced with treacherous terrain, snow storms, near-death accidents, resurfacing repressed memories, and seemingly insurmountable barriers, she realizes that maybe she wasn't supposed to go back.

metas.name: Vice and Virtue
metas.description: When celestial rivals Vice and Virtue bet on the fate of six unsuspecting humans, chaos ensues and secrets unravel. As free will collides with divine meddling, lives spiral in this darkly comedic tale of power, morality, and choice.

metas.name: SHE LATE!
metas.description: In this intimate portrayal of friendship, patience, and transformation, filmmaker Pierce McCleary follows Buffalebrity drag trio She Lives through a night of convoluted, cross-dressing chaos. Will she ever make it?!

metas.name: Vested Interest
metas.description: Two college-age buddies begin to have their world flipped upside down when one of them discovers a workplace murder.

metas.name: An Evening with PinkPantheress Begins... (Live At The Wiltern)
metas.description: PinkPantheress presents the tour for her hit mixtape, Fancy That, live in Los Angeles.

metas.name: CMLL: The Night of The Amazonas 2026
metas.description: In celebration of International Women's Day, CMLL presents The Night of The Amazonas 2026, a historic all-women wrestling spectacular streaming live on TrillerTV from Arena México.  This star-studded event brings together elite talent from CMLL, AEW, Stardom, and the lucha libre indies for one unforgettable night of high-impact action, championship gold, and international rivalries.  The main event features global superstar Mercedes Moné defending the CMLL Women's World Championship against rising CMLL standout Persephone.

metas.name: The Last Hail Mary
metas.description: When the planet Mercury is swallowed up by the Sun’s gravitational pull, a team aboard the Interplanetary Space Station, including a suspicious Martian scientist, must race to reverse the effect before Venus, and even Earth, are destroyed forever.

metas.name: Buckling Under the Pressure
metas.description: A young man tries to buckle his seatbelt without embarrassing himself.

metas.name: The Sinks
metas.description: A small band from Tucson - comprised of four best friends - plays their final show at the end of college.

metas.name: EVE 145: Women Behaving Badly
metas.description: EVE 145: Women Behaving Badly was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro-Wrestling: EVE that took place on March 6, 2026, at The Big Penny Social in London, England, and was headlined by DASH Chisako vs. Anita Vaughan in a Falls Count Anywhere Match.

metas.name: GCW They Said It Couldn't Be Done (In Kentucky)
metas.description: They Said It Couldn't Be Done (In Kentucky) was a professional wrestling event promoted by Game Changer Wrestling (GCW), held on March 6, 2026 at Bourbon Hall in Louisville, KY. The event features a brutal GCW Ultraviolent Championship clash, with Otis Cogar defending against Reed Bentley in a violent, no-holds-barred battle. Plus, the GCW World Championship takes center stage as Atticus Cogar puts his title on the line against the powerhouse Larry D.

metas.name: Incubation
metas.description: In an isolated cabin amidst a devastating pandemic, Helen takes every precaution to protect her children Ethan and Lily. But when a mysterious stranger named Gideon arrives, the family's fragile reality shatters. As secrets unravel and a deadly confrontation ensues, Ethan must make a harrowing choice to protect his sister and mother.

metas.name: Inheritance Of Silence
metas.description: "To live is to suffer, to survive is to find meaning in the suffering."  Three brothers, known as the Berkshire brothers, and their friend Erik go to a motel to relieve stress, but after they find their friend's dead body in the basement, the brothers realize the killer is among them

metas.name: One More Sip
metas.description: Two alcoholics house sit a rich home for the weekend until one of them takes their tomfoolery too far.

metas.name: Behind the True Story of Sometimes I Imagine Your Funeral
metas.description: Behind the True Story takes you behind the scenes of Vince Dixon's 'Sometimes I Imagine Your Funeral', a short film based on Vince and his real-life experience of losing his sister Lauren to an overdose. Crowdfunded by his community and the addiction recovery networks, Vince was able to bring together a team of Los Angeles-based and Indianapolis-based creatives to film in his home community of central Indiana. The short film follows Max as he processes how to eulogize his sister Chloe, an experience that mirrors Vince’s own. This documentary is a behind-the-scenes look at the multi-day filmmaking process of the film and is a tribute to the real-life friends and family who helped Vince create this awareness film

metas.name: Gonzaga: The Slipper Still Fits
metas.description: Documentary centers on how head coach Mark Few turned the small college program into a national powerhouse that became a regular contender in the NCAA Division I men’s basketball tournament known as March Madness.

metas.name: Pass Time
metas.description: Pass Time explores the passive absorption of breaking news and political discourse during one of the most charged elections in American history. How did we arrive at this moment, where truth and narrative blur? What forces have shaped our perceptions, and what consequences lie in wait as we drift through an ever-shifting landscape of information? Where are we headed, and can we even see it coming?

metas.name: Wait For Me
metas.description: As a powerful storm sweeps through Southeast Mexico, a family takes refuge in their small meat shop. In the dead of night, their grandmother weaves an ancient tale of the Xtbay-a spirit born of grief and longing-to help them confront their fears and hold onto hope as their father is lost in the storm.

metas.name: Bikini Lawyer
metas.description: A lawyer finds herself caught in a mysterious corporate office, confronting a complex case that drives her beyond reason.

metas.name: The Weird Guy
metas.description: A Weird Guy searches for food, but finds love instead.

metas.name: Pinball
metas.description: In this contemplative coming of age portrait, Yosef, a spirited athlete, is becoming more aware of his family history, after being displaced from their Iraqi homeland.

metas.name: Buckskin
metas.description: An experimental portrait of the filmmaker’s grandfather: Carroll B. Williams Jr., a ground-breaking African-American forester, reflecting on his work and legacy in the twilight of his life.

metas.name: Division
metas.description: Spring, 2025. Brooklyn, New York. One chapter closes and another begins.

metas.name: First They Came for My College
metas.description: When the Governor of Florida transforms a beloved public honors college in a political coup, students and professors confront a new reality: their campus is ground zero in a growing nation-wide assault on academic freedom.

metas.name: Power Slap 18: Wolverine vs. Da Crazy Hawaiian
metas.description: Power Slap 18, featuring a main event match between Wolverine and Da Crazy Hawaiian, is scheduled for Friday, March 6, 2026, at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.

metas.name: Landscapes of Memory
metas.description: As a Jewish American filmmaker studies her past in Berlin, she grapples with the reality of her trauma being weaponized to inflict violence on Palestinians.

metas.name: The Hotline
metas.description: Portrait of an anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using, and volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, forging collective hope amid addiction.

metas.name: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
metas.description: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.

metas.name: In the Rearview
metas.description: At his best friend’s funeral, a young man’s grief clashes with a truth too heavy to bury.

metas.name: Charlie Is Not a Boy
metas.description: Charlie is Not a Boy is the tale of a hushed soul, bound to a crumbling household in an allegorical America. With a perverted butcher for a father and a mother frozen in a quiet, catatonic spell, Charlie seeks solace in the whimsical world of his eccentric grandmother. As his safe haven unravels, Charlie navigates the hostile worlds of home and the military, caught between his authentic self and the masks he must wear.

metas.name: The Plan
metas.description: Inside a modest Los Angeles apartment over the course of a single day, a group of disillusioned young adults prepares for a radical act they believe will change the world. As paranoia builds and fractures deepen, the lines between purpose, fear, and identity blur.

metas.name: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
metas.description: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

metas.name: Chirp Talker
metas.description: On her city balcony, Audrey delights in the flutter of tiny birds—fluffing their feathers, chattering, and sneaking tangerine bites. Their chirps sound like cheerful hellos and playful spats, inspiring her to invent a bird-language translator that unlocks their secret conversations.

metas.name: Ramón Who Speaks to Ghosts
metas.description: After a volcanic eruption, Ramón walks the island of La Palma with his microphone, looking for ghosts.

metas.name: A Life in Art: Through the Eye of Dr. Leslie King Hammond
metas.description: The life and work of Dr. Leslie King Hammond, a renowned art historian, teacher, curator and artist, exposes a side of the art world rarely seen. Through studio visits and museum exhibitions, Dr. Hammond untiringly dedicates her life to assisting artists of color find their way to success through humor, ingenuity and the incredible creativity she and her extended artist family embody. Her insistence on excellence and vision to rise above and transform the struggles she faces becomes contagious.

metas.name: Love Sick Rebourne
metas.description: Can Samantha Anderson survive the worst night of her life, or will the weapon of mass destruction she was made to be, take over?

metas.name: Running Late
metas.description: A short and sweet film about a couple running late to their wedding. Made with love! For love!

metas.name: Just Friends
metas.description: Natalie connects with Isaac after a series of bad dates, but navigating the blurry lines between friendship and romance proves messier than expected.

metas.name: The Letter
metas.description: A one-minute short where a piece of news changes the relationship between two best friends forever.

metas.name: Treagens' Black Shadows
metas.description: Treagen Kiers' Black Shadows is a chilling triptych thriller that dissects the fragile morality of the modern world through three visceral chapters wrapped into one provocative film.

metas.name: Incessant
metas.description: Haunted by what she believes is her husband's spirit, a grieving widow embarks on a time-traveling journey through her memories in a desperate attempt to change the past.

metas.name: Moana Jr: The Ranches Academy School Performance
metas.description: Live Recording of the Ranches Academy School Performance of "Disney’s Moana JR", a musical adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film, bringing the adventures of Moana and her village of Motunui to life onstage. Moana JR. features all the beloved songs from the film, written by Tony®, GRAMMY, Emmy, and Pulitzer Prize-winning composer Lin-Manuel Miranda, Opetaia Foa’i, and Mark Mancina, including “How Far I’ll Go,” “Shiny,” and “You’re Welcome.”  This thrilling and heartwarming coming-of-age story follows the strong-willed Moana as she sets sail across the Pacific to save her village and discover the truth about her heritage. Moana and the legendary demigod Maui embark on an epic journey of self-discovery and camaraderie as both learn to harness the power that lies within. With empowering messages of bravery and selflessness, Moana JR. is sure to bring out the hero within each of us.

metas.name: KIRAC 29: Whore Dialectics
metas.description: While Ben Lunato awaits his day in court, we embark with him on a journey through the world of whores. We traverse bizarre mental landscapes and arrive in Los Angeles, where we meet our friend, the art dealer Stefan Simchowitz, and, of course, whores. Endlessly many whores.  In Los Angeles, walking through the warehouses that store Stefan Simchowitz’s vast collection of contemporary African art, a promising discovery emerges concerning whores and fetishized Africans. In this film these figures appear to merge into an affirmative horizon, beyond woke ideology and politics, toward a new art, reaching back to reestablish a link with modernist symbolism as represented by Picasso’s Demoiselles d’Avignon.

metas.name: XOXO
metas.description: Love's mirror

metas.name: Make Up Sex
metas.description: After a year of dating, a young couple explores the boundaries of what Make Up Sex can do for their relationship. Jeremy, not looking for confrontation, agrees to give it a try as they gear up to start that one fight worth making up over.

metas.name: Season's Greetings
metas.description: At a Christmas party, a girl seeks closure from her ex, only to get answers she doesn’t want.

metas.name: Bi-Rista
metas.description: Leslie, an awkward queer woman, tries to work up the courage to ask out the cute barista at her local coffee shop.

metas.name: I Just Shit My Pants
metas.description: On Valentine's Day, a man shits his pants while proposing to his girlfriend.

metas.name: Tender: Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips
metas.description: "Tender" is a tribute to the care, responsibility, and quiet eccentricity of the goaltending position – exploring a lesser-seen side of some of the fiercest competitors in a brutal sport. Told through the intertwined careers of Team USA goaltenders Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips, this short documentary highlights the talents, habits, and quirks that make both athletes individually elite at their craft, while allowing their distinct personalities to shine through. It also examines the unique bond between goalie partners – a relationship defined by mutual trust and respect, forged over years as both teammates and opponents.

metas.name: Pencil & Doodles
metas.description: On the eve of her departure, a citywide blackout traps two childhood best friends in an apartment, forcing them to face the conversation about love they can no longer avoid.

metas.name: My Hero
metas.description: On their way to Comic-Con, a timid guy in an ill-fitting Spider-Man freezes as two bullies humiliate his girlfriend.

metas.name: The Amazing Bulk: Re-Bulked
metas.description: The greatest mockbuster of all time has been reimagined and reinterpreted by nearly 100 people.

metas.name: Homewreckers
metas.description: With his friends constantly crashing at his house and straining his relationship with his girlfriend, James must choose between his friends and his girlfriend.

metas.name: Sam Darnold's Redemption
metas.description: Sam Darnold's journey from early career setbacks to Super Bowl stardom with the Seattle Seahawks is chronicled. NFL Films follows the player's path through multiple teams, showcasing both struggles and triumphs.

metas.name: For The Love of Film
metas.description: A heartbroken film student is pulled out of his slump by his colleague and rediscovers passion for cinema. When a major movie podcast invites him to join an episode, he sees a chance to finally move forward as he steps into a moment that could change everything.

metas.name: D RATING
metas.description: After anonymously purchasing a service from his favorite OnlyFans model, a young man must confront his choices when meeting this woman in the real world.

metas.name: Window Service Only
metas.description: A new customer can’t decide if he wants the single or the double.

metas.name: Two Guys and a Time Machine
metas.description: Two roommates find out how to control time what could go wrong? (answer: everything)

metas.name: Ghosted In Love
metas.description: At a Halloween party, a reclusive English major, Will, falls in love with the mysterious Ghost Girl. But before he can get her name, she vanishes. It is up to Will and his best friend Marty to find Ghost Girl before she is lost forever.

metas.name: Cupid
metas.description: Follow Cupid and her new client Neha as they race the clock to find her a date for Valentine's Day. Will she find a perfect match? Or has it been there all along...?

metas.name: The Prodigy
metas.description: Roger Sportsmans comes to Bellingham to escape his crime-riddled past when he stumbles on an underground foosball ring.

metas.name: How to Kill a Mermaid: The Linnea Mills Story
metas.description: A heart-wrenching true-crime documentary exploring the death of 18-year-old Linnea Mills during a 2020 cold-water scuba dive in Montana’s Glacier National Park. Using never-before-seen footage, it reexamines the fatal dive and investigation, offering an intimate portrait of a life cut short.

metas.name: Wild Asia: Life at Extremes
metas.description: Atop the world’s tallest peaks of the Himalayas, get an intimate look at elusive Snow Leopards and Tiger moms in Nepal raising their young. Witness a Tibetan Fox ‘hide-and-seek hunting’ amongst yaks on an ancient plateau, catch glimpses of the secretive red panda in its remote forest stronghold, meet the remarkable long-eared jumping Jerboa in the harsh Gobi Desert, and fly alongside beautiful songbirds feeding on “sapcicles” in northern Japan. In the world’s richest coral seas of the Pacific, discover the cute-yet-deadly Sea Bunny and be immersed in an unbelievable shark feeding frenzy, that’s never been filmed before. Each story reveals the incredible ways in which wildlife has adapted to thrive in these challenging habitats.

metas.name: On Air
metas.description: A driven high school announcer’s carefully controlled routine is thrown off balance when a carefree co-host enters her world, forcing her to confront perfection, vulnerability, and what it means to share her voice both on air and off.

metas.name: The Butterfly Lab
metas.description: At Oregon’s only women’s prison, incarcerated women raise an endangered butterfly. In the Lab, eggs are collected and caterpillars are fed by hand, each life stage carefully nurtured.  As metamorphosis nears, the film reflects on captivity, purpose, care, and the natural world.

metas.name: Love Hurts
metas.description: After kidnapping a Valentine’s Day icon, local mob boss Frank Deeno learns the hard way that love hurts like hell.

metas.name: Love Notes
metas.description: A couple diagnoses and dissects their relationship through thoughts and notes.

metas.name: AEW Grand Slam Australia 2026
metas.description: Grand Slam Australia 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on February 14, 2026 at Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Brody King for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Creation Story: A First Date
metas.description: A middle-aged woman embarks on a first date.

metas.name: Osculum Infame: The Shameful Kiss
metas.description: A Catholic college student wants to join a coven, so she goes to a chapel and performs a ritual in hopes of summoning the devil. Where she can then perform the Osculum Infame and be initiated!

metas.name: The Last Egg
metas.description: After the passing of her last living relative, an astronaut travels across a sterile universe to a hostile planet believed to have a psionic egg with the ability to restore life. However, the closer she gets the more aggressive the egg and the planet become.

metas.name: Kiss Me
metas.description: Desperate for affection, Hazel unravels while grappling with the lack of intimacy and fulfillment in her life.

metas.name: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
metas.description: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

metas.name: The Same Frame
metas.description: While writing a screenplay for successful film producer Sally Kimmer, twin brothers Austin and Lee learn of their true sibling rivalry. As tensions rise, Sally finds herself having to prove herself worthy to her pushy boss Mr. Williams.

metas.name: Because of Cupid
metas.description: Best friends Naomi and Marcus participate in a Valentine's Day mocktail competition but things go awry when Cupid interferes with a love potion that affects Marcus and several of their friends.

metas.name: Just Shy of Love
metas.description: A story of boy meets girl.

metas.name: Cigar Box
metas.description: A high schooler gives his girlfriend a cigar box, but she rejects it. Throughout the years, as their paths cross, he takes each opportunity to ask her why.

metas.name: Back Then
metas.description: Haneul greets his parents and heads to college. While in a taxi to New York, a diminishing past memory is brought up — through one old, crumbled Leche Frita wrapper.

metas.name: Ernie and Emma
metas.description: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

metas.name: More Than Monogamy
metas.description: Sexuality is complex. Sexuality is diverse. Sexuality is More Than Monogamy.  "The Lifestyle" is a massive umbrella term that encompasses swinging, polyamory, kink...and so much more; this documentary is all about highlighting and explaining why it might be perfect for your relationship and maybe why it won't.  Designed to be both educational and entertaining, let's look at why there can be so much more to a relationship than monogamy.

metas.name: The Metropolitan Opera: Cinderella
metas.description: In this New Year’s Day performance, Laurent Pelly’s storybook staging of Massenet’s Cendrillon, a hit of the 2017–18 season, is presented with an all-new English translation in an abridged 90-minute adaptation, with mezzo-soprano Isabel Leonard as its rags-to-riches princess. Maestro Emmanuel Villaume leads a delightful cast, which includes mezzo-soprano Emily D’Angelo as Cinderella’s Prince Charming, soprano Jessica Pratt as her Fairy Godmother, and mezzo-soprano Stephanie Blythe and bass-baritone Laurent Naouri as her feuding guardians. This live cinema transmission is part of the Met’s award-winning Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.

metas.name: How to Make a Killing
metas.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

metas.name: Love on Tap
metas.description: Amber, a headstrong brewery owner, and Samuel, a slick marketing strategist, clash over how to save her failing business. But as they stir up a plan to reinvent the brewery, they unexpectedly ferment their own love story.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

metas.name: Because of You
metas.description: Brayden, a young 17 year old boy, faces conflict and self doubt as he navigates the complexities of one's first love. Supported by many, he remains in question and fear until crossing paths with the one who changes everything - Thomas.

metas.name: Spooder-Kid Shattered World
metas.description: Full movie version of series.  Its been a few months since Spooder-Kid has defeated the Bubbler. Its winter time. The boys are well adjusted to their new lives. But when a new villain who goes by the name of Octavius creates a dangerous machine to  make infinite energy and finish what the Bubbler started , Spooder-Kid intervenes. Will he save his town from this new unwanted threat?

metas.name: Finding Orson
metas.description: Andrew Callaghan helps find a lost parrot

metas.name: Gangster’s Daughter 4
metas.description: Kadisha Spencer continues to run her father’s brutal empire while matching wits with Detective Steel and meticulously eliminating her enemies.

metas.name: Working in Progress
metas.description: Working in Progress is a quirky, offbeat mockumentary that hilariously captures the bizarre and absurd day-to-day operations of Scorbsackeg, a company with a purpose no one can quite figure out. Founded and run by the delusional and self-obsessed CEO James Brownlee, the company operates out of his sister Janet's home in the small town of Progress, Delaware. Despite its lack of clear direction, James believes the business is destined for greatness. He's so convinced, in fact, that he hires a film crew to capture his "rise to success," planning to sell the documentary alongside his autobiography when he makes it big.

metas.name: Living in the Cemetery
metas.description: A mother haunted by trauma becomes overprotective of her daughter, but when the daughter falls in love, their bond fractures. As buried secrets emerge, both must confront whether forgiveness can heal old wounds before it's too late.

metas.name: Georgia Peach
metas.description: A nurse in recovery from alcoholism must confront her past and her brother's growing demands, risking everything she's worked for to reclaim her life or lose it all to her inner demons.

metas.name: Body Of Nurses
metas.description: A doctor is led into a web of betrayal by his nurses on a fateful night shift at a mysterious hospital.

metas.name: Evaporation
metas.description: Two strangers bond through fleeting moments of smoking, but beneath their connection lie a gut wrenching emptiness they can't escape.

metas.name: Big Scouse
metas.description: Big Scouse follows Terry O’Neill’s journey from Merseyside to Richmond, Virginia and the impact he had on the city's football culture with his legendary pub Penny Lane and what makes it the best football bar in America.

metas.name: Feigning Tennis
metas.description: An amateur tennis player must keep up the facade of being a pro to delay her wedding to a man she’s fallen out of love with. If her career takes off, she can excuse herself from the relationship with the promise of bigger and better things, even though it might reveal she was leading him on, but if she fails, she’d rather be in a one-sided marriage than completely alone. How far will she feign tennis success before the truth comes out?

metas.name: Caught Slippin
metas.description: Three couples-Shawn and Chelsea, Mack and Ciara, and Jen and Mike-go on a weekend getaway to Joshua Tree. The trip takes a dark turn when Mack goes missing after the first day. As tensions rise and secrets come to light, the friends must confront their deepest fears and suspicions, unraveling a mystery that threatens to change their lives forever.

metas.name: Out in the Wilderness
metas.description: A group of friends try to set off on a camping trip. After a series of mistakes leaves the group stranded in the woods, they find themselves needing to go to lengths never before imagined in order to get out alive.

metas.name: Keep It Going
metas.description: This film, which follows Xavier on his first-ever headlining tour, captures a young rapper at an inflection point in his career: he's the biggest he's ever been and needs to make a decision of where to go next. With a dedicated fanbase keeping up with his every move, Xavier is still working to make his most basic ends meet. "I'm homeless right now. We trying to get a crib right now," he admits at one point during our doc. "We still got a long way to go."

metas.name: HORSEBOTTOM
metas.description: Langely Horsebottom is an aspiring basketball player and showcases his talents on film.

metas.name: Who Killed These Women? (The Tinley Park 5)
metas.description: An examination into the largest unsolved mass shooting in modern day America today. On Feb 2, 2008 a killer executed 5 women inside a Lane Bryant department store in suburban Chicago.

metas.name: Confessions of a Girl
metas.description: She has something to say.....and you better listen.

metas.name: Violent Bastards
metas.description: A disillusioned teenager embraces violence as a means to truly fight for ideologies, drawing his estranged brother into a bloody confrontation that will leave both scarred.

metas.name: Soberman
metas.description: After waking up from his first hangover, Waylon Stone experiences a life‑changing cinematic event that makes him rethink his weekend drinking habits.

metas.name: Starry Eyed
metas.description: 'A struggling actor and burnt-out painter find themselves torn between passion, love, and day jobs over a magical night at the movies.'

metas.name: The Wrong Baby Daddy
metas.description: Lila’s life finally feels complete when she starts a dream job with her close friend Robin, falls into a promising romance with Mark, and discovers she’s pregnant. But everything shifts when Julia, Mark’s ex-wife, reappears the moment she learns about the baby. At first, Julia’s involvement seems harmless, even polite, until she begins showing up uninvited, inserting herself into every corner of Lila’s new life. As Julia’s presence grows more intrusive and her intentions more unsettling, Lila realizes she may be fighting to protect far more than just her future. Soon, what began as a perfect new chapter becomes a tense battle of boundaries, obsession, and survival.

metas.name: The Blind Date
metas.description: When a young woman is set up on a blind date in New York City, she realizes quickly her date is her ex-girlfriend and must decide whether to stay or go.

metas.name: For the Love of Strippers
metas.description: An intimate portrait of two L.A. strippers and activists fighting to protect their art, safety, and livelihoods during a critical inflection point for the industry and their own lives.

metas.name: Red Flags
metas.description: After hundreds of bad dates, a chance meeting brings two people, in the same boat, together.

metas.name: BYU's Resident Cougar
metas.description: A documentary crew follows Ella Gible, a BYU student for 20 years, who refuses to graduate until she finds a husband.

metas.name: Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel
metas.description: Filmed in the intimate and historic setting of London’s Union Chapel, Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel captures the acclaimed vocalist at his most personal and powerful. Shot in November 2025, the concert film showcases Groban performing many of his most beloved songs alongside new material, all reimagined within the chapel’s soaring acoustics. The film highlights Groban’s extraordinary voice, emotional range, and deep connection with his audience.

metas.name: Bikini Nurses
metas.description: With the sheriff set to padlock their clinic at dawn, and a wealthy buyer on the prowl, three Bikini Nurses mount one last move: to impress their wealthiest patron with a show so that he'll buy the clinic and save the day.

metas.name: TNA No Surrender 2026
metas.description: No Surrender 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) that took place on February 13, 2026 at The Pinnacle in Nashville, Tennessee, USA, and was headlined by Eddie Edwards & Nic Nemeth vs. Leon Slater & Mike Santana in a Tag Team Match.

metas.name: My Dog: The Paradox
metas.description: This film is a celebration of the absurd, unconditional love between humans and their pets, equal parts hilarious and heartfelt.

metas.name: Kissing Is the Easy Part
metas.description: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

metas.name: Real Couples
metas.description: Me and my girl fight a lot, it’s honestly why I’m in therapy. Is every couple like this or are my friends better than me?

metas.name: Hunting Jessica Brok
metas.description: Long before she was a single mother in a sleepy South African town, Jessica Brok was a highly skilled, coldblooded, special ops assassin. She thought she’d left that life behind. She thought her last ill-fated mission was her last. She thought wrong.

metas.name: Mostly Void, Partially Stars
metas.description: When Sammie Mckenzie's low-stakes boyfriend cheats on her with the girlfriend of Drew Stark - Sammies high school ex - Drew and Sammies lives collide together in one night that will re-contextualize their pasts, presents, and futures.

metas.name: Joe's College Road Trip
metas.description: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.

metas.name: The Story of Ruby Falls
metas.description: A 5-minute short film that depicts not only the fated discovery of Ruby Falls in 1928, but also the passions of adoration and devotion that drove explorer Leo Lambert onward. Only viewable at Ruby Falls in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
